• Develop strong relationships with global and regional finance leaders and provide responsive, practical, and technically sound accounting support.
• Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
• Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making.
• Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
• Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
• Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
• Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams.
People Leadership and Talent Development
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals.
• Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
• Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
• Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution.
• Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
Qualifications & Experience…
Required
● Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
● At least 18 years of progressive accounting, controllership, and financial reporting with at least 8 years of supervisory role.
● Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
• Deep understanding of US GAAP, IFRS, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
● Proven experience leading large accounting teams, including leaders/managers.
● Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
● Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
● Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
● Strong analytical, problem-solving, present solution, and decision-making skills.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
● Able to work effectively across various time zones.
Desired
• Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
• Experience with remote transition.
• Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
• Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
• MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred.
Leadership Attributes
• Strong controllership leader with sound judgment and high integrity.
• Comfortable building structure in a changing environment.
• Able to balance technical accounting depth with practical business partnership.
• A leader who can build capability, coach teams, and create accountability.
• A transformation-minded leader who can simplify, standardize, and scale processes.
• Confident working with senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
• Proactive in identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving closure.

ㅤ
Job Overview
We are looking for a Senior Programmatic Integration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace, and strong knowledge of the wider programmatic advertising ecosystem. The role will own and support technical connectivity across the ad server, FreeWheel Marketplace, DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, and other advertising technology partners.
The role will work closely with Ad Sales, Product, Engineering, Trafficking, and external technology partners and vendors to diagnose complex issues, support new integrations, drive technical improvements, and establish best practices. The successful candidate will be a key technical SME for FreeWheel and Marketplace, combining strong hands-on expertise with the ability to lead technical discussions and guide the wider team.
Note: This role is a fixed term contract position for a duration of 12 Months on WBD payroll itself.
FreeWheel & Marketplace Expertise
Define and promote best practices for FreeWheel and Marketplace integrations, configurations, troubleshooting, and operational processes.
Work directly with FreeWheel and external vendors on technical investigations, product capabilities, new integrations, and resolution of complex issues.
Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of FreeWheel Marketplace issues, including integration failures, deal delivery issues, discrepancies, configuration problems, and ad-serving behaviour.
Understand Marketplace configuration, inventory and deal flows, auction/request-response behaviour, partner setup, and dependencies between FreeWheel and external platforms.
Own and support end-to-end FreeWheel Marketplace connectivity with SSPs, DSPs, DSP-side demand, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
Act as the internal subject-matter expert for FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace, with a deep understanding of how the platforms support publisher monetization and programmatic workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Ad Tech Integration & Connectivity
Own and support end-to-end integrations and connectivity between the ad server, DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic partners.
Manage and support API, oRTB, VAST, and other technical integrations, ensuring robust data and ad-request/response flows across platforms.
Lead technical assessment, testing, validation, and launch of new ad-tech integrations and partner connections.
Ensure integrations are configured correctly and aligned with business, technical, and operational requirements.
Technical Troubleshooting & Support
Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex ad-serving, programmatic, integration, and delivery issues.
Troubleshoot issues across the end-to-end ad-tech stack, identifying root causes and driving resolution with internal teams and external partners.
Support the wider Programmatic team with technical investigations, debugging, and resolution of platform or integration issues.
Use tools such as Charles Proxy, Wireshark, browser developer tools, logs, XML/VAST inspection, and platform diagnostics to investigate issues.
Analyze discrepancies, ad-request/response flows, delivery failures, VAST errors, oRTB issues, and other technical problems.
Stakeholder & Partner Management
Work closely with Ad Sales partners to understand requirements, resolve technical issues, and ensure programmatic solutions support commercial objectives.
Lead technical discussions with SSPs, DSPs, ad-tech vendors, and other external partners.
Act as a trusted technical advisor to internal stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into clear business implications and actions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Trafficking, Operations, and other teams to resolve issues and deliver new capabilities.
Technical Leadership & Best Practices
Establish and drive best practices for ad-server, DSP, SSP, and programmatic integrations.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, troubleshooting playbooks, and operational standards.
Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Share knowledge with the wider team and provide technical guidance and coaching on ad-tech integrations and troubleshooting.
Stay current with developments in programmatic advertising, ad-server capabilities, oRTB standards, and emerging ad-tech solutions.
Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Monitor the health and performance of integrations and identify trends, recurring issues, and potential risks.
Use data and technical analysis to identify opportunities for improving ad delivery, integration performance, and operational processes.
Support the rollout of new markets, partners, products, and monetization capabilities from a technical integration perspective.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Advertising, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in ad tech or programmatic operations are a plus.
Experience
5+ years of experience in programmatic advertising, ad-tech integrations, ad operations, or a related technical role, with significant hands-on experience with FreeWheel Ad Server and FreeWheel Marketplace.
Strong hands-on experience working across FreeWheel Ad Server, FreeWheel Marketplace, SSPs, DSPs, exchanges, and other programmatic platforms.
Experience owning or supporting end-to-end integrations and troubleshooting complex ad-serving and programmatic issues.
Strong understanding of oRTB, VAST/VPAID, APIs, XML, ad-request/response flows, and programmatic data flows.
Hands-on experience with debugging tools such as Charles Proxy, Wireshark, browser developer tools, logs, or similar tools.
Experience working directly with technology vendors and external programmatic partners on technical integrations and issue resolution.

Are you the kind of product leader who gets energy from turning a great product into a growth engine?
If you've built product-led experiences that actually moved the needle on revenue and retention and you want to do it at scale, in a role that sits at the heart of company strategy, this is your opportunity.

Our ambition is bold: build the most powerful self-serve growth experience in our category. Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience
Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
Core Daily Activities
Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.
Key Responsibilities:
Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.

Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.

Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.
Preferred Qualifications:
Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead
Location: Pune, India
Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.
About Zendesk
At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.
The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR.You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.
What You’ll Do
Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-
Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics
Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements.
Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times.
Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems.
Tooling Enhancements : End-to-end management of observability stacks (Data Dog) and its integration with ITSM tools (Ticketing Tools) and applications. Seek assistance from product and engineering team for any tool enhancement use cases to build a robust observability platform integrated with the ticketing tools.
Application Onboarding: Responsible and accountable for onboarding relevant observability and monitoring necessities for new applications which are onboarded and handed over to operations.
Incident & SLA Management: Oversee the operational lifecycle of monitoring tickets and Lead the monthly analysis and reporting of performance metrics (Eg - Mean time to detect, Mean time to restore,Mean time to Respond/Accept, First touch resolution) and ensure SLA compliance .
Continual Service Improvement: Liaise with technical and level 2 teams to improve and mature the current monitoring state of applications in scope.
Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights.
SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations.
Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards.
What You Bring
Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.
Nice to Have
Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).
Working Model
Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

jobs.description:
Buyer – Admin Real Estate & HR Procurement:

Role Overview:

The Buyer – Admin, Real Estate & HR Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities across Administration, Facility Management, Lease Rentals, and HR-related categories. The role includes vendor sourcing and management, commercial negotiations, contract and lease administration, PR-to-PO processing, spend analysis, and ensuring the timely procurement of goods and services in compliance with company procurement policies.

The ideal candidate should possess strong negotiation, analytical, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, along with a service-oriented approach and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities:

Administration Procurement:
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate procurement for facility management services, including housekeeping, security, pest control, and maintenance services.
- Source and procure office infrastructure such as furniture, workstations, printers, and related equipment.
- Track and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), ensuring timely renewals.
- Support procurement requirements for corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and office activities.
- Coordinate travel and accommodation bookings in line with company policies.
- Ensure timely conversion of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) into Purchase Orders (POs).
- Maintain an updated vendor database and monitor vendor performance.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate commercial terms within the approved authority limits.

Lease Rental Management:
- Manage procurement support for office spaces, branches, warehouses, fleet hubs, and other leased facilities.
- Collaborate with Business, Administration, Finance, and Legal teams for new lease acquisitions, renewals, amendments, and lease closures.
- Participate in commercial negotiations with landlords, property owners, and real estate consultants to secure competitive lease terms.
- Review lease proposals and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal approval processes.
- Coordinate lease agreement execution and maintain trackers for lease expiries, renewals, rent escalations, security deposits, lock-in periods, and notice periods.
- Process lease-related PRs, POs (where applicable), rental invoices, and payment coordination.
- Monitor rental payments, Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges, utility-related obligations, and other lease-associated commercial commitments.
- Maintain centralized lease documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Identify opportunities for lease cost optimization through renegotiation, benchmarking, and space utilization initiatives.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external landlords to resolve commercial and operational issues related to leased properties.

HR Procurement:
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors, including Group Medical Cover (GMC) and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance providers.
- Support onboarding and management of Training & Development partners.
- Coordinate with recruitment agencies for billing, documentation, and vendor management.
- Manage background verification vendor coordination.
- Oversee procurement of employee onboarding kits, corporate gifting, and engagement materials.
- Support coordination with payroll and HRMS service providers.
- Track contract validity, renewals, and compliance for HR-related vendors.

Operational Responsibilities:
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluations, commercial assessments, and sourcing recommendations.
- Monitor procurement timelines and proactively resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.
- Support budget monitoring, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and drive effective vendor performance management.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 5 years of procurement experience, with exposure to Administration, - Facility Management, HR, and Lease Rental procurement categories.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, commercial negotiations, procurement lifecycle (PR-to-PO), contract administration, and vendor management.
- Prior experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement management will be an added advantage.
- Excellent analytical and commercial evaluation capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- High attention to detail with strong documentation and record management capabilities.

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.
The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire an Enterprise GTM Lead to own the go to market charter for Paytm’s AI Inference and Agentic AI products across enterprise clients.
This is a managerial role that will lead business managers and client onboarding managers, and will work closely with enterprise sales teams to drive pipeline, deal conversion, onboarding, and client success.
The role sits at the center of Paytm’s enterprise AI charter and involves shaping GTM strategy, enabling sales teams, supporting client pitches, structuring commercials, and ensuring strong post sale execution.
The candidate will be responsible for building a repeatable enterprise sales motion for Paytm AI agents, including Pi Commerce and future AI products.
The role requires strong commercial judgment, enterprise stakeholder management, execution discipline, and ability to work across sales, product, technology, finance, and marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise GTM Strategy and Business Ownership
Own the enterprise GTM strategy for Paytm AI agents across existing and new enterprise clients.
Build and execute sales enablement, pipeline generation, deal conversion, onboarding, and account expansion plans.
Work with leadership to define target segments, priority accounts, industry plays, and product positioning.
Translate business goals into clear GTM plans, sales motions, commercial models, and execution cadences.
Track the full enterprise funnel across sales channels and drive corrective action where performance deviates from plan.

Sales Enablement and Enterprise Sales Partnership
Work closely with Paytm’s enterprise sales teams to equip them with product knowledge, pitch material, pricing frameworks, commercials, and objection handling support.
Accompany sales teams in key client pitches, discovery discussions, solutioning sessions, and commercial negotiations.
Build reusable sales assets including pitch decks, case studies, proposals, demo scripts, pricing notes, and competitive positioning.
Conduct regular training sessions for enterprise sales teams on Pi Commerce and other Paytm AI agents.
Ensure enterprise sales teams are consistently updated on new product launches, feature upgrades, pricing changes, and GTM priorities.

Commercial Strategy, Pricing, and Deal Support
Own pricing strategy and commercial structuring for enterprise AI agent deployments in partnership with business, finance, and sales teams.
Support custom pricing, proposal creation, margin analysis, and negotiation strategy for strategic enterprise deals.
Drive enterprise level invoicing discipline in coordination with finance operations and central finance teams.
Support vendor negotiations and third party commercial discussions wherever required for enterprise deployments.
Ensure deal structures are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and aligned with Paytm’s AI business objectives.

Pipeline Generation and B2B Marketing
Drive enterprise pipeline generation initiatives across industry events, account based outreach, webinars, client workshops, ecosystem partnerships, and targeted campaigns.
Partner with sales and marketing teams to create strong B2B marketing programs for Paytm AI agents.
Build client engagement programs to nurture warm accounts, enrich leads, and improve conversion from interest to qualified opportunities.
Identify high potential enterprise use cases and convert them into focused GTM plays by industry and function.
Track campaign and pipeline performance, and improve channel productivity through structured reviews.

Product Feedback and Client Success
Capture structured feedback from clients and enterprise sales teams on product capabilities, pricing, integrations, and adoption barriers.
Work with product and technology teams to convert market feedback into product roadmap inputs and feature improvements.
Ensure major product upgrades, launches, and new capabilities are communicated clearly to clients and sales teams.
Work with client onboarding managers to ensure smooth deployment, adoption, and early value realization.
Support account expansion by identifying new use cases, cross sell opportunities, and adoption gaps within existing clients.

Team Leadership and Governance
Lead and mentor business managers and client onboarding managers across enterprise GTM and deployment workstreams.
Set clear goals, review cadences, dashboards, and operating rhythms for the enterprise AI GTM charter.
Monitor sales funnel performance, onboarding progress, revenue milestones, invoicing status, and client satisfaction.
Conduct root cause analysis for pipeline gaps, delayed conversions, onboarding delays, or revenue deviations.
Build scalable operating processes, playbooks, and governance mechanisms to make the enterprise GTM engine repeatable.

Ideal Candidate Profile

4 to 6 years of experience across enterprise sales strategy, GTM, business management, consulting, revenue operations, or enterprise SaaS roles.

impact role at the senior level where your success directly dictates the company's growth curve.

with 5-7 years of proven expertise for strategic sourcing and procurement of IT
products and services. Strategic Procurement & Sourcing:

cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), SaaS applications, cybersecurity solutions, telecommunications, and managed services.

objectives and technology roadmaps.

risk throughout the contract lifecycle.

(TCO).

integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners.

reviews to improve service quality and vendor performance.

teams to understand procurement requirements and deliver timely sourcing
support.

strategies and commercial decisions.

 Vendor Relationship & Performance Management

preferred.

Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants, and online platforms. We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Key Account Manager focused primarily on hunting and bringing incremental business to the platform. The person will identify prospects, build a pipeline, pitch our offerings, negotiate commercials, close new business and deliver measurable monthly revenue.

Qualified opportunities created

Revenue/incentive contribution

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. 

Role Objective:
Own performance marketing initiatives for Paytm's consumer businesses with a focus on incremental user growth, transaction growth and efficient CAC/CPT across acquisition and reactivation.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own performance marketing strategy and execution across Google, Meta, OEM/DSP and emerging digital channels.
- Manage the consumer funnel across App Install → Signup/Login → First Transaction → Repeat/Reactivate.
- Translate business objectives into channel strategy, budgets, audience architecture, bidding and optimization frameworks.
- Drive improvement in CAC/CPI/CPT, conversion rates, scale and incremental contribution.
- Identify growth opportunities across UPI, Recharge & Utilities, Travel and other Paytm consumer businesses through user, geography, cohort and funnel-level analysis.
- Lead experimentation across audiences, creatives, campaign structures, bidding/optimization events, geographies and new platforms.
- Work closely with Analytics, Product, Business, Creative and Martech teams to improve measurement, attribution and campaign effectiveness.
- Develop strong understanding of incrementality, attribution and user quality, rather than optimizing purely towards platform-reported conversions.
- Leverage platforms such as AppsFlyer, Firebase, GA4, BigQuery and internal analytics tools to identify opportunities and drive decisions.
- Evaluate new performance channels, OEM partnerships and emerging ad products.
- Own performance reporting and communicate key insights, opportunities and risks to senior stakeholders.
- Ensure strong governance on budgets, pacing, measurement and marketing efficiency.

Requirement:
- 3–5 years of experience in performance marketing, preferably in fintech, consumer internet, e-commerce or high-scale app businesses.
- Strong hands-on experience across Google Ads and Meta; exposure to DSP/OEM/app-growth ecosystems is preferred.
- Strong understanding of app acquisition, re-engagement, attribution and full-funnel optimization.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business decisions.
- Experience independently managing budgets and delivering measurable growth.
- Strong commercial mindset with an understanding of the trade-off between scale, efficiency and user quality.
- High ownership and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Why join us?
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager 

Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us: Paytm is India’s leading payments Super App, offering consumers and merchants a wide range of financial services. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm’s mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial inclusion.
Paytm Money is the wealth-tech arm of Paytm, enabling users to invest in mutual funds, equities, and derivatives seamlessly. Owned by One97 Communications, founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma, the company is headquartered in Noida and backed by leading global investors.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing leader to drive scalable and efficient user growth for Paytm Money within the Paytm ecosystem. 

This role will own the end-to-end paid growth charter across mutual funds, equities,  derivatives and MTF with a strong focus on acquisition efficiency, funnel optimization, and ROI-driven scaling.

Sitting at the intersection of marketing, analytics, and product, this role will play a critical part in accelerating new user acquisition, improving activation rates, and maximizing lifetime value across investment products.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Performance Marketing Strategy & Ownership:
* Own and drive the performance marketing strategy across channels (Google, Meta,, programmatic, OEMs).
* Manage large-scale acquisition budgets with a strong focus on ROI, CAC, and payback periods.
* Scale user acquisition across mutual funds, equities, and derivatives segments.

2. User Acquisition & Funnel Optimization: 
* Build and optimize full-funnel campaigns—from awareness to conversion (app installs, KYC completion, first trade/investment).
* Improve conversion rates across onboarding journeys (demat account opening, SIP setup, trading activation).
* Continuously refine targeting, creatives, and landing experiences.

3. Data-Led Growth & Experimentation
* Leverage analytics frameworks (A/B testing, attribution modeling, cohort analysis) to drive decision-making.
* Identify funnel drop-offs and optimize user journeys across acquisition and activation stages.
* Partner with analytics teams to build robust LTV, CAC, and ROI models.

4. Channel Expansion & Innovation:
* Identify and scale new acquisition channels (OEM partnerships, fintech alliances, influencer-led growth).
* Experiment with emerging formats such as video commerce, vernacular campaigns, and content-led acquisition.
* Drive innovation in performance marketing through automation and AI-driven optimization.

5. Product & Marketing Integration:
* Work closely with Product and business teams to improve landing pages, onboarding flows, and conversion journeys.
* Influence product features that enhance acquisition and activation (e.g., simplified KYC, personalized onboarding).
* Align marketing campaigns with product releases and feature launches.

6. Retention & Lifecycle Marketing (Support Role):
* Collaborate with CRM and lifecycle teams to improve activation and early retention.
* Enable seamless transition from acquisition to engagement journeys (SIPs, trading behavior).

7. Stakeholder Management & Leadership: 
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Business teams.
* Present campaign performance, insights, and growth opportunities to senior leadership.
* Build and mentor a high-performing performance marketing team.

Key KRAs / Success Metrics:
* Cost per acquisition (CPA) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Conversion rates across funnel stages (install → KYC → activation)
* Volume of new users (demat accounts, SIP registrations, traders)
* ROI and payback period on marketing spends
* Contribution to overall user growth and revenue

Qualifications & Experience:
* 10+ years of experience in performance marketing / growth roles
* Strong background in broking, wealth management, or fintech platforms
* Proven track record of managing large-scale digital acquisition budgets
* Deep understanding of stock markets, mutual funds, and derivatives ecosystem
* Experience in scaling user acquisition for consumer internet platforms

Key Skills:
* Performance marketing & media buying
* Funnel optimization & conversion rate improvement
* Data analytics & attribution modeling
* Growth experimentation frameworks
* Martech tools and campaign automation
* Stakeholder management & leadership

distributes various financial services offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with
financial institutions.

Paytm Intelligence is building next-generation AI platforms across two key areas: AI inference
infrastructure and agentic AI solutions. Our focus is on enabling enterprises to move from AI
experimentation to production-grade deployment with measurable business outcomes.

specific AI agents that automate complex customer journeys across sales, service, and operations. These
systems go beyond traditional chatbots, orchestrating workflows, decisions, and actions across
enterprise systems.

About the Role
We are hiring an AI Agentic Solutions Architect to drive enterprise adoption of AI-powered workflow
automation. This role sits at the intersection of business process transformation, AI systems, and
enterprise sales.
You will work directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, identify automation
opportunities, and design agentic solutions that deliver measurable outcomes such as cost reduction,
conversion uplift, and improved customer experience.

Customer Journey and Workflow Design
 Map end-to-end customer journeys across sales, support, and operations.
 Identify high-impact automation opportunities.
 Design agent-driven workflows across systems and teams.
Solution Architecture
 Design agentic AI systems including orchestration, APIs, and integrations.
 Combine LLMs, rules, and enterprise systems into scalable architectures.
Business Value Articulation
 Translate solutions into measurable outcomes such as cost reduction and conversion uplift.
 Support deal teams with ROI narratives.
POC and Deployment
 Lead proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with clear success metrics.
 Ensure POCs convert to production deployments.
Stakeholder Engagement
 Engage both business and technical stakeholders.
 Effectively handle skepticism stemming from prior enterprise AI failures.
Reusable Playbooks
 Build repeatable solution frameworks across industries.
 Enable sales teams with structured use cases.
Superpowers & Skills That Will Help You Succeed
 5–8 years of experience in AI/ML, SaaS, or workflow automation.
 Proven track record of working successfully with enterprise customers.
 Strong foundational understanding of customer journeys and core business processes.
 Technical familiarity with APIs, system integrations, and complex enterprise software architectures.
 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap and communicate effectively
with both technical engineers and business stakeholders.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)
 Deal Impact: Influence deal progression and maximize win rates.
 POC Conversion: Successfully convert pilots to full production deployments.
 Business Value Articulation: Deliver quantified outcomes, data-backed ROI, and clear business
metrics.
 Workflow Depth: Build strong, highly repeatable use cases across diverse industries.
 Customer Credibility: Establish deep trust and strategic advisory standing with enterprise
stakeholders.
Culture & Compensation

We foster a merit-based culture that thrives on self-motivated & driven individuals who are set out
to build a successful career in India’s fastest-growing Fintech Organization. We offer an agile &

Third-Party Risk Assessment

jobs.description:

Title: Application Security Compliance Lead

About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
The opportunity
As an Application Security Compliance Lead, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.
A major focus is organization-level PCI Software Security Framework (SSF) activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.
What you will do
Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
What you will bring
Essential experience and capabilities
Typically, 7+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk-based decision-making.
Technical understanding of cloud services, source-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day-to-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
Desirable experience and capabilities
Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
Knowledge of payment-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
Experience delivering application security or compliance-related training.
Knowledge of security and governance for AI-enabled software development and products.
A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
How you will succeed
Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
Evidence we value
In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.

Own the ongoing support, maintenance, reliability, and enhancement of Data Concierge, AskInsights, and related AI-powered data products.
Build, test, deploy, and optimize data pipelines and transformations using dbt, SQL, Alteryx, and related technologies.
Design and develop governed, reusable data models and contextual data capabilities that support analytics, automation, and AI use cases.
Monitor data and application health, troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and improve reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Experience with Alteryx or similar data preparation, analytics, or workflow automation platforms.
Experience designing and maintaining data solutions within cloud-based or modern enterprise data environments.
Good understanding of data modeling, data quality, testing, monitoring, observability, and production support.
Experience integrating data solutions with APIs, enterprise applications, and external services.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent the last few years deep in FPGA design and implementation, and you have learned that the real work begins when a customer's design does not compile the way they expected or when partitioning across multiple FPGAs creates timing issues no one saw coming. You are the engineer who stays on the call until the problem is solved, not because you have to, but because leaving something half-fixed bothers you.
You are comfortable reading Verilog or SystemVerilog that someone else wrote, understanding what they were trying to do, and figuring out why the synthesis tool is choking on it. You know your way around FPGA architecture well enough to explain why a design that worked fine in simulation is failing in hardware, and you can do it in a way that does not make the customer feel like they missed something obvious.
Working with customers energizes you. You like the variety of problems, the pressure of real deadlines, and the satisfaction of helping someone get unstuck. You do not need everything documented perfectly to move forward. You ask the right questions, dig into log files, reproduce issues locally, and escalate to R&D when needed with enough context that they can actually help.
At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most complex emulation and prototyping workflows in the industry, supporting global customers who depend on Zebu and Protocompiler to verify chips that power everything from automotive systems to data centers.
What You'll Be Doing
Provide technical support to global customers using Synopsys Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping software, troubleshooting issues across partitioning, synthesis, place and route, and hardware debug
Work directly with customers to migrate their designs to new software releases, ensuring compatibility and resolving any regressions or performance issues that surface
Deploy new software features on live customer designs, helping them adopt capabilities like advanced partitioning algorithms, new debug modes, or updated FPGA target support
Deliver technical training sessions to customers, ranging from basic tool usage to advanced workflows for multi-FPGA partitioning and hardware-software co-verification
Collaborate with Synopsys HAV R&D teams to report customer issues, provide reproducible test cases, and advocate for product improvements based on real-world usage patterns
Support pre-sales evaluations by running customer designs through the Synopsys emulation and prototyping flow, demonstrating performance and identifying potential adoption blockers
Travel occasionally to customer sites for onsite support, training, or critical issue resolution
The Impact You Will Have
Enable customers to bring up complex SoC designs on emulation and prototyping platforms faster, reducing their verification cycle time by weeks or months
Improve product quality by surfacing real customer pain points to R&D with enough technical detail that fixes can be prioritized and implemented effectively
Build customer confidence in Synopsys HAV solutions through responsive, expert-level support that helps them solve problems they could not solve on their own
Expand adoption of new software features by showing customers how to use them on their actual designs, not just in demos
Reduce escalations and support load over time by delivering training that helps customers become more self-sufficient with the toolchain
Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they trust to pick up the phone when something is broken and production timelines are at risk
Contribute to the technical knowledge base and internal best practices that make the entire support organization more effective
What You'll Need
Bachelors in Electronics Engineering with 2-3 years of experience, or Master's in Electronics Engineering with 1-2 years, specifically in emulation or prototyping environments
Hands-on experience with logic design and implementation using FPGAs, including synthesis, place and route, and timing closure
Strong working knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog, or VHDL, including the ability to read, debug, and modify RTL written by others
Practical experience with FPGA architecture and back-end implementation flows, including understanding of resource utilization, clock domain crossing, and design partitioning
Exposure to Xilinx or Altera synthesis tools is a plus, as is familiarity with Synopsys Prototyping or Emulation hardware and software
Experience with interface protocols like PCIe, AXI, UART, or I2C is a plus, particularly in the context of hardware-software integration
Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, or shell is desirable for automating workflows and analyzing log files
Who You Are
You can take a vague customer complaint like 'the compile is failing' and turn it into a specific, reproducible issue with enough detail that R&D can act on it
You stay calm when a customer is frustrated or under pressure, and you focus on solving the problem rather than defending the tool
You are comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple customer issues in parallel without losing track of who needs what by when
You do not mind digging through synthesis logs, waveform dumps, or FPGA utilization reports to find the root cause of a problem
You can explain a complex technical tradeoff, like why a design needs to be repartitioned or why certain optimizations are not possible, in a way that makes sense to someone who is not an FPGA expert
You are open to occasional travel for customer support, training, or onsite troubleshooting when remote support is not enough
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join Synopsys Technical Sales Group (TSG) as part of the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, working alongside expert-level field engineers who support customers globally on Zebu Emulation and Protocompiler Prototyping solutions. The team works closely with R&D and directly with customers at all stages of the emulation and prototyping cycle, from pre-sales evaluation through post-deployment support. You will collaborate with engineers across geographies and gain exposure to Synopsys HAV hardware platforms as part of your technical development.

jobs.title: Senior Applications Engineer (Functional Verification)
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent enough time in digital design or verification to know that the real work starts when something breaks in a way the documentation never mentioned. Debugging is not just a skill for you, it is how you think. You follow the signal, trace the logic, and figure out what actually happened versus what should have happened, and you can explain the difference to someone who was not there when it broke.
Working with customers does not intimidate you. You have learned that the best support is not about having every answer immediately, it is about asking the right questions, reproducing the issue, and staying with it until it makes sense. You know your way around Verilog or VHDL well enough to read someone else's RTL and spot where the problem might be hiding.
You are comfortable working across time zones with engineers in different locations, and you understand that being remote does not mean working in a vacuum. At Synopsys, you will be part of a global team supporting EDA tools that matter, and the work you do will directly affect how customers deploy and trust the products we build.

jobs.title: ASIC Digital Design (Functional safety), Sr. Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the space where hardware meets safety, and you know that a chip destined for an automotive system is not just about performance or power, it is about proving that when something goes wrong, the design catches it before it matters. You think in failure modes, diagnostic coverage, and safety mechanisms, not as compliance checkboxes but as engineering decisions that determine whether a product ships or gets recalled.
You have read ISO 26262 enough times that you can tell when a Technical Safety Concept is missing a dependency or when an FMEA is too shallow to survive an audit. You are comfortable sitting with RTL design architects who are sketching out a new IP block and asking the questions that surface safety gaps early, before RTL is written and before verification plans are locked. You do not wait for someone to hand you a safety requirement, you help shape it based on what the hardware can realistically deliver.
You have done the work. You have written safety analyses, reviewed fault injection results, defined safety mechanisms, and worked through assessor feedback without losing your patience or your clarity. At Synopsys, you will work on IP and SoC products where safety is not an afterthought, and where the rigor you bring will directly shape what our automotive customers can build.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive Functional Safety activities across ASIC IP and SoC development lifecycles, from early architecture through verification and release
Develop and review safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and safety work products in compliance with ISO 26262
Conduct safety analyses including FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis to identify and mitigate failure modes
Define, implement, and evaluate safety mechanisms at the IP, subsystem, and SoC level to meet diagnostic coverage and fault detection targets
Collaborate with Architecture, RTL Design, and Verification teams to integrate safety into design and validation workflows
Interface with customers, cross-functional teams, and external safety assessors to support audits, reviews, and certification activities
Document safety analyses, traceability matrices, and compliance evidence for internal reviews and external assessments
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys IP and SoC products to meet automotive safety standards and support customer certification timelines
Reduce late-stage design rework by identifying safety risks early in the architecture and design phases
Improve diagnostic coverage and fault detection capabilities across safety-critical semiconductor products
Strengthening customer confidence by delivering well-documented, auditable safety work products that pass assessor scrutiny
Influence hardware safety architectures that will be deployed in next-generation automotive systems
Build internal capability by mentoring design and verification engineers on Functional Safety principles and practices
Contribute to a culture where safety is embedded in engineering decisions, not bolted on at the end
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
2-4 years of experience in Functional Safety engineering, with a focus on automotive semiconductors, IP, or SoC development.
Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 standards, processes, and compliance requirements across hardware development lifecycles
Proven experience developing and reviewing safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and related safety work products
Hands-on experience in FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis methodologies
Experience defining and evaluating safety mechanisms, diagnostic coverage, and fault mitigation strategies at IP or SoC level
Understanding of semiconductor product development and verification flows, and the ability to work independently with cross-functional teams, customers, and assessors. Experience with automotive IPs, networking or communication IPs, or safety-critical products is a strong plus
Knowledge of CyberSecurity (ISO 21434) is a plus
Knowledge of any protocols such as I3C, AMBA, Ethernet, UFS, UNIPRO is a plus

You can walk into an architecture review and spot a safety gap that others miss, not because you are looking for problems but because you understand how failures propagate
You write safety analyses that are clear enough for an assessor to follow and detailed enough to survive a technical challenge from a design lead
You do not get stuck when requirements are incomplete or when a design decision has not been finalized, you work with what you have and flag what needs to be resolved

jobs.title: Hardware Security Analyst - Semiconductor IP
jobs.description:
We Are:
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are:
You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams and helps them do security work as part of normal delivery. You listen first, write in clear language, and own your conclusions. You work well with people in different disciplines and locations without needing to be the loudest person in the room.
You are practical when information is incomplete. You explain complex topics in simple terms, stay calm when the design changes, and challenge unclear choices in a respectful way. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving work that others can use.
This is a full-time role.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Lead threat analysis for semiconductor IP and associated firmware: identify assets, access points, threat scenarios, and attack paths, and recommend controls in the IP versus requirements for the integrator.
Run security analysis as part of the cybersecurity lifecycle, from planning through design, implementation, verification, and release.
Advise product teams on cybersecurity requirements, architecture, and verification so security work is built into the existing development flow.
Author customer-facing security integration guidance that describes the threat landscape, implemented controls, and how customers should integrate the IP.
Review RTL, architecture, and verification intent against secure-design principles; judge whether a claimed control is implemented and testable; capture integrator recommendations where needed.
Support in-field cybersecurity activities for the products you cover, including vulnerability assessment, incident analysis, and security advisories, working with product-team architects and corporate vulnerability response as required.
Facilitate working sessions with cybersecurity architects and design and verification leads; keep analysis consistent across similar IP classes.
Deliver analysis incrementally with product teams working in agile sprints: plan security work against the product backlog, adjust scope when the design changes, and keep evidence current at each milestone.
Use Python to automate analysis, transform inventories and threat-model data, and produce repeatable reports other analysts can run and review.
Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research, first drafts, consistency checks, and routine tasks without handing off ownership of findings.
Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track analysis and incident work, keep project documentation current, and version work products through merge requests and review.
The Impact You Will Have:
Give product teams threat analysis they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
Leave cybersecurity requirements and verification objectives that design and verification teams can execute.
Produce integration guidance that customers can follow without a security specialist in the room.
Strengthen the cybersecurity lifecycle for IP products so security work stays current as the design changes.
Improve consistency of analysis across similar IP classes through shared working sessions and clear written conclusions.
Help the organization respond to in-field issues with clear assessment and practical advisories.
Raise analysis throughput with Python and agentic workflows without lowering the quality of technical conclusions.
What You’ll Need:
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
Typically, 4 or more years in product cybersecurity, embedded security, digital design, digital verification, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on the required capabilities can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
Practical experience performing threat modeling or threat analysis and risk assessment on real products, not only training exercises.
Ability to identify assets, attackers, attack surfaces, and attack paths, and to map each path to a mitigation (in-product control or integration requirement).
Comfort working without a single known end-system: analysis must cover representative integration scenarios and state assumptions clearly.
Experience applying a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release.
Ability to turn threat-analysis results into requirements, design guidance, verification objectives, and release evidence.
Hands-on understanding of embedded systems: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, hardware/software interfaces, memory-mapped registers, boot and debug, and on-chip interconnects.
Ability to reason about hardware-rooted threats and firmware threats, and to read architecture, databooks, and interface specifications with the design team.
Hands-on proficiency as a digital designer or a digital verification engineer. Either path is sufficient.
Ability to read and discuss RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL), architecture, interfaces, and register maps with designers and verification leads.
Ability to judge whether a claimed cybersecurity control is implemented in the design and whether it is verifiable.
Experience delivering analysis or engineering work inside agile product teams, including re-scoping when product content changes.
Ability to write and maintain Python for analysis and automation. This is not a software-engineering role. Scripts should be readable and usable by other analysts.
Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.
Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard is helpful, as is analog or mixed-signal background, semiconductor IP product experience, vulnerability handling, or applied embedded cryptography.
Who You Are:
You build trust with design teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is difficult.
You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a tool, a template, or the loudest voice in the room.
You write clearly so engineers and customers can use your work without you in the room.
You work well with incomplete information and out-of-context IP, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend improvements teams can actually adopt.
You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as the design changes.
You are comfortable with agile change and re-scope analysis without waiting for a late gate.
The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
You will join the cybersecurity team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. As an analyst, you are assigned to IP product teams and work in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, and firmware engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to complete analysis, guidance, and evidence through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by product teams and by customers who integrate the IP.
Rewards and Benefits:
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months.
You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99.5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences.
At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter.
What You'll Be Doing
Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1149.6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success
The Impact You Will Have
Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
Expertise deploying IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149.6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy
Who You Are
You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
