jobs.title: Senior Layout Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Layout Design, Sr Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years translating analog circuit schematics into physical layouts that actually perform, not just pass DRC. You know that a GPIO layout is not just about routing metal, it is about understanding how a 2pF mismatch or a 10-micron shift can break ESD performance or skew I/O timing in ways the schematic never predicted. You think in cross-sections and current density maps, and you have learned to spot a latchup risk or a substrate coupling problem before it ever hits silicon.
You are comfortable sitting with a circuit designer who hands you a half-finished schematic and a set of constraints, and you know which questions to ask to turn that into a layout that meets area, performance, and reliability targets. Matching does not scare you, it is something you have done enough times to have opinions about dummy placement and orientation strategies. You have debugged parasitic extraction results at 2 a.m. and lived to tell the story.
Automation is not a nice-to-have for you, it is how you stay sane. You write scripts to check spacing rules, generate array structures, or pull reports because doing it manually fifteen times is not an option. At Synopsys, you will work on IO and analog IP that ships in real products, with a team that knows the difference between a layout that works and one that just closes.
What You'll Be Doing
Design and own full custom analog layouts for GPIO, specialty IO, and general-purpose analog IP blocks including I2C, I3C, SMBUS, eMMC, SVID, Quad SPI, and JTAG interfaces
Develop high-performance LVDS layouts and crystal oscillator circuits with attention to signal integrity, noise coupling, and parasitic management
Collaborate with circuit designers to translate schematics into physical implementations that meet area, performance, matching, and reliability specifications
Perform layout verification including DRC, LVS, and parasitic extraction analysis, iterating with design teams to close on performance targets
Build and maintain layout automation scripts to improve design efficiency, consistency, and quality across IP families
Provide technical guidance and layout reviews for junior engineers, helping them develop skills in analog matching, IO frame design, and technology-specific layout techniques
Work across global teams in the US, Europe, and Asia to align on design standards, schedules, and deliverables for multi-site IP development programs
The Impact You Will Have
Your layouts will directly enable GPIO and specialty IO performance in Synopsys IP that powers AI, automotive, and high-performance computing chips used by leading semiconductor companies
You will help reduce design cycle time and improve first-pass silicon success rates through high-quality layout and proactive parasitic management
The automation scripts and layout methodologies you develop will become reusable assets across multiple IP families and process nodes
Your technical reviews and mentorship will raise the skill level of the layout team and reduce costly respins caused by layout-induced performance issues
You will contribute to IP roadmaps by identifying layout-driven design constraints early, influencing architecture decisions before they become problems
The IO and analog blocks you design will ship in millions of devices, affecting real-world product performance and time to market for Synopsys customers
You will help establish layout best practices and design guidelines that scale across a global engineering organization
What You'll Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, VLSI Design, or equivalent practical experience
3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in analog or mixed-signal custom IC layout design
Strong understanding of CMOS layout fundamentals including device matching, parasitic effects, electromigration, latchup, and ESD protection strategies
Proficiency with industry-standard layout tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, or equivalent verification and extraction platforms
Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, or SKILL for layout automation and design checks
Experience with IO frame design, pad ring assembly, or specialty interface IP layout is a strong plus
Familiarity with parasitic extraction tools and the ability to interpret and act on R/C extraction results to meet circuit performance targets
Who You Are
You can sit in a layout review, spot a symmetry issue or a metal density violation in seconds, and explain the fix without needing to pull up the full design
You do not wait for perfect specs, you work with what circuit designers give you, ask clarifying questions about critical matching pairs or bias routing, and move forward
You treat layout as a craft, not a checklist, and you care about the difference between a layout that barely passes LVS and one that is actually manufacturable and reliable
You are comfortable working across time zones with teams in different geographies, coordinating handoffs and reviews without losing momentum
You are the person junior engineers come to when they are stuck on a tricky matching problem or cannot figure out why their extraction numbers are off, and you enjoy that role
You know when to escalate a layout-driven performance issue to the circuit designer and when to solve it yourself with a smarter floorplan or routing strategy
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will be part of a strong development team focused on GPIO, specialty IO, and general-purpose analog IP development. The team works on a range of interface IP including I2C, I3C, SMBUS, eMMC, SVID, Quad SPI, JTAG, high-performance LVDS, and crystal oscillators. You will collaborate closely with experienced engineers locally in Bangalore and across global sites, contributing to multi-site IP programs that serve customers worldwide.
Rewards and Benefits

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Memory Layout Design
jobs.description:
Memory Layout, Staff Engineer
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the trenches of custom layout, and somewhere along the way you realized the real leverage is not in drawing one more SRAM cell, it is in building the frameworks that let hundreds of those cells get generated correctly, verified automatically, and scaled to the next node without reinventing everything. You think in systems, not schematics. When you look at a new process node, you are already mapping out the design rules, the automation gaps, and the verification bottlenecks before anyone asks.
You are the engineer who gets called when a layout flow breaks at 3nm or when a compiler needs to scale and no one is sure how to get StarRC and Custom Compiler to play nicely together. You do not just script solutions, you architect them with an eye toward maintainability, reuse, and the next three nodes. You have strong opinions about what good automation looks like, and you are not afraid to push back when a methodology does not serve the people who will actually use it.
At Synopsys, you will define how next-generation embedded memory gets built, not by drawing it yourself, but by creating the infrastructure that makes it possible for teams across the company to do it faster, cleaner, and more reliably.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead technology studies and process entitlement evaluations for advanced nodes (FinFET, GAA) to define what is physically possible and translate that into actionable layout guidelines for embedded memory compiler teams
Architect and build layout automation frameworks using Python and TCL that generate, verify, and validate custom memory IP layouts at scale, not one-off scripts but production infrastructure
Develop and maintain automated physical verification flows integrating Synopsys Custom Compiler, StarRC for parasitic extraction, and Ansys Totem for EM/IR reliability analysis across memory compiler products
Author and document physical implementation design rules, best practices, and layout methodologies that become the standard for how SRAM, ROM, and register file compilers are built and scaled
Evaluate next-generation EDA tools and capabilities, working directly with vendors and internal teams to define what gets adopted, how it gets integrated, and what productivity gains are realistic
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to layout development teams, troubleshooting complex verification failures, flow bottlenecks, and tool integration issues that block progress
Collaborate with foundry partners on design-technology co-optimization, feeding real-world layout constraints and automation needs back into process development discussions
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys memory compiler teams to scale to next-generation nodes faster by defining clear, automated methodologies that eliminate guesswork and rework
Reduce time-to-market for embedded memory IP by building verification and extraction flows that catch issues early and run without manual intervention
Improve layout productivity across the organization by delivering automation tools and infrastructure that teams actually use and trust
Influence foundry roadmaps and EDA tool development by representing real custom layout challenges and methodology needs in co-optimization discussions
Establish the technical standard for how advanced memory architectures are physically implemented, verified, and delivered at Synopsys
Mentor and elevate layout engineers by providing them with better tools, clearer guidelines, and a methodology framework that scales with their work
Drive reliability and quality improvements by automating EM/IR analysis and parasitic extraction in ways that surface problems before tapeout
What You'll Need
8+ years of hands-on experience in custom IC layout methodology, EDA automation, or physical design enablement, with a strong focus on embedded memory architectures like SRAM, ROM, or register files
Deep proficiency in Python and TCL for building production-grade layout automation tools, verification flows, and EDA infrastructure, not just scripting but software development
Extensive experience developing and deploying automated physical verification flows using Synopsys Custom Compiler, StarRC, Ansys Totem, or equivalent industry-standard tools
Solid understanding of advanced process nodes (FinFET, GAA, 5nm and below) and the ability to translate complex foundry design rules into engineering guidelines and automation requirements
Strong working knowledge of DRC/LVS/Antenna checking, EM/IR drop analysis, and parasitic extraction methodologies in the context of full-custom layout
Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with a focus on EDA or layout methodology
Experience collaborating with foundry teams on design-technology co-optimization or familiarity with AI/ML frameworks for automating engineering tasks is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can walk into a room with a process design kit and walk out with a methodology roadmap that accounts for layout complexity, tool limitations, and team bandwidth
When a verification flow fails in a way no one has seen before, you do not escalate immediately, you dig into the tool logs, reproduce the issue, and figure out what broke and why
You write automation code that other engineers can actually read, maintain, and extend six months later without needing you to explain every function
You have a point of view on what good layout methodology looks like and you are comfortable defending it in a room full of senior engineers who may not agree
You can explain a complex tradeoff between layout density, verification runtime, and EM reliability to a product manager in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
You stay current on EDA tool capabilities, process technology trends, and automation techniques because you know that what worked at 7nm will not necessarily work at 3nm
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join the Memory Layout Methodology and Automation team in Noida, a group responsible for defining how embedded memory compilers are physically implemented, verified, and scaled across Synopsys IP products. This is a technical leadership role where your work directly shapes the infrastructure and guidelines that memory development teams rely on to deliver next-generation SRAM, ROM, and register file IP to customers.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:

Staff Engineer – Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST)
About Yugabyte
At Yugabyte, we are on a mission to become the default transactional database for enterprises building cloud-native applications. YugabyteDB is our PostgreSQL compatible distributed database for cloud-native apps. Resilient, scalable, and flexible, it runs on any cloud and enables developers to become instantly productive using well-known APIs.We are looking for talented and driven people to join us on our ambitious mission and help us build a lasting and impactful company.The transactional database market is estimated to grow to $150B by 2030. YugabyteDB is cloud-native by design, has on-demand horizontal scalability, and supports geographical distribution of data using built-in replication. This means that we are well-positioned to meet market demand for geo-distributed, high-scale, high-performance workloads.
Yugabyte offers a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence, with opportunities to impact a cutting-edge distributed SQL database used by global enterprises. As a member of the DST team, you’ll help meet growing demand for high-scale, high-performance, globally distributed transactional workloads — instrumental to our product’s success.
Role Overview
As a Staff Engineer on the Distributed Storage & Transactions (DST) team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the core distributed storage, replication, and transaction foundations of YugabyteDB.
You will work on some of the most challenging problems in distributed systems — including consistency, durability, fault tolerance, performance, and scalability — while collaborating closely with query layer, platform, and cloud teams. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in low-level systems work and want to shape the future of a globally distributed database.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, testing, and delivery of core storage and replication features in YugabyteDB.
Write high-quality C/C++ code with comprehensive automated tests; actively participate in design discussions and code reviews.
Troubleshoot and resolve correctness, stability, and performance issues in complex distributed storage and transactional subsystems.
Improve database scalability and throughput as cluster sizes, data volumes, and transaction rates continue to grow.
Build and streamline database management operations, including:
Horizontal cluster scale-out
Incremental and point-in-time backups
Online schema and index operations
Rolling upgrades and blue-green deployments
Identify and implement performance improvements across the storage engine, transaction processing, and replication layers.
Contribute to the open-source YugabyteDB project, helping evolve its storage architecture and operational reliability.
Mentor and technically influence other engineers in distributed systems design, performance engineering, and systems-level debugging.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in systems programming using C/C++.
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science (or related field), or equivalent practical experience.
Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including:
Replication and consensus
Transactions and consistency models
Fault tolerance and recovery
Experience working on storage engines, databases, or other infrastructure-level systems.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, distributed team environment
Preferred Skills
Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems, transactional engines, or consensus protocols.
Familiarity with LSM-tree based storage engines, WALs, snapshots, or compaction strategies.
Experience with PostgreSQL internals or other relational database engines is a strong plus.
Prior contributions to open-source systems or database projects.

Job Description:
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. In this role you’ll have the opportunity to develop massively scalable solutions to solve complex data problems using Hadoop, NiFi, Spark and related Big Data technology. This role is a client facing opportunity that combines consulting skills with deep technical design and development in the Big Data space. This role will present the successful candidate the opportunity to travel across Asia Pacific and across multiple industries and large customer organisations.
As the Senior Solutions Architect you will:
Work directly with customer business and technical teams to understand requirements and develop high quality solutions
Design highly scalable and reliable data pipelines to consume, integrate, and analyze large amounts of data from various sources.
Able to understand big data use-cases and recommend standard design, implementation patterns used in Hadoop-based deployments
Able to document and present complex architectures for the customer’s technical teams
Work closely with Cloudera teams at all levels to ensure project and customer success

Design, build, tune and maintain data pipelines using Hadoop, NiFi or related data integration technologies
Install, deploy, augment, upgrade, manage and operate large Hadoop clusters
Write and produce technical documentation, customer status reports and knowledge-base articles
Keep up with current Hadoop, NiFi, Big Data ecosystem / technologies.

Overall 12+ years IT experience, with at least 4+ years of production experience working with Hadoop and/or NiFi, data engineering.

Experience setting up multi-node Hadoop clusters

Ability to understand and translate customer requirements into technical requirements
Excellent verbal and written communications

An overview of this role
As a Benefits Analyst on GitLab's Total Rewards team, you'll support global benefits administration and take ownership of day-to-day benefits operations in India, partnering closely with a Senior Benefits Analyst. Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. This role reports to the Manager, Global Benefits and focuses on benefits programs, not leave administration. You'll need to be based in Bangalore, with periodic office presence for hosting and managing benefits events, and flexibility to collaborate across time zones, including Pacific time.
What You’ll Do  
Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.
Review benefits and team-member data from multiple sources, research discrepancies and root causes, and recommend next steps for manager or senior team-member review.
Work with brokers and vendors on day-to-day benefits operations, and support the Senior Benefits Analyst with renewals, plan changes, implementations, testing, launches, and post-launch improvements. Benefits plan decisions remain with the Senior Benefits Analyst.

Partner with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, and People Technology on accurate reporting, billing reconciliation, eligibility data, and compliance-related processes.
Support People Operations in resolving team-member benefits inquiries, explain moderately complex benefits topics in accessible language, and escalate cases appropriately.
Analyze benefits utilization, cost, survey, and qualitative data to identify trends and prepare summaries, insights, and recommendations that support team priorities.
Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. Protect accuracy and team-member experience, communicate progress and risks, and seek guidance on prioritizing improvements.
What You’ll Bring 
Experience supporting benefits administration, including enrollment, reporting, and audits, and working with benefits brokers or vendors. Experience supporting benefits in more than one country is required; global technology company experience is preferred. Strategic benefits plan design experience isn't required.
Working knowledge of core benefits concepts, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits.
Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.
Intermediate or stronger Excel or Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUPs, filters, pivot tables, and data analysis; macros aren't required. Ability to evaluate multiple sources, identify patterns or discrepancies, and develop evidence-based recommendations with appropriate guidance.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.
Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.
A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.
Ability to be based in Bangalore and go to our Bangalore hub to host and manage benefits events, with flexibility for collaboration across time zones, including Pacific time.
About the team
The Benefits team within Total Rewards supports global benefits programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. You'll work closely with the Senior Benefits Analyst and colleagues in India, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Pacific time zones to support India's growing benefits needs. The team's tools include Workday, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. The role emphasizes accurate administration, team-member support, and practical process improvements, with opportunities to build deeper benefits expertise.

You’ll report to the Senior Manager or Director, Nonlinear Productivity and work at the intersection of engineering, developer productivity, AI-assisted development, and product. You’ll build a data-backed view of where technical interventions can have the highest leverage, test solutions through prototypes, drive validated fixes into internal adoption, and help build the case for productizing the strongest outcomes.
What you’ll do
Survey GitLab’s internal software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows to identify structural friction early, and build a data-backed view of where technical interventions will have the highest leverage.
Evaluate build, buy, and adapt options for each opportunity, including emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability.
Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment.
Hire and manage a small, high-caliber team, or operate as a hands-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount.
Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained.
Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product.
Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don’t remain tribal knowledge.
Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.
What you’ll bring
Ability to use GitLab.
A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned.
Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down.
People management experience, including in a small-team or working-manager capacity.
Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them.
Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers.
Familiarity with agentic or AI-assisted development tooling.
Experience moving an internal tool toward an external, customer-facing product is advantageous.
About the team
The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. We test and scale durable technical fixes that improve our internal engineering output. 
Career ladder
In this role, you can progress to Senior Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, with an expanded mandate across the full set of team metrics we use to track improvement.

An overview of this role
Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.
In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.
What you'll do
Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.
What you'll bring
Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.
Nice to have:  Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.
About the team
The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.
What you’ll do
Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.

Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.
Helpful experience
Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.
Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.

Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
Improving service accounts and secure automation

Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.
What you'll bring
Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.
Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. 
Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.
Some examples of the projects you could work on:
Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)
Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure
What You’ll Do
Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.
What You’ll Bring
Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.
Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.
Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.

GitLab Platform Proficiency: Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.

This person should be comfortable reading code, writing examples, building demos, running benchmarks, explaining architecture tradeoffs, profiling workloads, and translating developer feedback into useful product input.

Build and execute a technical Developer Relations strategy to grow NVIDIA platform adoption across AI Labs in India.
Develop trusted relationships with founders, CTOs, ML researchers, ML infrastructure teams, platform leaders, and developer communities.
Identify and accelerate high-value workloads such as foundation model training, fine-tuning, speech AI, retrieval augmented generation, multimodal AI, inference optimization, and production model serving.
Assess which AI Lab workloads are a strong fit for GPU acceleration by profiling bottlenecks and distinguishing compute-bound problems from memory-bound, IO-bound, network-bound, or orchestration-bound issues.
Build and adapt technical demos, sample code, notebooks, benchmark plans, reference architectures, and performance guides.
Run deep technical workshops, code labs, architecture reviews, office hours, developer sessions, technical webinars, and executive briefings.
Work hands-on with developers to debug integration issues, profile workloads, improve inference performance, and identify the right NVIDIA software stack for each use case.
Explain why similar model workloads may perform differently across labs due to model architecture, data pipeline design, batch size, latency targets, storage/network behavior, software stack, or deployment environment.
Capture developer feedback, technical blockers, competitive insights, and product requirements for NVIDIA product and engineering teams.

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience and 8+ years of experience in technical Developer Relations, ML engineering, AI platforms, model infrastructure, cloud platforms, solution architecture, or startup technical engagement.
Strong understanding of generative AI, deep learning, machine learning, model lifecycle, inference serving, model optimization, distributed training, and MLOps.

Ability to profile and reason about AI workloads, including GPU suitability, compute intensity, memory bandwidth, IO bottlenecks, network constraints, latency, throughput, batching, and cost/performance tradeoffs.
Ability to engage both deeply technical developers and senior business stakeholders, with credibility in whiteboarding, live demos, technical troubleshooting, and architecture reviews.

Complete ownership of verification and end to end analysis of sophisticated full chip gate level custom designs with advanced low power and power management technologies spread across multiple categories such as DDR4,LPDDR4,DDR5 and LPDDR5 that can operate at high speeds of up to 6400MT/s.

Good communication skills and ability to work well in a team
Guide new team members and energetic engineers in the team

Experience in SystemVerilog, PLI coding

Experience in AMS verification and co-sim

jobs.description:

Job Summary
The Planner will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling integrated project schedules in line with approved planning methodologies. The role involves critical path analysis, progress monitoring, variance and delay analysis, and preparation of insightful planning reports to support management decision-making. The Planner will closely coordinate with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure schedule integrity, identify risks, and propose recovery strategies to achieve project milestones.
Roles and Responsibilities
1. Develop and maintain project schedules based on defined planning methodology, including schedule basis, assumptions, exclusions, and coding structures.
2. Establish and manage schedule baselines in alignment with contract requirements and project controls standards.
3. Perform Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis and continuously monitor critical and near-critical activities.
4. Conduct delay analysis, impact assessments, and evaluate schedule changes and claims.
5. Propose schedule crashing, fast-tracking, and recovery strategies to mitigate delays and support milestone achievement.
6. Perform schedule variance analysis against baseline and previous updates, identifying root causes and trends.
7. Prepare and present weekly and monthly planning reports highlighting progress, risks, critical path movement, productivity, and recovery recommendations.
8. Lead and facilitate schedule review workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders.
9. Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams to ensure realistic and achievable schedules.
10. Validate contractor schedules, progress updates, and reports, identifying discrepancies and non-compliances.
11. Support management with planning insights, scenario analysis, and forecast completion assessments.
12. Ensure compliance with project planning standards, contractual requirements, and reporting protocols.
13. Prepare executive level presentations and dashboards
14. Should have good working knowledge of using AI agents like Copilot, Claude, etc. and should demonstrate application of the same in day-to-day job
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Civil / Electrical / Industrial or relevant discipline).
• Certification in Project Planning / Project Management (Primavera P6, PMP, PSP, or equivalent) is preferred.
• Certification in Power BI/ Tableau preferred
Experience
• 7+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling within EPC, industrial construction, semiconductor fabs, infrastructure, or large-scale projects.
Technical Skills & Proficiency
• Strong proficiency in Primavera P6 (mandatory).
• Working knowledge of MS Project, Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), and PowerPoint.
• Experience in developing schedule basis documents, WBS, and coding structures.
• Expertise in Critical Path Analysis (CPM), delay analysis, and recovery planning techniques.
• Understanding of productivity measurement, progress curves (S-curves), and forecasting.
• Familiarity with contract scheduling requirements and claim support documentation.
• Experience in developing BI Dashboards (preferred)
• Working knowledge of using AI tools like Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.

ARP evaluates whether internal platforms are “agentic-ready” for end-to-end AI agent development. Its evaluation engine normalizes top use cases, spawns agents in virtualized environments, executes their plans, automatically files issues for friction points (such as missing docs or APIs), and re-runs checks on every CI/CD deploy to prevent regressions. This role sits on the Core Platform Framework team, which builds the evaluation platform and seeks research-minded engineers focused on agent orchestration and LLM tooling, distinct from the Operations/Adoption team.

Core platform architecture: build and evolve the virtualization/harness layer, the agent plan-then-execute engine, and the friction detection and auto-ticketing pipeline.

Telemetry and auditability: build scalable logging, cost and telemetry systems so every agent run is fully auditable and cost-accountable.
Use-case normalization: contribute to technical standards that make use cases agent-readable across differently documented capability platforms.
Cross-team collaboration: partner with capability, operations and adjacent platform teams on friction reporting, PRD-to-action pipelines, RAG-backed architecture context and OPA policy validation.

7+ years of software engineering experience, focused on distributed systems or developer platforms.
Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent systems: orchestration loops, tool use, plan-and-execute patterns.
Strong systems programming background (Python, Java) with virtualization, sandboxing or IaC experience.
Proficiency in Python, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL and React.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions
Hyderabad / Chennai
At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
As a Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments.
The Opportunity
Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence.
Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock.
Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies.
Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims
External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view
Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support.
Who You Are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred.
Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement): You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each:
Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics
EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources
Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so
Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics
Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data
Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs
Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting
Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group)
Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data
Therapeutic Area Exposure: Demonstrated exposure to either of Oncology (solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways), Ophthalmology (Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or CVRM (cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights
Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You are an early-career engineer ready to make your mark in semiconductor design. You have spent your academic years drawn to digital design that requires proof, not just simulation. When you see a spec, you think about corner cases and what could break. You have written Verilog or SystemVerilog, debugged logic that did not behave as expected, and you are comfortable in a Unix terminal. Formal verification might be new to you, but the rigor makes sense. You learn by doing, ask questions when stuck, and you do not mind being the person who finds the bug everyone else missed.
What You'll Be Doing
Learn the latest formal verification methodology from experts and apply your learnings to live projects.
Work with a team of seasoned FV engineers and execute validation as per defined plans.
Support quality improvements and contribute insights that help enhance verification tool capabilities.
Write and refine assertions in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to capture design intent and uncover edge-case failures.
Script verification flows using Python, Perl, or Tcl to automate repetitive tasks and improve team productivity in Unix/Linux environments.
The Impact You Will Have
Help catch critical design bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months and millions to fix in silicon.
Contribute to the quality and reliability of Synopsys IP and EDA tools that power semiconductor development across the industry.
Accelerate verification closure on complex designs by applying formal methods that simulation alone cannot cover.
Strengthen the formal verification methodology at Synopsys by bringing fresh perspectives and identifying gaps in existing flows.
What You'll Need
Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline. (2026 Fresh Masters Grad Expected).
0 to 2 years of experience in digital design, verification, or related semiconductor work (internships, projects, and coursework count).
Strong understanding of computer architecture and digital design fundamentals including state machines, pipelining, and timing.
Hands-on experience with hardware description languages, Verilog or SystemVerilog preferred.
Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Tcl, and comfort working in Unix or Linux environments.
Solid academic performance with relevant coursework or project work in VLSI, digital design, or verification.
Experience with formal verification tools, assertion languages, or model checking is a strong plus.
Who You Are
You can look at a block diagram or RTL code and start asking the right questions about what could go wrong, not just what is supposed to work.
You are comfortable learning new tools and methodologies on the job without needing everything explained upfront, you read documentation, try things, and ask targeted questions when you are stuck.
You communicate clearly when you find something, whether it is a bug, a gap in coverage, or a script that is not working the way it should.
You are detail-oriented enough to track down a single-bit logic error in a complex design without losing sight of what the block is supposed to do.
The Team You'll Be Part Of
You will join a focused team at Synopsys dedicated to advancing formal verification methodologies and delivering proven IP and EDA solutions. You will collaborate with experienced formal verification engineers and design experts who are committed to pushing the boundaries of what formal methods can achieve. The team values rigorous thinking, continuous learning, and clear communication, creating an environment where your growth is supported.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

ROLE
Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration.
This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES
• Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent.
• Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions.
• Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features.
• Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions.
• Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies.
Proven ability to leverage AI‑assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level.
• Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following:
Mixed-signal verification
Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
Post-silicon validation and characterization
Memory validation
• Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations.
• Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments.
• Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results.
• Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python.
• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration.
• Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies.
• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

jobs.description:

As an Electrical Design Engineer in the Systems Integration Group (SIG) of Micron Technology, Inc, you will design load boards that support semiconductor memory manufacturing, as well as resolve issues with and develop improvements to deployed automated test equipment (ATE) products.
Load boards, used for testing memory devices after they are manufactured & packaged, are the contact interface between ATE and pins of the device under test (DUT). Load boards contain the necessary components to:
setup the DUT for correct testing by the ATE;
route power, test, and response signals between the DUT and the ATE;
provide additional test capabilities that the ATE may not be able to provide; and,
alternately, testing or calibrate the ATE itself.
Load board design considerations, like other PCB assemblies, include DC power supply distribution, clock & digital routing, and high-speed signal integrity. You will apply circuit theory to design load board solutions working closely with other team members located around the world that include other engineering disciplines, technicians, procurement, planning, and external contract manufacturers.

Develop requirements specifications

Incident investigation and corrective / preventive actions.
Risk elimination, improvising engineering, and administrative controls.
Establish and maintain EHS training, communication, and document control process/ program.
Write technical reports based on the interpretation of EHS data, observations, and current regulations regarding inspection findings and recommend corrective actions.
Driving the organization towards best-known/best-in-class EHS practices.

Using Artificial Intelligence for safety initiatives.

Risk-based decision making
Strong stakeholder coordination (Construction, Operations, Facilities, Contractors)
Incident investigation and problem-solving
Leadership in safety culture development
Strong problem-solving skills, good analytical skills & experience in writing reports &
Excellent communication skills and good team working skills, Self-motivated.
Strong ability in English speaking and writing, be able to communicate with English speaking engineers both verbally and by writing.

The Position
About the Role
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Full-Stack AI Engineer / Data Scientist with a deep sense of ownership. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. You will build agentic generative AI systems and classical ML systems end-to-end, taking accountability from concept and exploratory data analysis all the way to production releases and monitoring.
Core Tech Stack & Scope
This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent-to-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) alongside vector, graph, and traditional databases to develop scalable and robust AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic & GenAI Application Development:
Design and build advanced AI agentic systems, state machines, search-based conversational systems that solve complex business problems.
Develop workflows leveraging Large Foundational Multimodal Models to process and reason across text, audio, and video modalities.
Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients to standardize context exchange between agents, data sources, and external tools.
Collaborate with AI Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers to integrate AI capabilities into scalable, fair, and ethical end-user applications focusing on relevance and real-time performance.
Full-Stack Engineering & Agentic SDLC:
Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) daily to accelerate full-stack development cycles, maintaining high productivity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks.
Take end-to-end accountability for features: write high-quality, production-ready Python (and occasionally TypeScript) code with comprehensive testing and documentation.
Manage the DevOps/MLOps lifecycle: containerize applications using Docker, configure CI/CD pipelines, and architect high-throughput, reliable cloud-native solutions on AWS/multicloud.
Data Science, EDA & Strategy:
Perform thorough Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand dataset characteristics, uncover patterns, detect biases, and identify data quality issues.
Use statistical and visualization techniques to inform feature engineering, model selection, and optimization of foundation model-based applications.
Design robust data pipelines to curate, preprocess, and structure diverse datasets that maximize LLM effectiveness and reduce bias.
Algorithm Development & Optimization:
Design, customize, optimize, and fine-tune LLM-based and traditional AI algorithms for specific use cases (e.g., text generation, summarization, AI agents, sequence modeling).
Lead advanced prompt engineering strategies, utilizing zero-shot, few-shot and other paradigms to optimize model outputs without extensive fine-tuning.
Implement pre-generative AI models (e.g., classification, clustering, regression) when they provide a more efficient, interpretable, or cost-efficient solution compared to LLMs.
Optimize model inference speed, reduce latency (cold start reduction, caching strategies), and manage resource usage across cloud architectures.
Evaluation, Observability & Continuous Improvement:
Conduct rigorous experimentation (A/B testing) and implement automatic metric pipelines (e.g. BLEU/ROUGE, RAG retrieval accuracy, human rating frameworks, etc.) to evaluate generative and multimodal systems.
Implement real-time algorithms monitoring and observability practices, ensuring visibility into pipelines behavior, drift detection, and anomaly identification using telemetry tools.
Translate complex technical results into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, driving data-driven decision-making.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and Data Science, with exposure to generative AI, agents and classical ML.
3+ years of hands-on experience with generative large language models and agents.
Proven experience managing the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle and deploying models at scale.
Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents within an agentic SDLC to accelerate feature delivery.
Skills:
Must-have:
Expert Python: Advanced production-grade proficiency in Python.
Cloud Platforms: Practical experience designing cloud solutions on AWS (familiarity with multicloud is a plus), utilizing GenAI-specific services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker).
AI/GenAI Frameworks: Deep expertise with LangChain, LangGraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic system design, and state machine logic.
Building production-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end-users, integrations, etc., but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs.
Software Engineering Best Practices: Expertise in API design, CI/CD, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and rigorous automated testing.
aSDLC expertise: Proven experience in leveraging agents for SDLC (software development lifecycle).
Databases: Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and data lakes.
Data Skills: Strong background in statistics, data manipulation, synthetic data generation, and feature engineering.
Should-have:
Could-have:
Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage - to have a common language with the full-stack Software Engineers.
Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent analytical skills to tackle complex engineering and statistical challenges.
Ownership & Leadership: Deep sense of accountability, eager to define architectural patterns, and able to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary.
Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems.
Ethics: Strong understanding of biases, fairness, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI deployment.

Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., Ph.D., or equivalent in Computer Science, Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
Be deeply passionate about AI, staying continuously up-to-date with the latest developments in foundational models, agentic approaches, and classical ML.

Be a great communicator, able to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+.

Agile Requirements & Product Owner Support (60% Focus):
Manage the full AI project lifecycle from opportunity identification through deployment and value realization.
Translate business goals into prioritized product backlogs, Epics, and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Define MVP/MMR strategies to iteratively deliver business value while managing project risks.
Act as a Proxy PO when necessary, making critical decisions on prioritization and sprint goals.
