Design and optimize LLM prompts to ensure accurate, secure, and relevant model outputs.
Prototype agentic workflows and evaluate model responses using Python scripting and SQL data exploration.
Develop specifications for dynamic Generative UI components and RAG pipeline context mappings.
Requirements Engineering & Business Process Analysis:
Lead requirements workshops and JAD sessions to elicit business and functional specifications.
Author standard-compliant artifacts including URS, FRS, and "as-is/to-be" process maps.
Conduct gap analyses and re-engineering assessments to optimize and automate manual workflows.
GxP Compliance, Computerized System Validation (CSV) & Software Assurance (CSA):
Guide compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments following GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Annex 11.
Guide risk-based CSA/CSV activities, authoring risk assessments (FMEA), trace matrices, and validation reports.
Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) and system classifications to preserve validated states.
AI Governance, Risk Management & Observability Specifications:
Ensure governance guardrails, escalation triggers, and observability requirements for agentic AI systems are applied.
Assess AI-specific risks (drift, leakage, tool misuse) and formulate TCO/ROI business cases.
Change Control, ITSM & Configuration Management:
Manage formal Change Requests (RFC) and present impact analyses to CAB/ECAB boards.
Maintain system configuration documentation and audit-readiness for internal and regulatory inspections.
Audit Readiness & Operational Support:
Act as IT SME during audits, presenting validation evidence and requirements engineering practices.
Author SOPs, manuals, and training materials to support business readiness and operational transitions.
Practical Skills Required
Experience:
8+ years of IT Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise-scale software solutions, system integrations, and business processes.
5+ years of experience in highly regulated environments, with a strong preference for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, or clinical healthcare sectors.
3+ years of proven experience in Agile/Scrum product delivery, with demonstrated success managing product backlogs, writing detailed User Stories, and supporting agile ceremonies.
Hands-on AI/LLM Project Experience: Experience working directly on Generative AI or machine learning projects, supporting data preparation, prompt development, or AI application testing.
Proven track record of delivering computerized system validation or software assurance under industry-standard quality guidelines and electronic records regulations.
Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional, globally distributed engineering squads (including developers, architects, QA, and validation teams).
Agentic Workflow / aSDLC Experience: Proven experience leveraging AI productivity tools and writing/coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot) daily to accelerate elicitation, business process mapping, and requirements generation within an agentic software development lifecycle.
Skills
Must-have:
Advanced Requirements Lifecycle Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in elicitation, specification, modeling, verification, and traceability.
LLM Prompt Engineering & AI Prototyping: Proficient in designing, evaluating, and refining prompts for large language models. Ability to construct robust system prompts and templates that control model outputs and behavior.
Technical & Data Literacy (Analysis & Logical Assessment): Advanced ability to analyze complex data structures, logically assess AI model outputs, and trace data lineage. Strong technical aptitude to interpret technical specifications and evaluate system behaviors, with a focus on data-driven decision-making rather than hands-on coding or scripting.
Regulatory & Quality Expertise: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of industry-standard regulatory and quality protocols, software validation and quality assurance standards, and global guidelines for electronic records and digital signatures.
Process Modeling & Visualization: Advanced skills in process mapping, business workflow design, and data flow diagramming using tools like Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN engines.
Business Case & Financial Analysis: Experience conducting financial analyses, cost-benefit modeling, and calculating the total cost of ownership for enterprise platforms.
Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Outstanding active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build consensus across conflicting viewpoints, push back on unrealistic business requests, and translate between "business speak" and "tech speak."
Should-have
Agile Product Ownership Capability: Strong product thinking and backlog management capabilities using JIRA and Confluence. Ability to confidently step in as a Proxy PO when necessary to define MVPs, prioritize backlogs, and drive sprint goals.
AI/ML and Agentic Architecture Familiarity: Broad understanding of LLM architectures, RAG/GraphRAG concepts, multi-agent frameworks, and vector/graph databases to effectively analyze requirements for advanced AI projects.
IT Service Management (ITSM): Solid understanding of ITIL-based change management, incident management, and CMDB architectures.
Testing and QA Partnership: Experience partnering with QA to review test plans, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and verify test coverage using Requirements Traceability Matrices.
Agentic SDLC: Strong drive to apply agentic Software Development Lifecycle practices and tools.
Could-have:
Professional Certifications: International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) credentials such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or CCBA; Project Management Institute (PMI-PBA) or Scrum Alliance (CSPO/PO) certifications.
Multicloud Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud service models (AWS/Azure) and cloud-native application deployments.
Capabilities:
Problem-Solving Skills: Dissect complex, ambiguous, and abstract business challenges into manageable, structured, and verifiable functional requirements.
Ownership & Decisiveness: High-ownership mindset with the confidence to make tough priority decisions, remove development roadblocks, and step in to lead product direction as a Proxy PO when necessary.
Consulting & Trust: Ability to serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, QA leads, and engineering teams, translating seamlessly between clinical business speak and technical developer speak.
Ethics & Empathy: Deep commitment to patient safety, product quality, data security, and ethical AI deployment, backed by a strong user-centric design approach.

Have a strong understanding of both AI applications and traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with emerging digital trends, software architectures, prompt engineering, and validation practices.
Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative, with a proven ability to thrive in a high-velocity, fluid, and multidisciplinary agile environment where roles are fluid.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
External Job Ad Text
Job description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems.
As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
Job Responsibilities
Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy.
Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends.
Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices.
Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases.
Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring.
Qualifications
Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies.
Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents.
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases).
Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements.
Education / Experience
Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications.
Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery.
Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams.
Skills
Must-have:
Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces.
End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines.
Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle.
Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy.
Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics.
Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments.
Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement.
Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications.
Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems.
Should-have:
Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services.
Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub).
Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications.
Could-have:
Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries.
Additional Qualifications
Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations.
Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+.
Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
Shift: CET time zone

Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
The Opportunity
Engagement Delivery
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
Your work will include but will not be limited to:
understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate
Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
Actively managing your project management upskilling
Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues
Who you are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience
Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching.
Experience in project management financials and resource management

Customer centricity
Collaborative ways of working
Presentation and influencing skills
Business acumen & systems thinking

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
Job Responsibilities
Team Management
Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment.
Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work.
Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members.
Capability Development & Resource Management:
Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it.
Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution.

You Are:
You are a visionary change leader passionate about ushering in a new era of digital finance. Serving as the Model Builder SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.
Gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements.

Participating in data integration and migration solutions.

Monitoring data flows to and from source systems to ensure all data is up-to-date and accurate.

Driving transformative change in Synopsys' collaborative planning and forecasting processes.
Enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of financial planning and reporting.
Contributing to the global finance function's strategy, process, system, structural, and behavioural changes.

Improving data integration and migration solutions to ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.

Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modelling skills.
Experience with multi-dimensional or cube-based planning and reporting tools.
Strong understanding of business processes.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion.
Proven record of career progression with increasing levels of responsibility.
Experience in a fast-changing, fast-paced environment.
Excellent teamwork skills, including the ability to interact with all organization levels.

This opportunity sits within the Centre of Excellence’s Transformation Team, focused on reshaping the future of Finance at Synopsys. We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Senior/Staff ESSD Validation Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will be responsible for validating Micron NAND-based SSD systems and solutions by developing test strategies, test plans, test cases, and automation frameworks that ensure industry-leading product quality and reliability. You will work closely with firmware, hardware, systems, product engineering, and customer teams to verify SSD functionality, performance, interoperability, and customer qualification requirements.
The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of SSD architecture, NVMe/PCIe technologies, storage systems, and validation methodologies, along with a passion for automation and AI-enabled engineering practices. Key Responsibilities
Define and execute validation test plans, test cases, and automation content for SSD firmware validation.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts covering functional, system-level, performance, reliability, and customer qualification requirements.
Validate SSD firmware against NVMe, PCIe, OCP Cloud SSD, and customer-specific specifications.
Work closely with firmware, hardware, and system engineering teams to identify, debug, and resolve product issues.
Analyze test results, identify product quality risks, and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
Review, track, document, and communicate validation findings, defects, and project status.
Drive issues to closure by collaborating with cross-functional development and engineering teams.
Support customer qualification activities and reproduce customer-reported issues when required.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in validation methodologies, automation, and execution efficiency.
Communicate validation plans, status, technical concerns, and recommendations to project stakeholders.
Work effectively in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction while managing multiple priorities.

Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity in test development, debugging, data analysis, and reporting.Leverage Generative AI tools for script development, test case creation, log analysis, documentation generation, and knowledge discovery.
Identify opportunities to automate validation workflows, failure triage, and repetitive engineering tasks using AI-enabled solutions.
Apply data-driven techniques and AI-based insights to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and issue identification.
Follow responsible AI practices, ensuring compliance with company policies, data privacy, security, and governance requirements.
Continuously learn and adopt emerging AI technologies that enhance engineering productivity and quality.
Experience
4–10 years of experience in Embedded Firmware, Storage Systems, SSD Validation, or related engineering fields. Prior experience in SSD Firmware Validation is highly desirable. Experience integrating tests into automated test environments and supporting continuous validation frameworks. Ability to analyze failures, drive root-cause investigations, and collaborate across teams to resolve issues. Experience reviewing, documenting, tracking, and communicating test results and product sightings. Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

Education
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of SSD architecture, NVMe, PCIe, and enterprise storage technologies.
Good understanding of storage system interactions involving CPU, Memory, PCIe, Drivers, Operating Systems, and Firmware.
Strong programming and scripting skills in Python.
Hands-on Linux and Windows operating system debugging experience.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks.
AI & Data-Driven Engineering Skills
Demonstrated ability to use AI-powered productivity tools to enhance engineering efficiency and decision-making.
Understanding of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and practical AI applications in software and validation engineering.
Experience utilizing AI tools for code generation, debugging assistance, test content creation, and technical documentation is a plus.
Ability to assess and validate AI-generated outputs for technical correctness before use.
Understanding of responsible AI practices, data security, privacy, and compliance considerations.
Professional Skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Effective project planning, execution, and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work across diverse engineering teams.
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of operating in ambiguous environments.
Team player with a passion for innovation, learning, and continuous improvement.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience working with hyperscale, enterprise, or cloud storage customers.
Experience applying AI-driven automation or data analytics techniques within engineering workflows.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated qualification environments, and large-scale validation infrastructures.
Passion for leveraging emerging AI technologies to improve product quality, engineering efficiency, and customer outcomes.

Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision-ready status for leadership.
Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.
Leadership and PMO Excellence
Lead cross-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.

Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
Experience mentoring junior project team members
Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.

PMP certification.
Experience managing enterprise-wide, cross-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.

“Jira Platform enables Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale.”

AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork, designing systems that enable people and AI agents to work together effectively.

Job Summary
Your Career:
Palo Alto Networks is disrupting the Cyber Security industry! We are looking for a Senior Staff Enterprise Security Engineer to join our Infosec team that owns, securing and delivering security for our Enterprise, SaaS, and Public Cloud security services. With your networking, firewall, cloud, and development skills, you’ll design, build automation and integrate along with our secure programs – scale and secure our infrastructure and application in a Google Cloud Platform environment as well as collaborate with other team members. In this role, you will provide technical leadership in the development of Security programs by helping to drive the disruptive vision, technology planning, and estimation. If you are a fast learner and passionate about Cyber Security, this is a great opportunity for you
Qualifications
Providing advanced operations and engineering support for critical systems and services, including application and security infrastructure on-prem and in the cloud.
Responsible for assessing and reviewing the security and cloud infrastructure in both IT and production environments.
Coordinates with various teams to ensure appliances and services are configured with the correct posture to support business requirements.
In-depth knowledge of designing and implementing a Zero Trust Network Architecture, including network and identity segmentation.
Continuous monitoring and improvement of IT support practices to enhance scalability, reliability, and performance in the product infrastructure.
Assist in maintaining strong oversight of cloud computing solutions to safeguard against undue risks from third-party or external integrations.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, with 13 or more years of relevant experience in SSD technologies, storage systems, firmware engineering, hardware engineering, applications engineering, product engineering, validation engineering, technical support, or a related technical field.

Experience coordinating cross-functional technical investigations and managing issues through resolution using Jira or an equivalent issue-tracking system.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, accurate, actionable, and audience-appropriate communications.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, with excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, influence decisions, and lead strategic initiatives across global and matrixed organizations. Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

jobs.title: Layout Design, Sr Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent years in the trenches of physical design, where a misplaced power ring or a routing bottleneck can turn a promising memory macro into a timing nightmare. Layout is not just drawing rectangles to you, it is solving a puzzle where every micron counts and every decision ripples through verification, performance, and yield. You know that the difference between a memory compiler that ships and one that gets stuck in debug is usually a floor plan decision made two weeks earlier, and you are the kind of engineer who sees that coming.
You are comfortable moving between Calibre or ICV verification runs, XARA power analysis, and sitting with circuit designers to understand why a bitcell is behaving the way it is. When a DRC violation shows up at tape-out minus two days, you do not panic, you methodically trace it back, fix it, and document it so it does not happen again. You have strong opinions about power grid design and you can back them up with IR drop numbers.
At Synopsys, you will work on memory IP that goes into chips powering everything from AI accelerators to automotive systems. The layouts you own will be used by customers worldwide, and the quality bar is exactly as high as you would expect.
What You'll Be Doing
Design and own full custom layouts for embedded memory blocks, including SRAM, register files, and ROM compilers across advanced process nodes
Develop floor plans, place memory cells and periphery blocks, route power grids and signal interconnects to meet area, performance, and power targets
Run IR drop and electromigration analysis using tools like XARA, back-annotate layout parasitics, and iterate with circuit teams to close timing and power
Execute physical verification using DRC and LVS tools such as ICV or Calibre, debug violations, and drive layouts to clean signoff
Collaborate with memory compiler architects and circuit designers to translate specifications into manufacturable, verified layout deliverables
Script layout automation flows using TCL, Perl, or C-shell to improve productivity and ensure consistency across memory variants
Support formal release cycles, including documentation, design rule checks, and handoff to product engineering and customers
The Impact You Will Have
Enable Synopsys memory IP to meet aggressive PPA targets that directly affect customer chip performance and power efficiency
Reduce layout development cycle time through automation and reusable design practices, accelerating time to market for new memory products
Ensure memory macros pass physical verification and reliability checks on the first pass, minimizing costly respins and customer escalations
Contribute to the quality and competitiveness of Synopsys memory compiler offerings used in high-volume production across automotive, mobile, and AI markets
Influence layout methodology and best practices that shape how the team approaches next-generation process nodes
Mentor junior layout engineers and share knowledge that raises the overall capability of the physical design team
Support customer engagements by delivering robust, well-documented layouts that integrate cleanly into complex SoC designs
What You'll Need
Diploma in Electronics Engineering with 8+ years of layout design experience, or BE/BTech with 6+ years, or MS with 4+ years in a directly relevant role
Deep hands-on experience with full custom layout design for embedded memories including floor planning, placement, power grid design, and signal routing
Proficiency with layout tools such as Cadence Virtuoso or Custom Compiler, and physical verification tools like Mentor Calibre or Synopsys ICV
Strong understanding of IR drop and electromigration analysis, including use of tools like XARA or RedHawk, and ability to close power integrity issues
Solid knowledge of physical design methodologies across all phases: floor planning, place and route, DRC/LVS verification, and signoff
Scripting capability in TCL, Perl, or C-shell to automate layout tasks and improve design flow efficiency
Experience with memory compiler development, block placement, and parasitic-aware layout optimization is a strong plus
Who You Are
You can look at a layout and immediately spot the power grid weakness or the routing congestion that will cause problems three steps downstream
When a circuit designer asks for a layout change that breaks your carefully optimized floor plan, you do not just say no, you explain the tradeoff and propose an alternative that works for both of you
You keep your manager informed without being asked, you know when a schedule is slipping and you surface it early with a plan, not just a problem
You are the person the team comes to when a tough DRC violation will not go away, because you have the patience and the methodology to track it down
You adapt quickly when process rules change or a new node brings unexpected challenges, and you help the rest of the team do the same
You take initiative to learn new tools and techniques, and you share what you learn so the whole team gets better
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
Rewards and Benefits
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process

Perform transistor-level circuit design, simulation, and optimization across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) conditions.

Work closely with layout teams to implement high-performance analog layout methodologies including matching, shielding, isolation, and parasitic optimization.

Strong experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design.

Solid understanding of transistor-level analog design fundamentals including gain, bandwidth, noise, stability, matching, and power optimization.
Experience with industry-standard analog design and simulation tools.
Strong knowledge of pre-layout and post-layout verification methodologies, including PVT, Monte Carlo, reliability, and corner simulations.
Experience working closely with layout engineers on analog layout reviews and parasitic-aware design optimization.

Excellent problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

A collaborative team player who values diversity, inclusion, and open communication.

The team is focused on delivering robust, innovative, and high-quality solutions that meet the rigorous demands of a global customer base. Collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical mentorship are at the core of our culture, ensuring you’ll have the support and opportunities needed to thrive and grow.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Senior Engineering Manager- TDP Insights and Data Resiliency
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. You will work closely with engineering teams in India and Australia and coordinate strategy, priorities, and execution with leadership in the United States.
Atlassian’s Trusted Data Platform (TDP) provides secure, reliable, and scalable data capabilities used by Atlassian product and platform teams. It helps those teams manage persistent customer data while meeting complex enterprise requirements, including data residency, encryption, regulatory compliance, backup and recovery, and operation across multiple cloud environments.
TDP Insights provides the intelligence layer for the Trusted Data Platform. It helps teams understand where data lives, how it moves, what it costs, how reliably it operates, and how customers use TDP services. By transforming high-volume platform telemetry into actionable insights, it supports better decisions about reliability, capacity, cost, compliance, recovery readiness, and developer experience.
Atlassian Data Resiliency (ADR) strengthens end-to-end recovery across TDP. It provides common backup and restore capabilities, recovery assurance, RPO and RTO evidence, validation, restore exercises, and consistent resiliency standards across TDP data platforms.
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the TDP Insights and ADR engineering team. This leader will be accountable for the team’s people, strategy, execution, and operational outcomes. They will partner with senior engineers, product and program leaders, storage and streaming teams, infrastructure teams, security specialists, and Atlassian product organizations to improve how Atlassian understands, protects, and recovers its data.
Success in this role means building a strong engineering organization, delivering trusted platform insights and recovery capabilities, and translating complex customer, reliability, and infrastructure requirements into a clear and executable roadmap.
Team and organizational leadership
Lead, coach, and develop engineers and senior technical leaders, establishing clear expectations and accountability.
Build an inclusive, high-performing team through effective hiring, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
Develop senior technical and leadership talent by delegating meaningful ownership to senior engineers and emerging leaders.
Establish operating practices that support good decisions, predictable execution, and continuous improvement.
Manage capacity across strategic investments, customer commitments, operational work, and technical debt.
Build an effective distributed-team operating model across India and Australia, with clear alignment and communication with leadership in the United States.
Strategy and execution
Define and execute the TDP Insights and ADR strategy and roadmap in alignment with Atlassian’s broader data-platform and cloud-infrastructure goals.
Translate enterprise, product, platform, and recovery requirements into measurable outcomes, milestones, and engineering plans.
Surface delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, capacity constraints, and required trade-offs early.
Establish clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities across TDP Insights, ADR, TDP data platforms, and partner teams.
Deliver actionable insights into platform health, customer adoption, cost, data movement, compliance, and recovery readiness.
Improve recovery confidence through common capabilities, clear standards, validation, and repeatable restore exercises.
Reliability and customer trust
Own the operational health of TDP Insights and ADR capabilities, including availability, data quality, performance, security, compliance, and recoverability.
Establish service-level objectives, operational indicators, review mechanisms, and sustainable on-call practices.
Establish trustworthy measures for backup coverage, restore validation, RPO and RTO performance, and recovery readiness.

Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data-driven financial strategies. We are seeking a customer-focused Support Engineer who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this high-visibility, customer-facing role, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
Location & Shift
Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.

Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.
About You
Basic Qualifications (Required)
Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
Technical & Diagnostic Skills:
Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.
Cloud & Monitoring Systems:
Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.
AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
Triage & Operations:
Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
Have these technical skills:
ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
Jenkins & Git
Kubernetes and Docker
ELK or other log aggregation tool
JavaScript

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Job Description
As a Non-Volatile Memory QRA (NVMQRA) Solid State Drive (SSD) Quality and Reliability Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc., you will you will be responsible for managing quality and reliability of Micron SSD products as these products enter into high volume production phase of product lifecycle.
You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.
In this role you will work with various Engineering and Quality Reliability Assurance Groups to provide technical support, expertise, consultation and training. You should expect to support customers both internal and external to Micron on an on-going basis.
Responsibilities And Tasks
Manage Reliability evaluations for deviation management
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Identify deviated material within Material Review Board (MRB)
Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability
Collaborate with discrete component product quality and reliability team for product reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Collaborate with package quality and reliability team for package-related reliability evaluations/trials/plans
Manage Product Outgoing Quality and Reliability Monitoring
Provide the plan for operations to execute for SSD product OQRM data collection
Analyze the data from Micron Manufacturing Execution System (MES) such as MAM
Use statistical analysis tools to provide conclusions and verify results
Summarize the reult of analyzed data through a regular OQRM metrics report
Digital & AI Tool Usage
Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, agentic AI platforms, and other generative AI solutions) to enhance engineering effectiveness, automate routine tasks, analyze large datasets, and improve decision quality.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, and improve knowledge sharing within the organization.
Provide Expertise, Consultation and Training
Communicate Globally with NAND, Firmware, BUs and Engineering Groups for priority management
Provide training to engineers and technicians within and outside of the group
Maintain knowledge base (lessons learned) within the group for each SSD market segment
Stay abreast of Quality and Reliability issues of Micron NAND components
Provide consultation for audits, RMA, and customer issues
Education
Required: Master's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Desired: PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree and strong academic performance, relevant internships, research projects, or semiconductor-related experience may also be considered.
Experience
Exposure through coursework, academic research, internships, co-op programs, or project work in one or more of the following areas is preferred: Solid State Drive (SSD) products and storage technologies, Non-Volatile Memory (NAND, NOR, UFS, eMMC, SSD) technologies, Semiconductor device engineering, Semiconductor process integration engineering, Semiconductor quality and reliability engineering
Experience applying engineering principles to solve complex technical problems through academic, research, or internship projects.
Demonstrated ability to effectively utilize Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to improve productivity, automate routine tasks, accelerate data analysis, and enhance technical documentation.
Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted tools in daily engineering activities while exercising sound technical judgment, critical thinking, and responsible data handling practices.
Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a fast-paced semiconductor product development environment.
Qualifications
Fundamental knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing and wafer fabrication processes
Fundamental understanding of semiconductor device physics
Basic understanding of NAND flash memory architecture and operation
Basic understanding of Solid State Drive (SSD) architecture and operation
Familiarity with storage interface standards such as SATA, PCIe, and NVMe through coursework, projects, or internships
Understanding of engineering statistics and reliability concepts
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Effective written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Photolithography Engineer at Micron, you will be responsible to tackle critical lithography scribe challenges for memory devices. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting work for the photolithography team. This includes modeling to support optical simulation related to scribe mark, provide mark design recommendations, identifying root causes for sophisticated problems, and providing simulation training for other photolithography engineers. You will also define and lead projects to address photolithography performance gaps on current and future memory and storage nodes.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Understand the technology challenges with respect to overlay and establish project plans to address them for the N, N+1, and N+2 nodes.
Work with vendor applications teams to find areas for overlay scribe improvement.
Drive technical innovation in your area of expertise as a recognized Micron expert in your field.
Standardize methods and procedures across area, department and/or FABs.
Define and lead sophisticated, multi-disciplinary projects that are essential to Micron’s photolithography roadmap. Help to craft strategic decisions.
Work with process development engineers on issues and projects related to photolithography.
Summarize plans, progress to experimental work, and conclusions in the form of written reports.
Provide advice and counsel to senior management on technical issues related to overlay scribe.
Build strong customer relationships to understand customer expectations.
Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.
Qualifications for this position include:
Strong understanding of photolithography. Familiarity with semiconductor process integration is a plus.
Understanding of optics. Understanding of the principals of photolithography and optical metrology.
Understanding of how lens aberrations, scanner chuck differences, and process variations can affect overlay.
Understand various alignment and overlay marks. Understand how mark type and design can impact overlay errors. Experience with overlay mark simulation software is a plus.
Ability to develop and maintain relationships with multi-functional teams and suppliers.

jobs.description:
Job Details | Atlassian
Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
Engineering | Bengaluru, India | Remote, Remote | Full-Time
Apply for this job
Working at Atlassian India
Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear.
Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere.
Your future team: KubePlat Team
The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products.
What we own:
Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments.
Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts.
Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices.
Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on.
Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads.
Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day.
AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features.
We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale.
As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch.
What you'll do
Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters.
Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources.
Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP).
Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation.
Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference.
Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers.
10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems.
Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs.
Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design.
Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar.
Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability.
A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills.
Nice to have
Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments.
Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore).
Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Development [CPaaS, Data Platform, Database Internals,12 -16 years experience]
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a world-class systems architect to join the Nutanix Cloud-PaaS (CPaaS) data services team as a Staff Software Engineer. This is a high-visibility technical leadership role designed for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of deep database internals and scalable distributed systems. If you are ready to lead the design of platform foundations while championing an "Open Source First" philosophy, this is your next challenge.
About Team
At Cloud Platform as a Service, our core mission is to architect, develop, and maintain a robust, enterprise-grade data and compute platform. This platform is meticulously crafted using cutting-edge open-source technologies, providing the foundational infrastructure upon which numerous product engineering teams at Nutanix build and deliver their exceptional solutions to our valued customers.
Your Role
Architect & Innovate: Lead the design, implementation and optimization of core data platform components for on-prem, hybrid-cloud enterprise & service provider environments. You will ensure our systems are resilient, performant, scalable and easily "day-2 manageable" across diverse customer data centers, including air-gapped and highly regulated environments.
Performance Engineering: Dive deep into I/O stacks, memory management, DB engines, distributed messaging stack, and data models to squeeze every ounce of performance out of the hardware.
Technical Leadership: Be a force multiplier, influence the technical roadmap, conduct high-stakes design reviews, and mentor engineers across the CPaaS team.
Customer-Led Engineering: Develop a deep intuition for user challenges to build high-impact solutions that deliver immediate value. By collaborating with cross-functional leads, you will ensure our data platform remains a pragmatic, reliable foundation that solves real-world problems without compromising on long-term architectural excellence.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a critical escalation point for cross-functional teams, providing the deep architectural insights and hands-on debugging necessary to resolve complex technical blockers and accelerate delivery cycles across the organization.
Open Source Leadership: Identify internal data platform technologies & contributions suitable for open-sourcing to establish Nutanix as a thought leader.
Planning & Prioritization: Collaborate with engineering leads to define the high impact initiatives and quarterly priorities. You will ensure the CPaaS data services roadmap balances immediate customer needs with long-term architectural sustainability and technical debt reduction.
Work in a geographically distributed team setup.
What will you bring?
Deep Systems Expertise: 12+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software, with a specialized focus on distributed systems and database internals. You should have a proven track record of solving complex problems at the infrastructure layer.
Polyglot Programming: Expert-level proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust. You are also comfortable using Python to automate, prototype, and bridge services within a cloud-native ecosystem.
Data Engine Mastery: A deep, internal understanding (indexing, storage engines, data models, query optimization) of diverse data architectures:
Analytical & Time-Series: ClickHouse, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics.
Relational: PostgreSQL, MySQL.
Graph: Neo4j, Dgraph.
Messaging: NATS, Apache Kafka.
Cloud-Native Foundations: A solid architectural understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration, specifically regarding stateful workloads and high-availability data services.
Operational Excellence: Experience operating distributed "Big Data" systems in a resource constrained on-prem or hybrid cloud environment. You understand the nuances of observability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and zero-downtime migrations.
AI-Augmented Engineering: A forward-thinking passion for integrating AI tools into the SDLC. You have experience using AI for code generation, automated design reviews, and accelerating the path from "concept to commit."
The "Nutanix" Mindset: A self-starter who can think big (architecting for the future), start small (delivering iterative value), and make it happen (driving projects to completion).

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP)
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
The Opportunity
Founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Jose, California, Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) solutions. With a passionate team of over 6,000 employees worldwide (affectionately known as "Nutants"), we make computing invisible anywhere. Companies around the world rely on Nutanix software to manage any app, at any location, and at any scale across private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. We value intellectual curiosity, a bias for action, customer obsession, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Nutanix welcomes builders who thrive on tackling seemingly impossible challenges while celebrating what makes each of us unique.
As a senior staff engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader and architect for the NKP team. This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role where you will look beyond single-cluster management to solve "fleet-scale" problems—designing systems that manage tens of thousands of clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will bridge the gap between Nutanix’s core infrastructure and the evolving CNCF ecosystem.
About the Team
The Nutanix Cloud Native team is at the forefront of building the next generation of enterprise infrastructure. Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), a complete, enterprise-grade solution that simplifies Kubernetes operations across hybrid, edge, and multi-cloud environments.
Our mission is to make NKP the foundational layer for all modern workloads. We are solving complex distributed systems challenges in fleet management, multi-tenancy, and edge computing to deliver a robust, scalable control plane.
You will report to the engineering leader at Nutanix. The work setup is hybrid, allowing for flexibility and a healthy work-life balance. As a new hire, you will be expected to work from the office three days a week, ensuring face-to-face interactions with your team members and promoting a sense of camaraderie and community within the team.
Your Role
Architectural Strategy: Lead the design of critical NKP components with a focus on multi-tenancy, resilience, and "Fleet Management". You will ensure NKP operates reliably at the Edge and in resource-constrained environments.
Force Multiplier: Act as a technical "bar-raiser". " You will lead and mentor a distributed team of 15–20 engineers, driving excellence through design reviews, coding standards, and a culture of technical curiosity.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Management, the Data Services (NDK) team, and Core Hybrid Cloud teams to translate high-level business goals into technical roadmaps for stateful workloads and disaster recovery.
Community & Innovation: Represent Nutanix in the open-source community. Contribute to upstream CNCF projects (Cluster API, Kappa, etc.), file patents, and author white papers that define the future of hybrid cloud.
Operational Excellence: Engage with customers and support teams to resolve complex production issues, ensuring our platform meets the highest standards of scale and user experience.
What You Will Bring
Experience: 15-20+ years of software development experience within product-led companies, with a significant tenure architecting and shipping large-scale distributed systems. Technical: Rock-solid proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. While deep K8s internals (controllers, API machinery) are a plus, we value "systems thinkers" who can master new stacks quickly.
Domain Expertise: A proven track record in cloud-native systems, Docker/containers, and large-scale control plane management is a great plus. Leadership: You can navigate ambiguity, drive consensus across multiple teams, and balance long-term innovation with short-term risk/reward trade-offs.
Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
Work Arrangement
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview
Join the Central Engineering - Software team as a Senior System QA Engineer, helping to validate complex Linux server and SoC platforms. You will develop automated tests and investigate system-level issues across hardware, firmware and software, contributing to reliable platform bring-up, performance and long-duration stability. This role offers the opportunity to work across processor, memory, I/O, networking, storage, power and thermal technologies, collaborating with engineering teams to turn challenging failures into clear, actionable findings.
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain functional, performance, stress and stability tests for Linux server and SoC platforms.
Create test automation, log-analysis tools and regression coverage using C/C++, Python and shell scripting.
Validate and debug interactions across firmware, Linux kernel and device drivers, system management, networking, storage and hardware bring-up.
Investigate failures found during system-level workloads and long-duration testing; gather evidence, identify likely root causes and communicate findings clearly to partner engineering teams.
Exercise platform reliability, availability and serviceability features, telemetry, power and thermal behaviour, and reset and boot flows.
Contribute to validation of memory, high-speed I/O, PCIe, NVMe, Ethernet, RDMA and accelerator-related workloads where relevant to the platform.
Required Skills and Experience
Practical experience programming in C or C++ and using Python and shell scripting to develop test automation, analyse logs and support regression testing.
Ability to validate and debug Linux-based server or SoC platforms across firmware, kernel, device drivers, system management and hardware bring-up; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
Experience designing and running system-level functional, performance, stress or long-duration stability tests, with effective failure detection and root-cause analysis.
Understanding of system architecture and behaviour across areas such as CPU and memory, cache coherency, DMA, NUMA, IOMMU/SMMU, PCIe, networking, storage, power or thermal management.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
Experience with BMC-based server management, secure boot, firmware authentication, boot-stage sequencing, watchdogs, reset flows, inter-processor communication or mailbox mechanisms.
Knowledge of RAS validation across memory, interconnect, PCIe or accelerator subsystems, including use of telemetry such as performance counters, sensors and activity monitors.
Experience with PCIe or NVMe validation, including raw block-device testing, storage performance testing or long-duration storage stress testing.
Knowledge of high-speed Ethernet, RDMA, RoCEv2, MPI/CCL-style communication stacks, collective operations, or scale-up and scale-out communication architectures.
Familiarity with AI/ML or accelerator validation, including PyTorch workloads, model execution, numerical-result comparison, benchmarking, workload automation or concurrent compute, memory, networking and I/O testing.
In Return
You will work on meaningful system validation challenges at the intersection of hardware and software, helping improve the reliability and performance of complex server and SoC platforms. The role provides broad technical exposure across Linux, firmware, platform management, networking, storage and accelerator technologies, alongside opportunities to deepen your debugging, automation and system-level validation expertise. You will collaborate with engineers across disciplines and see your work inform product quality and platform readiness.
