jobs.title: AI Engineer, Agentic Systems (Quality Engineering)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary
As a Staff Software Engineer in IT Quality Engineering Automation, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for our automated testing and next-generation SDLC ecosystem, operating directly from our Bangalore office. At Palo Alto Networks, we are transitioning from traditional QA to an AI-First engineering culture.
We are looking for an early-in-career AI Engineer to build and ship custom Agentic AI. Applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom. Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will work with modern generative AI — LLM orchestration, autonomous agent loops, tool calling and RAG — against real enterprise infrastructure, building agents that carry out multi-step business workflows, act on data across these systems through their APIs, and hand back to a human when they should.
At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.
Agentic Systems & Enterprise Integration
Build agentic features: Develop and maintain agent workflows using LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen or CrewAI, including planner/executor loops, state handling and failure recovery.
Enable cross-system integration and tool calling: Connect agents across enterprise applications, including: Salesforce: REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, Platform Events, Apex Invocable Methods, SOQL and Flows. SAP: OData/BAPI services and business-object events. Custom applications: Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM through REST APIs, webhooks and message queues.
Build context grounding and RAG pipelines: Use vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate to provide LLMs with accurate, current enterprise context.
Define tools and schemas: Create well-specified tool definitions and JSON function schemas, including MCP tools, to support deterministic tool calls and traceability back to Jira.
Agent Quality, Safety & Observability
Build evaluation suites: Develop and run golden-set evaluations to validate improvements to agents and prompts before release.
Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows: Establish safety controls, rate limiting, fallbacks and clear approval handoffs, especially when agents write to systems of record.
Enable observability: Instrument agents with tracing and metrics covering execution paths, latency, context usage and token costs, and use findings to improve performance.
Apply responsible AI practices: Follow company policies on intellectual property and data privacy, keep secrets in managed stores and require explicit opt-in for steps that send content to external services.
Collaboration & Growth
Collaborate across functions: Partner with Salesforce, SAP and platform architects, QE leads, product managers and security teams to deliver reliable AI features that meet business, quality and enterprise compliance requirements.
Learn the enterprise landscape: Build an understanding of transaction flows from AI Custom Quoting and order capture through licensing, entitlement, provisioning and service management. Prior knowledge is not required, but proactive learning is expected.
Share knowledge: Contribute working examples, reusable tools and reviewed code to strengthen AI fluency across engineering teams.
Qualifications
Experience: 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent demonstrable capability.
Programming: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with sound fundamentals in data structures, testing and code review.
Backend fundamentals: Practical experience building and consuming REST APIs, working with relational databases and handling asynchronous or queue-based processing.
Hands-on LLM experience: Demonstrable experience with LLM APIs, including prompting, function/tool calling and structured outputs, through professional work, internships, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
Agentic or RAG exposure: Built at least one working agent or retrieval pipeline end to end, with the ability to explain its design, failures and improvements.
Integration skills: Comfortable reading unfamiliar enterprise API documentation and determining how to integrate safely.
Version control and CI: Comfortable using Git in a team environment and working with automated build and test pipelines.
AI-assisted development: Daily working fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to critically review generated output.
Education: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Production agents: Experience deploying AI agents or LLM features into production, including multi-agent coordination or autonomous decision loops.
Enterprise application knowledge: Exposure to one or more of the following: Salesforce: REST/Composite/Bulk APIs, SOQL/SOSL, Connected Apps, OAuth and Apex. SAP: OData, BAPI/RFC, IDocs or business-object events. Enterprise platforms: AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning, Licensing/Entitlement or ITSM platforms and their supporting distributed services.
Vector databases and embeddings: Experience with semantic search, embedding generation and vector engines such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or ChromaDB.
Advanced retrieval: Familiarity with Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE or agentic retrieval, and graph stores such as Apache AGE or Neo4j.
Model Context Protocol: Experience authoring MCP servers, including tools, resources and prompts.
Cloud and DevOps: Exposure to GCP, AWS or Azure, containerisation using Docker or Kubernetes, and serverless computing. Vertex AI experience is a plus.
Test automation: Familiarity with Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest.
Domain interest: Grounding in B2B sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM) or the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle.
Ways of Working
Evidence over assertion: Measure results before and after changes, share findings with the methodology and clearly acknowledge inconclusive outcomes.
Curiosity with rigour: Explore new tools, validate them before adoption and understand the difference between a demo and a reliable system.
Ownership: Take tasks from ambiguity through delivery and raise blockers early.
Builder’s bias: Prioritise shipping focused, reliable capabilities that users can trust over broad features that only perform well in demonstrations.
Growth Path
Join at the AI Engineer tier of the internal AI capability ladder, between AI User and AI Architect.
Progress towards AI Architect, building expertise in: Planner–executor orchestration at scale. Multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop controls. Event-driven integration across enterprise IT systems. Model customisation.
Access company-funded training to support this progression.
The Team
Join a growing, passionate and dynamic team working on challenging, mission-driven projects.
Contribute to a people-centric culture focused on creating an exceptional employee experience.
Help expand what is possible in the workplace through innovation and collaboration
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Understand Business Problems and Define Intelligent Solutions

Partner with product owners, domain experts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions.

Communicate technical options, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Design secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions that integrate enterprise data, cloud platforms, applications, services, and AI capabilities.
Define end-to-end architecture covering data ingestion, transformation, storage, retrieval, processing, APIs, user experiences, model integration, and production operations.
Select appropriate architectural patterns, cloud services, data platforms, models, frameworks, and integration approaches based on performance, security, operability, cost, and business fit.
Design modular services, APIs, event-driven components, intelligent workflows, and reusable platform capabilities.
Contribute to architecture and design reviews while establishing reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and quality gates.

Design and develop scalable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and processing workflows for varying data volumes and latency requirements.
Implement suitable data models, storage structures, contracts, metadata, lineage, retention, archival, and deletion strategies.
Establish and monitor data-quality objectives, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, freshness, traceability, and fitness for purpose.
Prepare trusted datasets and knowledge sources for reporting, analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled applications.
Develop retrieval pipelines that include document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embeddings, indexing, vector search, relevance evaluation, grounding, and citation strategies.
Develop Production-Ready Applications and Services
Lead the end-to-end design, development, testing, deployment, enhancement, and support of cloud-native and AI-enabled applications.
Develop secure, maintainable, and high-performing backend services, APIs, microservices, integration components, and intelligent workflows.
Build responsive, accessible, and reusable user experiences using suitable modern application frameworks.
Apply sound object-oriented design, domain-driven design, asynchronous processing, dependency injection, and distributed-system principles where appropriate.
Integrate relational, non-relational, analytical, streaming, and vector data stores into enterprise applications.
Modernize existing solutions and progressively evolve legacy systems toward modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled architectures.
Engineer AI-Enabled Capabilities
Design and implement solutions using machine learning, Large Language Models, Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, tool calling, copilots, and AI agents.
Develop prompt orchestration, context-management, memory, reasoning, workflow, and multi-agent patterns appropriate to the business use case.
Enable governed connectivity between intelligent agents, enterprise tools, APIs, applications, and data sources using Model Context Protocol or similar integration patterns.
Establish systematic evaluation approaches for model quality, retrieval relevance, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, safety, and user experience.
Implement safeguards to reduce hallucinations, unsupported responses, prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, and unintended system actions.
Design appropriate human-in-the-loop mechanisms, fallback behaviors, approval controls, and escalation paths for higher-risk scenarios.
Evaluate models, frameworks, and emerging technologies through structured prototypes and recommend adoption based on measurable technical and business outcomes.
Ensure Security, Responsible AI, and Governance
Apply security-by-design and responsible AI principles throughout solution architecture, implementation, and operation.
Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, secrets management, encryption, network controls, and secure coding practices.
Protect confidential and sensitive information through data classification, access restrictions, privacy controls, filtering, masking, and secure handling practices.
Incorporate content safety, prompt-injection defenses, auditability, traceability, explainability, and human oversight based on the use case.
Ensure that solutions comply with applicable enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data-governance, software-development, and AI-governance standards.
Assess third-party libraries, models, dependencies, and services for security, licensing, operational, and supply-chain risks.
Own Engineering Quality and Production Readiness
Build automated unit, integration, system, regression, performance, security, and AI evaluation tests.
Establish continuous integration and delivery pipelines with appropriate code-quality checks, automated validation, deployment controls, and rollback mechanisms.
Implement logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, health monitoring, and operational dashboards across solution components.
Optimize solutions for reliability, scalability, availability, performance, latency, throughput, and cost.
Participate in production support, incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement.
Define and monitor service-level indicators, operational thresholds, capacity requirements, and production-readiness criteria.
Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture decisions, data contracts, API specifications, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and engineering-quality assessments.
Mentor associate and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, pairing, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing.
Promote reusable solutions, coding standards, automation, documentation, and engineering best practices across teams.
Coordinate with globally distributed and cross-functional teams to manage dependencies, resolve technical challenges, and deliver incremental business value.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, written communication, verbal communication, and presentation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer(Growth & ML), Hyderabad
jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!
ㅤ
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad
Meet our Team
Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention.
Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks.
We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions.
About the Role
As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring.
Roles & Responsibilities:
ML System Design & Ownership
Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models.
Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs.
Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM).
Modeling & Experimentation
Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching.
Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case.
Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs.
Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR).
MLOps & Infrastructure
Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks.
Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency.
Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds.
Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design.
Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration
Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards.
Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs.
Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Flagship Projects You’ll Work On
Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching.
Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms.
ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions.
Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion.
What You’ll Bring
Required
5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.).
Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records).
Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery.
Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda).
Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders.
Preferred:
Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context.
Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation.
Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration.
Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex.
Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications.

jobs.description:

1. OPEX Budgeting (Annual & Quarterly)
Lead preparation of the annual OPEX budget for Construction & Facilities, covering utilities, O&M contracts, AMCs, repairs and maintenance, consumables, services, manpower contracts and other operating cost elements.
Prepare quarterly budget refreshes and rolling forecasts; incorporate operational changes, ramp-up plans, contract renewals, escalations and inflation assumptions.
Build cost models and bottom-up estimates with cost owners; maintain clear basis-of-estimate documentation and assumptions.
Align budgets to cost centers, GL accounts and WBS elements as per Micron Finance structure; support budget reviews and approvals with the Program Lead and Finance.
Identify cost-saving and cost-avoidance opportunities and incorporate them into budget plans.
2. OPEX QVS Performance Tracking
Track and report OPEX performance against QVS targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, including actuals, commitments, accruals and forecast-to-complete.
Perform variance analysis (budget vs. actual vs. forecast), identify root causes and drive corrective actions with cost owners.
Prepare dashboards and management reports for the Program Lead and site leadership; highlight risks, opportunities and spend trends.
Support month-end and quarter-end close, and respond to Finance and corporate queries on OPEX performance.
3. SAP Transactions – PR Issuance, GRN Adjustments & Accruals
Create, modify and track Purchase Requisitions (PRs) in SAP with correct account assignment (cost center, GL, WBS), and follow up through approval workflow to PO conversion.
Coordinate Goods/Service Receipts (GRN/SES) with requestors and perform GRN adjustments, reversals and corrections as required.
Estimate and post monthly accruals for services rendered but not invoiced; reverse and true-up accruals in line with corporate accounting policies and close calendars.
Monitor open POs, aged commitments and unutilized balances; drive PO closure and de-obligation of residual values.
Ensure all SAP transactions are accurate, timely, auditable and compliant with internal controls (SOX / delegation of authority).
4. OPEX P2P Tracking (PR to Payment)
Own end-to-end tracking of the Procure-to-Pay cycle: PR → PO → GRN/SES → Invoice → Payment for all Construction & Facilities OPEX spend.
Validate vendor invoices against PO terms, contract rates, GRN/SES quantities and service evidence (3-way match); resolve price/quantity mismatches and blocked invoices.
Verify statutory requirements on invoices, including GST compliance, TDS applicability and e-invoicing details, in coordination with Accounts Payable and Tax teams.
Maintain a P2P tracker with status, ageing and bottlenecks; follow up with Procurement, AP and vendors to ensure on-time payment and minimize vendor escalations.
Reconcile vendor statements and support vendor ledger clean-up and resolution of disputes.
5. Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Micron procurement, finance and audit policies; support internal and external audits with complete documentation.
Standardize OPEX processes, templates and reporting; drive automation of trackers and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Excel/VBA, SAP reports).
Partner with Procurement on contract scope, rate validation, escalation clauses and renewals to ensure commercial accuracy.
6. AI-Enabled Ways of Working
Use approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise GenAI assistants) to speed up budget preparation, draft variance commentary, summarize contracts and SOWs, and prepare management reports, while checking all AI outputs for accuracy.
Use AI and advanced analytics for OPEX forecasting and spend trend analysis, such as predicting utility, maintenance and contract costs from historical consumption and operating data.
Apply AI and automation to P2P processes, including invoice data extraction, automated 3-way match exception flagging, duplicate or anomalous invoice detection, and accrual estimation support.
Find repetitive OPEX and SAP tasks that can be automated (AI agents, RPA, Power Automate, Power BI) and work with Finance, IT and digital teams to build and scale these solutions.
Keep financial data clean, structured and well governed so it can be used reliably by AI and analytics tools.
Follow Micron’s Responsible AI, data privacy, information security and confidentiality policies; never put confidential vendor, pricing or financial data into unapproved tools.
Share AI use cases and good practices with the Construction & Facilities team and support colleagues in adopting AI-enabled ways of working.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description: Working at Atlassian India Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear. Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere. Your future team: KubePlat Team The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products. What we own: Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments. Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts. Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices. Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on. Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads. Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day. AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features. We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch. Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources. Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP). Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation. Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference. Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers. 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems. Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs. Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar. Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability. A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills. Nice to have Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments. Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore). Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Description Are you a hands-on engineer who wants to build AI agents that do real work? Not demos, but agents that provision infrastructure, investigate incidents, answer the questions engineers would otherwise file a ticket for, and take action safely on production systems? Our technology organization runs the cloud, compute, and network platforms that thousands of engineers across Thomson Reuters build on, spanning AWS, Azure, and our own data centers. We are rethinking how that platform is built and operated, with AI agents and automation taking on work that used to require tickets, runbooks, and manual toil. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead that work. We are a software engineering team within Thomson Reuters’ technology organization. We design and build AI agents, agent tooling, and infrastructure automation that change how technology teams across the company work. We also own and evolve internal platform and developer tools used by engineers across the company. We place a high degree of trust in our engineers and expect them to deliver. We move quickly, ship to production, and learn from what our users actually do. In return, you will have interesting problems, the resources to solve them, and real room to shape how a large enterprise adopts AI. Key Responsibilities We build for production, so a prototype is a starting point, not a deliverable. We eliminate toil by design, asking whether software, automation, or an agent should handle repetitive work. We use AI in our own development workflow and apply engineering judgment to everything it produces. We reuse before we build, and we value aptitude and judgment over experience with any specific toolset. Design and build AI agents that reason over context, call tools, and take action on real systems, from single-purpose assistants to multi-step workflows with human approval where it matters. Build the APIs, MCP servers, and integrations that give agents safe, well-scoped access to cloud providers, source control, service management, observability, and internal platforms. Build infrastructure-as-code, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that let engineers get what they need without waiting on a person. Own production-grade concerns for agents, including evaluation and regression testing, observability, cost and latency management, guardrails, least-privilege access, defenses against prompt injection, and auditability. Lead technically by owning the design of major systems, writing clear design documents, leading design and code reviews, establishing reusable patterns and standards, and mentoring engineers across the team. Apply judgment about when AI fits, recognizing when a deterministic script, a better API, or a process change is the right answer and making that case clearly. Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams, and with the stakeholders whose work is being automated, to turn ambiguous problems into well-defined solutions. Required Qualifications 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating production systems. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Python is the primary language and experience with it is a plus, but strong engineers from Go, TypeScript, C#, Java, or similar backgrounds who are ready to work in Python are welcome. Hands-on experience building applications or agents on large language models, including tool and function calling, context management, retrieval (RAG), and structured outputs, with a practical understanding of failure modes such as hallucination, non-determinism, and prompt injection. Experience with AWS and/or Azure and with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Bicep. Experience with modern delivery practices, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines), automated testing, and containers. A secure-by-design mindset, especially when giving software the ability to act on production systems. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a strong design document and explain complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. A track record of technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading through influence, and raising the quality of a team’s work. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks and SDKs such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Understanding of what these frameworks abstract is valued more than experience with any one of them. Experience designing evaluation suites for LLM systems, or with LLM observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith). Experience with Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or event-driven systems. Background in platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including on-call and incident response. Familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, firewalls, cloud networking) or IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow. Experience working in large, regulated, or compliance-conscious enterprise environments. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You? Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. About Us Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here . Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here . More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

jobs.description: Senior AI Software Engineer Bangalore, Karnātaka, India IT Ref ID: JR-023480 Apply Current Employees, apply here Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic AI applications integrated with our Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge modern generative AI technologies (LLM orchestrations, autonomous agent loops, tool calling, and RAG) with enterprise CRM infrastructure. You will design autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that execute complex, multi-step business workflows, interact directly with Salesforce data and APIs, and safely escalate to human teams when necessary. Key Responsibilities Agentic Application Architecture: Design, build, and maintain agentic solutions using tools like LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI etc. Salesforce Integration & Tool Calling: Implement robust REST/SOAP integrations, Webhooks, Platform Events, and Apex Invocable Methods allowing AI agents to query SOQL, update CRM records, and trigger Salesforce Flows autonomously. Context Grounding & RAG Pipelines: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connecting vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) to supply real-time context to LLMs while mitigating hallucinations. Workflow Automation & Agent Governance: Define function calling schemas, tool definitions, dynamic planning loops, and fallbacks. Implement safety guardrails, prompt evaluation suites, rate limiting, and seamless human-in-the-loop (HITL) handoffs. Observability & Reliability: Set up agent monitoring, evaluation metrics, and tracing to track execution paths, latency, context usage, and token costs. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Salesforce Architects, Product Managers, and security teams to translate complex CRM requirements into reliable AI features adhering to enterprise compliance and data governance standards. Qualifications Required Technical Skills & Qualifications Software Engineering Foundation: 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous message queues. Agentic AI & LLM Systems: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production AI agents, autonomous decision loops, multi-agent coordination, and function-calling/tool-use paradigms. Salesforce Core Knowledge: Proven experience interacting with Salesforce APIs (REST/Composite/Bulk), SOQL/SOSL queries, Connected Apps, OAuth flows, and Apex (Invocable Actions, Triggers). Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js for AI backend systems. Vector Databases & Embeddings: Direct experience with semantic search, embeddings generation, and vector engines (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector). Cloud & DevOps: Proficiency in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of B2B Sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and the end-to-end Opportunity-to-Quote (Q2C) lifecycle . jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: About the Team: Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. Job Purpose: The Principal AI Engineer is responsible for the technical design, development and implementation of AI-enabled and automation solutions across GSK’s MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Development Team. The role combines hands-on AI/software engineering with technical leadership to deliver reusable agents, automation components, integrations and engineering tools. Working closely with the MES Automation Manager, the role translates the Global MES AI and automation strategy into practical solutions and drives the technical adoption of AI within the development team. The job holder coordinates AI-related engineering activities, guides and coaches developers, promotes common AI engineering practices and remains hands-on in prototyping, scripting, integration and solution development. The role ensures that AI-enabled solutions are reliable, secure, reusable, measurable and appropriately governed, including evaluation, human oversight, monitoring and traceability. The MES Automation Manager retains accountability for AI/automation strategy, governance and value realization, while the Principal AI Engineer provides the technical leadership and engineering capability required to implement and scale AI within MES Development Team. Drives the delivery and operational support of AI solutions across their lifecycle, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable capabilities that enhance MES developer productivity, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making while delivering measurable business value and user adoption. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, test and implement AI-enabled solutions, agents and automation capabilities supporting the MES Development Team. Work with the MES Automation Manager to translate the MES AI and automation strategy into prototypes, (Minimum Viable Product) MVPs and scalable production solutions. Lead the technical implementation and adoption of AI within the development team, coordinating AI engineering activities and coaching developers in AI-enabled ways of working. Develop reusable AI agents, services, integrations, (Application Programming Interfaces) APIs, automation components and AI-ready knowledge solutions applicable across MES development. Apply prompt and context engineering, retrieval/RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agent orchestration and tool integration to build reliable and effective AI solutions. Define and execute evaluation, testing, acceptance criteria and monitoring for AI-generated outputs and agent behavior, and implement appropriate human oversight, traceability, logging, access controls and exception handling for AI-enabled solutions. Apply professional software engineering practices using technologies such as Python, C#/.NET, SQL, PowerShell, (Representational State Transfer) REST APIs, JSON (JavaScript Object Notation)/XML (eXtensible Markup Language), Git/GitHub, automated testing and code review. Collaborate with Architecture, Product, MES Engineering, Infrastructure and other GSK AI and technology teams to align solutions with enterprise platforms, standards and reusable AI capabilities. Drive reuse, standardization and continuous improvement of AI engineering practices, components and knowledge across the MES Development Team. Use AI coding assistants and agent workflows as the default way of building, testing and documenting, and validates every output before it is committed or released. Deliver and support AI solutions across the full lifecycle, including (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) CI/CD, release management, monitoring, incident resolution, and operational support, ensuring >99.5% availability, (Service Level Agreement) SLA compliance, and solution reliability. Drive AI-enabled capabilities that improve MES developer productivity, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making, with success measured through adoption, user satisfaction, delivery efficiency, incident reduction, and realized business value. Experience in collaborating, communicating and organising work effectively across global teams, suppliers and business stakeholders, including influencing decisions and building alignment. jobs.description: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Job Description Job Description What you get to do in this role: • Lead the design and delivery of complex components and services within the cloud-native platform, owning them from design through production operation. • Act as the technical lead for major features and initiatives within the team, translating ambiguous problems into clear, scalable, and executable designs. • Partner with Principal and Distinguished Engineers to ensure alignment with broader platform architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical strategy. • Identify technical risks early and drive them to resolution, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, operability, and engineering excellence. • Maintain a strong hands-on presence across the development lifecycle, including designing, coding, and reviewing core systems such as Kubernetes operators, controllers, infrastructure automation, and platform services. • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers while raising the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving. Qualifications To be successful in this role you have: • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work—AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run. • 12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native platforms in production environments. • Demonstrated experience building and operating Kubernetes platform infrastructure at scale, with ownership of platform capabilities through deployment, upgrades, and production operations. • Hands-on developing Kubernetes Operators, Admission Controllers, or other platform extensions using Kubebuilder, Operator Framework, or similar technologies. • Experience operating both managed Kubernetes services (EKS, AKS, GKE) and self-managed Kubernetes environments. • Experience supporting cloud-native database platforms, large-scale data infrastructure, or stateful services on Kubernetes. • Strong software engineering expertise in Go, with hands-on experience developing Kubernetes Operators, Controllers, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), and platform automation capabilities. • Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including orchestration, scheduling, security, storage, networking, and workload management. • Proven experience operating stateful and distributed workloads on Kubernetes, including databases, data services, or other mission-critical platform components. • Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including compute, networking, security, and identity management services. • Strong background designing and building microservices, event-driven systems, and distributed application architectures. • Experience owning complex technical initiatives end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation, deployment, and operational support. • Hands-on experience with containers, CI/CD, GitOps practices, and Infrastructure-as-Code using tools such as Terraform, Crossplane, or equivalent technologies. • Experience implementing observability and reliability best practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerting, and service-level objectives. • Proven ability to drive technical strategy through architectural design reviews, technical proposals, and cross-functional collaboration. • Good to have: • Experience with container networking (CNI) and/or service mesh. • Experience with mTLS, workload identity, and secrets management at fleet scale. • Experience with observability—metrics, tracing, and SLOs. • Experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar declarative infrastructure tooling. • Experience designing or tuning distributed data or compute workloads on Kubernetes. Distributed Systems Expertise • Experience with large‑scale deployments of distributed systems. • Deep knowledge of replication, fault-tolerant, and HA strategies. • Experience working in DevOps environments to operationalize distributed platforms. • Strong expertise in designing and architecting platforms using: • Kubernetes (workload deployments, upgrades, monitoring and maintenance) • Apache Kafka (high‑scale clusters, topic/partition strategies, HA) is a plus • Redis (high‑scale clusters, HA) is a plus • Expertise in data formats such as Parquet, ORC, and Avro, along with compaction and governance strategies. • Ability to build scalable, fault‑tolerant ingestion and transformation workflows. jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Collaborating closely with domain experts, software architects, and product teams, you will translate cutting-edge AI concepts—such as intelligent copilots, multi-step reasoning agents, and automated EDA verification assistants—into reliable, scalable, and high-impact solutions. Key Responsibilities • Design, implement, and deploy end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions integrated into EDA software workflows and developer environments. • Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). • Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. • Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. • Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. • Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications • 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. • Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. • Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). • Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. • Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. • Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. • Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills • Hands-on experience with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, dataset preparation/curation, or domain-specific model adaptation using Hugging Face TRL or Axolotl. • Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. • Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). • Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Diversity & Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday #LI-Hybrid #LI-EDA

jobs.title: Scaled AI & Solution Architect
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The Scaled AI & Solution Architect is the senior technical design authority for the Digital Quality (DQ) organisation, which delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer. The role is a global individual contributor position accountable for setting and driving the AI and solution architecture direction across the entire DQ product portfolio, rather than for the delivery of any single product. The incumbent defines the target architecture, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering standards that every DQ solution is built against, so that capability is built once and reused many times rather than rebuilt product by product. The role leads the scaled adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic AI across the portfolio, translating enterprise AI platforms and emerging technology into GxP-compliant, validated, production-grade capability that measurably improves quality, safety and environmental outcomes at site level. Recognised as an expert within and beyond Digital Quality, the incumbent influences the strategic technology direction of the QSEO business, and partners with Solution Leads, the Platform and Solution Engineering team, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security to ensure architectural coherence, compliance and pace across a complex global portfolio. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Cross-Product Solution Architecture Own the target-state solution architecture for the Digital Quality portfolio, spanning quality management, laboratory, manufacturing quality, and safety, environment and occupational health solutions. Define how products, platforms, data and integrations fit together, and drive convergence of point solutions onto common architecture, avoiding duplicated capability and unmanaged technical debt across the portfolio. Architecture Standards, Patterns and Reusable Components Establish, publish and maintain the architecture standards, reference patterns, reusable components and engineering guardrails that DQ solutions are designed and built against, covering integration, data, identity, AI, validation and cyber security. Make reuse the path of least resistance for delivery teams, and measure adoption, reuse and the resulting delivery efficiency. Scaled AI Enablement Define and drive the AI and agentic AI architecture for the DQ portfolio, including use case patterns such as deviation and incident triage, leading-indicator prediction, automated document and content generation, and conversational access to standards and procedures. Determine where AI capability should be built once as a shared service versus configured per product, and ensure AI is delivered on enterprise platforms with appropriate human oversight, evaluation, model monitoring and lifecycle management. Design Authority and Technical Governance Act as design authority for significant DQ investments, reviewing and approving solution designs at key lifecycle gates and providing architectural assurance on build-versus-buy, platform selection and vendor technical fit. Identify multiple viable options for highly complex problems, set out the trade-offs in cost, risk, compliance and time to value, and make clear recommendations to Digital and business leadership and relevant governance forums. Technical Leadership and Capability Building Provide hands-on architectural leadership to Solution Leads, Product Managers, engineers and vendor teams across the portfolio without direct reporting authority, influencing through expertise, credibility and evidence. Mentor and raise the technical capability of architects and engineers across Digital Quality, and lead architecture and AI Communities of Practice that spread good practice across DQ and the wider Digital organisation. Compliance, Data Integrity and Security by Design Ensure architectural decisions embed GxP computerised system compliance, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements from the outset, in partnership with Quality, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Cyber Security. Define validation-efficient architecture patterns that allow AI and cloud capability to be deployed at pace while remaining inspection-ready. Innovation and Emerging Technology Exercise foresight in evaluating emerging AI, data and platform technologies, and act independently on self-initiated proofs of concept and technical experiments that challenge the status quo and shape the multi-year DQ technology roadmap. Take appropriate, well-governed technical risk, and translate proven experiments into scaled, supportable production capability with a defined adoption path. QUALIFICATIONS Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Engineering, Environmental or Occupational Health Sciences, Life Sciences or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in in solution architecture, technical leadership or enterprise software delivery (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including demonstrable accountability for architecture across a portfolio of products rather than a single application. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI or machine learning capability into production, including an understanding of large language model and agentic architecture patterns, retrieval, evaluation and model lifecycle management. Strong experience with cloud, integration and data architecture, and with modern software engineering and Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred. Experience setting and driving adoption of technical standards across teams that do not report to the incumbent, influencing senior stakeholders through technical credibility. Experience across all stages of the system and application lifecycle, from value analysis and business case through deployment to value realisation and technical debt management. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation and data integrity expectations (e.g. GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11). Working knowledge of quality, or EHS business processes and the platforms that support them (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority). Experience deploying AI in a regulated context, including responsible AI governance, model risk assessment and human-in-the-loop design. Recognised architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF) or equivalent cloud architecture certification. Track record of external technical contribution — industry forums, working groups, publications or conference speaking. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Occasional travel up to 20% Ability to work with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms – Digital Quality Lead. Key internal relationships include Enterprise Architecture, the enterprise AI and Data organization, Cyber Security, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation, Legal and Privacy, and senior business stakeholders across Quality and EHS in Pfizer Global Supply. External: strategic software and AI vendors, cloud and platform providers, implementation and managed service partners, and relevant industry and regulatory technical forums. RESOURCES MANAGED Financial Accountability No direct budget ownership. Influences the architecture and technology decisions underpinning the Digital Quality portfolio representing approximately $10M of annual software, services and transformation investment, and is accountable for identifying reuse and rationalization opportunities that improve return on that investment Supervision Individual contributor with no direct reports. Provides technical direction and design authority to matrixed teams of product, engineering, data, validation and vendor resources across the Digital Quality portfolio, and mentors architects and senior engineers across the organization. Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 3
jobs.description: About the Role Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide. In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring. The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones. Key Responsibilities Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences. Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning. Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent). Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs. Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization. jobs.description: Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results.
