LET’S GO! ㅤ Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth & ML), Hyderabad Meet our Team Our Data & Audience Platform organization builds advanced AI/ML solutions that power identity, audience intelligence, advertising, and personalization at scale. Our Machine Learning Engineering team in Hyderabad develops foundational AI/ML capabilities that transform first-party data signals into production-ready machine learning systems. These solutions help expand addressable audiences, improve targeting and measurement, forecast demand, and personalize content discovery — driving advertising yield, marketing efficiency, user engagement, and retention. Our Machine Learning Engineers combine strong data science expertise with hands-on engineering capabilities to take models from development to production. This includes building production-grade ML data pipelines, model training and optimization, and scalable ML infrastructure such as feature stores, training and serving pipelines, and MLOps frameworks. We primarily leverage Databricks, along with Snowflake and AWS, and actively embrace emerging technologies, including agentic AI development workflows, to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent machine learning solutions . About the Role As a Senior MLE, you will own the design and delivery of production ML systems that directly impact audience targeting, advertising revenue, subscriber engagement, and retention across our global portfolio. You will lead technical execution on key workstreams — including probabilistic identity resolution, lookalike modeling, single-title affinity, and forecasting — while mentoring MLE 2s and collaborating closely with Staff MLEs and product stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for engineers with roughly 5–8 years of experience who can independently drive a project from problem framing through production deployment and monitoring. Roles & Responsibilities: ML System Design & Ownership Lead end-to-end development of production ML systems: data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Own key ML products such as probabilistic identity resolution (matching unauthenticated device IDs and 1P cookies to households/persons with calibrated confidence), single-title affinity (e.g., STAT two-tower retrieval), and audience/propensity models. Design scalable feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog) and the feature store, with documented feature contracts, backfill paths, and freshness SLAs. Architect batch and near-real-time inference pipelines integrated with Snowflake and activation systems (Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM). Modeling & Experimentation Develop and optimize models across the ML spectrum: gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), embedding/two-tower retrieval, neural ranking, probability calibration (e.g., isotonic regression), and probabilistic/graph-based matching. Design rigorous offline and online experiments; define evaluation frameworks (precision/recall, AUC-ROC, NDCG, decile lift, calibration curves) appropriate to each use case. Apply causal-inference techniques (propensity scoring, uplift/incrementality modeling) to measure true lift of audience targeting on engagement and retention KPIs. Contribute to lookalike modeling (LAL 2.0+) using 1,000+ first- and third-party features, including privacy-safe builds inside Data Clean Rooms (Snowflake DCR). MLOps & Infrastructure Champion MLOps best practices: model versioning, champion/challenger promotion, automated retraining triggers, drift detection, and production monitoring with MLflow on Databricks. Build and maintain robust, reproducible, auditable ML pipelines on Databricks (and AWS SageMaker where appropriate, e.g., the identity-resolution track); enforce leakage prevention and training/serving consistency. Contribute to the team’s feature-store strategy — feature contracts, backfills, and freshness SLAs — and implement data-quality checks, model-health dashboards, and alerting thresholds. Embed FinOps cost discipline (compute caps, auto-termination, job tagging) into pipeline design. Mentorship & Cross-functional Collaboration Mentor MLE 2s through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing; contribute to team technical standards. Partner with Product, Marketing, and Ad Sales to translate business requirements into ML problem formulations, and with Data Engineering on data contracts and pipeline SLAs. Communicate model performance, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Flagship Projects You’ll Work On Identity Intelligence — foundational, privacy-safe identity across all brands: probabilistic ID resolution that resolves unauthenticated signals to households/persons with calibrated confidence (entity resolution with gradient boosting and embeddings, representation learning, isotonic calibration, candidate blocking, champion/challenger pipelines), expanding addressable audiences beyond deterministic matching. Audience Intelligence — advertising and marketing use cases: lookalike and predictive audiences (LAL across 1,000+ features), ML-driven smart audiences, layered retrieval + propensity, and incrementality/closed-loop optimization, with privacy-safe activation including data clean rooms. ML-based Forecasting — audience growth, demand, and advertising yield/pricing forecasting that powers ad sales and marketing decisions. Content Preferences & Affinity — genre-preference, content-preference, and single-title affinity modeling (two-tower retrieval with semantic content embeddings) that ranks audiences for upcoming titles and powers cross-channel promotion. What You’ll Bring Required 5–8 years of industry experience in ML engineering or applied data science (3+ years with a Ph.D.). Deep Python expertise and production-quality software engineering practices; production experience building and deploying ML at scale (millions+ of users/records). Strong proficiency in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, MLflow, Unity Catalog) and solid SQL/Snowflake experience for feature sourcing and model-output delivery. Experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda). Strong understanding of ML model evaluation, A/B testing, and statistical inference; knowledge in one or more of recommendations & ranking, identity resolution, embeddings/retrieval, causal/interpretable ML, forecasting, bandits, or optimization. Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and mentor engineers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to advocate technical solutions to engineers, scientists, and product stakeholders. Preferred: Recommendation systems, personalization, identity resolution, or audience modeling in a media / streaming / ad-tech context. Familiarity with Data Clean Room environments (Snowflake DCR, AWS Clean Rooms) and consent-aware activation. Experience with two-tower / retrieval architectures, probabilistic identity resolution (graph-based matching, entity resolution), and probability calibration. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP), Databricks Genie Space configuration, and Snowflake Cortex. Experience with feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Tecton, Feast) and contributions to open source or ML publications. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. Write clean, tested, production-quality Python following engineering best practices (unit tests, code reviews, CI/CD). Use MLflow for experiment tracking, model registration, and versioning under the guidance of senior engineers. Support deployment and monitoring of batch inference jobs integrated with downstream activation platforms (e.g., Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM) and data in Snowflake. Leverage Databricks Genie for natural-language exploration of governed Unity Catalog datasets — querying ML feature tables, model outputs, and audience segments. Use Snowflake Cortex (Copilot / Cortex Analyst) to accelerate data analysis and SQL authoring against audience and identity schemas. You will spend most of your week in Claude Code and at the client, turning ambiguous business problems into working software — often within days, not months. This is the role at the front line of how the world's largest companies actually adopt AI. You will own a workstream end-to-end: sitting with client teams to understand their workflows, designing the solution, building it, demoing it, and getting it into production. You will collaborate closely with Anthropic, our other AI partners, and Genpact's industry and delivery teams to make sure what you build lasts after you leave. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity, and represent Genpact at the highest level inside customer environments. Stay current with the latest in LLM capabilities, agent frameworks, and the AI product development stack. Bring field insights back to our product and partner teams. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. Daily, hands-on working fluency with Claude (or a comparable frontier LLM) as a build tool — not as a chatbot. You use it to ship every day. Production experience with LLMs: advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills in Python and, ideally, one or more of TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or SQL. Experience shipping production applications. Track record of shipping something a customer or end-user actually paid for, used, or measured — a product, an internal tool, a notable open-source project, or a demo that closed a deal. Can hold your own in a client conversation with senior stakeholders. You do not need a PM to translate. High agency — comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex organizations and turning vague business problems into concrete technical plans. High cooperation mindset — you can balance competing priorities across customer teams, Genpact delivery, and partners with integrity. Hands-on experience with MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, LangGraph, etc.), evaluation tooling, or LLM observability. jobs.description: About Rubrik Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We’ve been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Job Introduction Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket. We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee’s access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is “My Digital Twin”, an agentic layer carrying an employee’s full context alongside the organization’s memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs. This is a multi-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip. The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global. The environment A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS and open source applications. Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc. Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc. VDI and remote desktop environments AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management) Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc. Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms and others What you will be doingRun the business: operational excellence today Own the global end-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones. Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all-hands production. Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees. Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you. Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow-the-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites. Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area. Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits. Represent operations in cross-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy & Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps. Change the business: build toward ticketless Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site. Re-architect hire-to-retire as event-driven rather than request-driven, so joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger provisioning, entitlements, device readiness, and access removal with no human in the loop. Build the organizational memory that “My Digital Twin” depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action. Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection. Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails. Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design. What we are looking forLeadership and operating track record Experience leading corporate IT, end-user services, or workplace technology at global scale, including managing managers and senior technical staff in more than one region. A track record of running a demanding environment well while changing it. We will ask for specifics on both. Fluency with AI and automation applied to operations: agents, workflow orchestration, integration across identity and ITSM systems, retrieval over internal knowledge. You need to know what is achievable, what is hype, and where the failure modes are. Hands-on depth in endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, MDM platforms, VDI, and AV and conferencing across multiple sites. Depth in identity and access (Okta or equivalent), SaaS administration, and public cloud environments. Practical experience putting enterprise AI tools in employees’ hands at scale, beyond pilots. Vendor management and procurement, plus IT technical program management with globally distributed teams, and the working habits that make distributed leadership effective across time zones. Executive presence and influence in a matrix organization, with the ability to develop senior leaders and build a culture of integrity, service excellence, accountability, and best practice sharing across sites. Security and compliance are treated as design constraints rather than obstacles, with exposure to SOC 2, SOX, or PCI cycles . AI-native depth, in a CorpIT context •     Demonstrated hands-on fluency with current generative AI tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where they don’t. •     Experience with AI-powered digital employee experience management platforms and endpoint telemetry, used to fix problems before employees report them. •     Experience deploying AI assistants or agents inside a corporate stack of identity, MDM, ITSM, and collaboration tools, including where human-in-the-loop approval belongs. •     Experience automating the employee lifecycle end to end, where joiner, mover, and leaver events drove provisioning and access through agentic tooling working from organizational memory rather than from a form. •     Experience running a service as a product measured on employee outcomes rather than ticket counts, with knowledge treated as a maintained asset. How we will know it is working A rising share of employee needs met with a north-star goal of no ticket ever filed. New hires are productive on day one, consistently and without expediting. Role changes and departures reflected in access automatically, within minutes. Autonomous resolution measured on quality and employee satisfaction, not closure. Support capacity per employee improves while experience scores rise, with clean audits throughout. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. Strong hands-on experience with inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d, or equivalent systems, along with LLM optimization techniques including continuous batching, quantization, KV-cache optimization, and speculative decoding. Please find the below JD and interested please apply on the below link!!! https://r.ripplehire.com/s/dfta1 Role summary A hands-on Data Tester to validate and protect the quality of data flowing through the Client data estate. The role tests data pipelines at every stage from source systems into the data lake, through transformation into the warehouse and data marts, and out to reports and turns repeatable checks into automated regression tests. The successful candidate works closely with the data engineers so that incident fixes, minor enhancements and releases go live without breaking downstream reporting. Core skills (must have) Data testing & platform ETL / data pipeline testing validating data between stages using the mapping and business rules of each pipeline. SQL advanced queries to compare, reconcile and profile data across Azure SQL / SQL Server and Databricks. Databricks & ADF understanding of pipelines, notebooks and Delta tables well enough to test them end to end. Test automation building automated regression suites using Python or an ETL testing framework. Report testing validating Power BI and SSRS outputs against source and warehouse data. Testing types covered Data completeness, volume and accuracy testing. Data consistency, type, range and relationship testing. Data transformation, enrichment and business-rule testing. Regression, smoke and release testing across all pipeline stages. Key responsibilities Design, run and maintain test cases for incident fixes, service requests and minor enhancements before they reach production. Test data across each pipeline stage source, data lake, transformation, warehouse, data marts and reports. Build and grow an automated regression pack so repeat testing is fast and reliable. Run reconciliation checks between source systems and the warehouse, and report exceptions clearly. Carry out smoke testing after deployments and overnight batch runs. Log, track and retest defects; support root cause analysis with the data engineers. Work with data quality tools (DQPro, Ataccama) to strengthen data quality rules and monitoring. Maintain test documentation, test data and evidence for release sign-off. Business & behavioral skills Attention to detail spots small data differences before users do. Business understanding — can test against what the data means for underwriting, claims and finance, not just row counts. Clear communication — reports defects and test results in plain language with business impact. Collaboration — works closely with engineers in an onshore/offshore support model. Nice to have ISTQB or equivalent testing certification; Databricks or Azure fundamentals. Experience with ETL test automation frameworks or data comparison utilities. Exposure to data quality tooling (DQPro, Ataccama) and insurance or financial services data.

jobs.description:

Senior Manager PROCESS TRANSFORMATION JOB DESCRIPTION The Senior Manager Process Transformation is responsible for leading and delivering mediumtolarge process reengineering and transformation programs across a portfolio of clients and internal initiatives, while playing a critical role in global and enterprisepriority transformation programs . The role operates at the business / LOB / project / process level , translating strategic transformation objectives into measurable business outcomes , and acts as a key bridge between Leadershiplevel strategy and onground execution , mentoring Managers. The role involves owning and executing clientfacing consulting engagements as well as internal transformation initiatives , sometimes as an independent contributor and at other times as part of larger crossfunctional teams. Most engagements are within the BFSI domain , with a strong focus on Investment Banking and Insurance , driving customerspecific goals such as cycletime reduction, cost optimization, productivity improvement, and operational KPI uplift . The incumbent is accountable for endtoend delivery of discrete transformation outcomes , including problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation support, and value realization. Strong consulting, communication (written and verbal), stakeholder management, and flexibility to travel are essential. The role also requires handson expertise in documenting, analyzing, reporting, and presenting consulting studies , supported by strong analytical and statistical capabilities , and the ability to influence stakeholders across client and internal leadership levels. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Transformation Delivery & Program Ownership Lead endtoend delivery of multiple transformation initiatives across portfolios or accounts. Translate enterprise or accountlevel strategy into execution roadmaps and value plans. Track benefits realization, KPIs, and financial impact. Consulting & Problem Solving Conduct and support leadership team in diagnostics, process assessments, and value discovery exercises. Structure complex business problems using Lean / Six Sigma methodologies. Develop executiveready insights, recommendations, and improvement roadmaps and present it with leadership team. Client & Stakeholder Management Engage with Account Leaders, Operations Heads, and Client SMEs. Act as a trusted advisor on efficiency, risk, scalability, and CX improvement. Support leadership reviews, steering committees, and governance forums. Digital, AI & Automation Enablement Identify and drive automation, RPA, AI, and workflow opportunities. Partner with IT, Digital, and vendor teams to implement solutions. Promote datadriven decision making through dashboards and analytics. Client Due Diligence & RFP Support endtoend due diligence and RFP / RFI / RFQ engagements. Conduct process maturity, risk, compliance, and scalability assessments. Develop effort estimates, business cases, and transformation solution inputs. People Leadership & Capability Building Lead and mentor Managers, Black Belts, and Consultants. Review project deliverables and ensure methodology adherence. Drive LSS projects, capability development training and consulting rigor. Governance & Compliance Ensure adherence to project governance framework. Ensure adherence to standard methodologies, templates, and governance. Identify execution risks and proactively mitigate issues. EDUCATION QUALIFIERS Qualifications MBA / Engineering (Tier 1 preferred) Degree / Masters degree in finance / business management - Mandate CERTIFICATION QUALIFIERS Lean Six Sigma Black Belt / Master Black Belt Mandate Minitab Tool Usage - Mandate Process Mapping Experience Business Optics, IBM Blue Works and Visio Mandate PMP - Preferred EXPERIENCE QUALIFIERS 1216+ years overall experience 07 - 10+ years in process excellence / consulting / transformation BPO / BFSI / Shared Services / Consulting exposure preferred Leadership, Consulting & Technical Skills Lean, Six Sigma, Process Re-engineering, Value Stream Mapping Structured problem solving and analytical thinking Strong stakeholder and executive communication Change management and influencing skills Exposure to RPA, AI, BPM tools, and analytics

jobs.title: Engineering Manager- Linux & Kernel
jobs.description:
Experience range: 12-17 Yrs
The Opportunity Nutanix AHV builds on top of the open-source x86-KVM stack, with an emphasis on performance, scale, and reliability. The hyperconverged nature of our stack provides the phenomenal potential for optimizations cutting across various parts of our stack -- right from the kernel and ranging up to, but not limited by, the management layer. We are looking for original thinkers who wont hesitate to demand conventional thought in arriving at out-of-the-box solutions. We aim to work as closely aligned with the open-source community as possible. Our engineers are highly encouraged to participate in open-source community development. Any work you do will be preserved as open-source commit(s) for posterity! A day in the life of an AHV hypervisor engineer: Problems you ll solve: We ve always believed in demanding the status quo and disrupting ourselves to provide the best in-class customer experience. A case in point: Nutanix is well known for providing a zero-touch upgrade experience for our customers. Within the hypervisor team, we are focussing on various ways to make this faster and more reliable -- by pushing the limits of VM live migrations towards speed and predictability, or rethinking why a hypervisor upgrade should need a reboot at all. About the Team At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Hypervisor team, a dynamic group that is spread out geographically. Despite being in different locations, the team collaborates effectively and maintains a strong sense of camaraderie. Working with the Hypervisor team means being surrounded by talented people who are supportive, making it a great team to work with. This setup also provides exciting exposure to diverse perspectives and opportunities for personal and professional growth. You will report to a Senior Manager who is committed to supporting your development and ensuring your success within the organization. This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i. e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. As for travel requirements, there are none, allowing you to focus on your projects without the need for frequent travel. Your Role You ll be managing a team of extremely talented engineers across a spectrum of geographies and experience. The most successful candidate for this role will be someone who can: Constantly look for ways to improve the product, learning from customer questions and not limited to existing technologies. Devise solutions and back them up with solid research and numbers to prove their efficacy. Have the ability to convey ideas to a geographically diverse audience using excellent communication/writing skills. Participate in design discussions, often outside one s known comfort zone -- learning on the go. Proactively mentor junior members of the team, finding ways to fuel their intelligent curiosity and leverage their unique strengths. Not hesitate to help out with occasional customer escalations: Nutanix believes in putting customers first. While we have a huge, dedicated team to assist customers with any issues, there might be situations where engineering help might be sought to bail out a rare, unfortunate outage. Take pride in working with open-source communities to fold product improvements back into community projects. What You Will Bring The must-haves: Rock-solid OS/systems fundamentals drive design and implementation. Low-level coding and debugging experience with at least one hardware architecture, preferably x86. The ability to write and maintain enterprise-quality code. Deep reasoning and detailed skills, which provide top-down thinking to break down abstract concepts into actionable pieces. Proven feature delivery experience: should have 8+ years of hands-on experience of what it means to ship enterprise-quality code to customers. The good-to-haves: Knowledge of x86 virtualization and the KVM stack. Code contributions to the Linux kernel/virtualization stack is an added plus. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA). Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do. As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset. We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide. About the team The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. ServiceNow Engineer About Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. About the IT Organization Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise. Digital Core is at the forefront of digitalization to enable and advance the entire company, with increased productivity and best-in-class Customer experiences. This team provides a robust and sustainable infrastructure of hardware, software and services that are critical to enable our global workforce. As leaders in technology, this team defines and leads the overall company technology strategy. About the Team Global Service Management (GSM) team works to enable Lilly to enhance global productivity and protect our Brand. The team manages the industry leading ServiceNow enterprise platform. We enable our 69k global workforce to accelerate how they work, manage critical action plans, and enhance their working methods/environment, and manage key vendor contracts / spending. In addition to maintaining operational excellence for our existing services, we must boldly innovate and enhance capabilities such as generative AI, automation & workflows across the enterprise. This will enable us to enhance our return on investment, improve user efficiency and experience, and help support the broader Company purpose of making life better for people around the world. You'll drive platform innovation, lead technical delivery, and ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, CMDB, and configuration management principles. Proven experience leading technical delivery across the full software lifecycle. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and commitment to excellence. A passion for mentoring, learning, and driving cross-functional success. jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect (DPO)
jobs.description: Job Summary Agentic QA Solution Architect Quality Solution Architect for AI Agents & Agentic Automation About the Role AI agents are non-deterministic: the same input can produce different outputs across runs. Testing them requires a fundamentally different discipline than scripted test automation - evaluation frameworks, scoring functions, and statistical judgment instead of exact-match assertions. As an Agentic QA Engineer, you will bring that discipline directly to our customers. This is a forward-deployed, customer-facing engineering role. You will work side by side with enterprise customers to design, build, test, and harden agentic workflows in their live environments - combining the hands-on coding of a software engineer, the quality mindset of a test automation expert, and the end-to-end design perspective of a solution architect. You will own the question every customer asks before putting an AI agent into production: "How do we know we can trust it?" Key Responsibilities What You Will Do Deploy and validate agentic solutions at customers. Work with enterprise customers to implement, integrate, and operationalize AI agents and agentic workflows in production environments - including APIs, data pipelines, and integration with existing customer systems. Design testing agents and evaluation strategies for deterministic and non-deterministic systems. Define what "quality" means for each agentic use case and turn it into measurable signals: evaluation suites, scoring functions, regression baselines, and pass/fail criteria that account for variability in agent behavior. Build and run evaluation frameworks. Implement automated evals (LLM-as-judge, semantic similarity, structured-output checks, human annotation rubrics) that track accuracy, latency, and cost across agent runs, and compare every release against baselines to catch regressions. Perform adversarial and safety testing. Probe agents for failure modes, hallucinations, prompt-injection vulnerabilities, and out-of-scope actions; validate guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and escalation paths before go-live. Automate the testing lifecycle. Build and maintain automated test suites for both deterministic components (integrations, workflows, UI) and agentic components, wired into CI/CD so quality gates run on every deployment. Act as a trusted technical advisor. Translate customer requirements into solution and test architecture; explain evaluation results, risks, and trade-offs to audiences ranging from QA engineers to non-technical executives. Architect for scale. Apply solution-architecture judgment to design quality strategies that span the full solution - agents, RPA/workflow/tools automation, integrations, and human-in-the-loop steps - and that customers can operate and extend themselves. Close the loop with product and engineering. Feed field findings - failure patterns, missing capabilities, evaluation gaps - back into the product roadmap and internal best practices, and contribute to reusable test assets and accelerators. Skill Requirements What You Bring (Required) Software engineering foundation. 7+ years of hands-on software development experience in Python, C#, VB.NET, or comparable languages, with the ability to write production-quality code and test harnesses. Testing and QA depth. 3+ years in software testing / test automation, including test strategy design, automated test frameworks, and CI/CD-integrated quality gates. Hands-on experience with AI agents. Practical experience building, deploying, or testing LLM-based agents and agentic workflows (e.g., tool/function calling, RAG, multi-step orchestration, frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol), ideally in customer or production settings. LLM evaluation literacy. Working understanding of non-determinism, prompting, grounding, and hallucination, and experience setting up evals - including LLM-as-judge approaches, rubric-based scoring, and regression testing of model or prompt changes. Customer-facing experience. Proven track record in a forward-deployed, professional services, implementation, or consulting role: leading technical workshops, managing stakeholder expectations, and delivering under real-world constraints in customer environments. Solution architecture background. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across applications, APIs, and automation platforms - able to see the whole system, not just the component under test. Communication. Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting technical findings and quality risks to executive stakeholders. Fluent English. Must Have Skill UiPath Agentic AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements What Sets You Apart (Preferred) Experience with agentic testing or AI-augmented QA platforms (e.g., UiPath Test Cloud / Test Manager, or comparable AI-powered testing tools) and with automation platforms more broadly (RPA, workflow orchestration). Experience with evaluation and observability tooling for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Braintrust, Promptfoo, or custom pytest-based eval harnesses) and with tracing/monitoring agent behavior in production. Statistical literacy - able to distinguish signal from noise in non-deterministic outputs and reason about sample sizes, baselines, and confidence. Experience with test management and ALM tooling (e.g., ADO, Jira - Xray, TestRail, Test Manager) and requirements-to-test traceability. Knowledge of AI governance, safety, and compliance considerations for deploying agents in regulated industries. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. How Success Is Measured Customers move agentic use cases from pilot to production with documented, repeatable evaluation and test coverage. Evaluation suites catch regressions before customers do - measured by escaped-defect and eval-coverage trends. Customer stakeholders trust and understand the quality evidence behind every go-live decision. Field learnings are converted into reusable test assets, patterns, and product feedback.

jobs.description: Company Overview Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and versatile AI / Machine Learning Engineer with 3–10 years of experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI-powered capabilities across our electronic design and verification tools. In this hands-on engineering role, you will contribute to the design and implementation of AI/ML pipelines and Agentic AI systems, bridge modern GenAI architectures with robust software engineering, and integrate intelligent capabilities directly into engineering workflows. Build and enhance intelligent agent systems capable of automated reasoning, planning, multi-step execution, and tool usage using modern frameworks (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, etc.). Develop and optimize production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, leveraging vector databases, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, and semantic reranking. Build robust data preprocessing, feature extraction, model inference, and evaluation pipelines adhering to clean code, testability, and CI/CD practices. Work closely with domain experts (chip design, verification), product managers, and core software engineering teams to formulate AI use cases, prototype solutions rapidly, and harden them into production. Ensure robust model safety, evaluation against hallucinations, prompt injection defenses, IP protection, and compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. Qualifications 3 to 10 years of professional software engineering and AI/ML experience, with proven hands-on involvement in taking AI/ML or LLM-based solutions from concept to production. Strong proficiency in Python with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modular architecture, and automated testing (pytest, CI/CD). Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs/GNNs), feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics. Practical experience building applications with foundational LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, etc.), prompt engineering best practices, and Agentic design patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, tool calling). Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Proficiency with modern ML and AI development libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or LangGraph. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases). We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build—guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement—are reliable, accurate, and release-ready. Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices. Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts. Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators. Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage. User Documentation Create and update user manuals. Core Skills: Quality mindset with a development background. Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily. Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English. Interested in continuously extending testing know-how. Curious and pragmatic about AI—applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output. Qualifications: Essential Skills and Experience 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA. Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience. Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git. Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows. Experience testing AI-powered features (e.g., chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency. jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Finance
jobs.description: Overview: Analyst, Cockpit Reporting & AI-Enabled Solutions. Digital Planning Transformation | Global Finance Cockpit Team Why this role exists. Cockpit is the single reporting platform behind the organization's financial planning: 7,000+ users, 175,000+ views every month, with all Operating Units converging onto one standard. The dashboards are largely built. What we're building now is different. We want reporting that maintains itself: dashboards that validate their own numbers, documentation that writes itself, insights that reach people without someone spending a Tuesday assembling them by hand. That's where we intend to be in two years. We are not there yet, and we're hiring the person who helps us get there. Generative AI is already part of how this team works. It isn't a pilot or a side project. But we care far more about someone who can tell when a model is confidently wrong than someone who has collected prompting tricks. What you'll actually do. Build reporting people rely on (the core of the job)Sit with Operating Units and Finance teams to understand what they actually need, which is usually not what they first asked for. Build financial performance dashboards with real drill-down, following our standard frameworks Improve what already exists: faster, clearer, more consistent Watch how people really consume the data, from analysts to senior leaders, and redesign around what you see. Apply our data security and FP&A reporting standards. We'll teach you these, and you'll follow them carefully Make the work smarter (this part grows as you do)Use AI in daily delivery: drafting documentation, writing and debugging calculations and SQL, accelerating requirements analysis Build and refine prompts for the things we do repeatedly (validation, documentation, quality checks) and improve them based on whether the output actually got better Catch AI's mistakes before a business user does: invented logic, results that don't reconcile, errors that fail silently Find the manual, repetitive parts of our reporting cycle and propose how to automate them Grow into shaping our AI validation and quality frameworks alongside the teamwork with people. Partner with S&T so business requirements survive the translation into Cockpit Help train and support Cockpit usersTake on high-priority projects as they come upWhat we need from you Genuinely required0 to 2 years of experience in analytics, reporting, data or engineering. Internships, academic work and personal projects all count. Hands-on with at least one BI or data tool. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, or a data-engineering background built on SQL, Python and pipelines. We don't need a Tableau expert. We build them. Most people here are productive in Tableau within a few months. What we need is someone who has already built something real with data and can walk us through the decisions they made and why. You use generative AI for real work, not just chat. Show us one concrete thing you built, automated or solved faster because of it.Basic SQL. You can read a query, understand a join, and trace where a number came from. You check whether a number makes sense before you publish it. This matters more than any tool on this list. Decent English, written and spoken. Comfort with things being unfinished. Our tooling changes every few months. That's the job, not a defect in it.Helpful, but not expected Python, Databricks, or any cloud data platform APIs, automation tools, or anything you've built with AI beyond a chat window. Finance or FP&A background, or familiarity with P&L and performance reporting. Data modeling fundamentals (grain, joins, single source of truth)Not requiredTableau certification. Prior finance work experience. Having done this exact job before. If you're strong on judgment and genuinely fluent with AI, apply. We'll teach you the rest. What you'll be in 18 months. You'll understand how a global company actually plans and measures itself, and you'll have built reporting that thousands of people use to make real decisions. You'll be fluent in Tableau, working well past dashboard-building, and helping define how an AI-enabled reporting function operates. Very few people anywhere have done that yet. This role sits where finance, data and AI meet, and that intersection is where the interesting careers are being built right now. How we'll assess you1. A dashboard you build on your own time. We'll send you a dataset and a short brief. Build something you'd be comfortable putting in front of a finance team. Use whatever tool you're strongest in: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Python, or something else. We are not testing which software you know.2. A conversation about what you built. You'll walk us through your reasoning: the design choices, what the data let you say and what it didn't, and where you weren't sure. Then we'll ask you to make a couple of changes to it live, with us. That's not a trap. It's the closest thing to how this job actually feels when a stakeholder changes their mind mid-review.3. A conversation about AI on real work. How you use it day to day, and how you decide whether to trust what it hands you. Using AI on the exercise is fine and expected. Just be ready to explain what you used it for and how you verified it. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards, reports, and scorecards. Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into BI solutions. Write complex SQL queries and scripts to extract, transform, and validate data. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and business insights. Optimize Tableau workbooks and SQL queries for performance and scalability. Develop and maintain data models, data sources, and metadata documentation. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Work closely with business teams, data engineers, and analysts to deliver reporting requirements. Automate recurring reporting processes and improve operational efficiency. Troubleshoot data discrepancies and resolve dashboard-related issues. Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience in Tableau dashboard development and SQL programming. Strong expertise in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server/Cloud, and Tableau Prep. Advanced SQL skills with experience in writing complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. Experience working with large datasets and relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar. Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and data modeling. Experience gathering business requirements and working directly with stakeholders. Knowledge of KPI development, data visualization best practices, and dashboard design principles. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments. Exposure to FP&A, Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, or Operations reporting domains.

jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Job ID PRINC020374 Employment Type Regular Work Style on-site Location Noida,UP,India Role Principal Software Engineer- Eng Why UKG: At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. Role Overview We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to join the engineering team for the WFM platform product. This role is focused on leading the technical direction, architecture, and engineering strategy for a modern, scalable, resilient, and intelligent enterprise SaaS product platform. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in defining the technology stack, shaping the technical roadmap, driving architectural decisions, and leading complex engineering initiatives across multiple teams. You will be expected to bring deep technical expertise, enterprise-scale thinking, and a strong understanding of performance, reliability, observability, and operational excellence. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can guide engineering teams through agentic SDLC, complex design decisions, lead technical discussions, troubleshoot critical technical issues, and build scalable and secure platform. The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in Java, database technologies, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI-assisted software engineering practices. We are looking for an engineer who combines strategic technical vision with practical execution, mentors senior engineers, raises engineering standards, and helps build a product platform that is scalable, secure, observable, performant, and ready for the future. Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Architecture Define and drive the architectural vision for the WFM platform, ensuring scalability, resiliency, performance, maintainability, and long-term extensibility. Lead the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the core technology stack, including application frameworks, cloud-native services, database technologies, observability tools, messaging systems, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities. Define and influence the technical roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, product management, architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders. Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex product and platform initiatives. Provide technical direction across multiple teams and ensure alignment with enterprise engineering standards, security expectations, and operational goals. Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices to continuously improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and system reliability. Software Engineering & Platform Development Design and build highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native enterprise platform. Lead the development of distributed systems, APIs, backend services, event-driven workflows, and data-intensive applications. Drive modernization initiatives that improve system performance, scalability, maintainability, and engineering velocity. Establish and promote engineering best practices around code quality, testing, automation, design patterns, performance optimization, and maintainable architecture. Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders. Ensure the product is built with an enterprise-level mindset, including strong consideration for scalability, compliance, security, availability, customer experience, and operational readiness. Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence Drive platform-wide improvements in observability, monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health management. Define and implement observability standards using platforms and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or similar technologies. Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, system failures, and reliability concerns. Partner with engineering, operations, and SRE teams to define service-level objectives, operational metrics, error budgets, incident response practices, and reliability improvement plans. Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions result in long-term improvements to architecture, automation, resiliency, and monitoring. Champion proactive engineering practices that improve product stability, reduce operational risk, and enhance customer trust. Performance Engineering & Scalability Drive performance tuning across application services, database layers, APIs, integration points, and distributed system components. Identify and resolve scalability challenges in high-volume, enterprise-grade SaaS environments. Lead capacity planning, load testing, profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and performance benchmarking efforts. Ensure that technical designs account for throughput, latency, concurrency, data growth, resiliency, and cost efficiency. Partner with teams to establish measurable performance goals and continuously improve system responsiveness and efficiency. AI-First Engineering & Agents Bring strong insight into AI trends, AI-assisted engineering, intelligent automation, and agent-based capabilities. Drive adoption of AI tools and practices to improve software design, development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows. Identify opportunities to leverage AI and agents within the engineering lifecycle and product ecosystem to improve productivity, quality, and customer value. Guide teams on responsible AI usage, including security, privacy, governance, explainability, and reliability considerations. Evaluate AI-enabled platforms, developer tools, observability assistants, coding agents, and automation frameworks that can improve engineering outcomes at scale. Database & Data Architecture Provide technical leadership in database design, data modeling, query optimization, transaction management, and scalable data access patterns. Work with relational and non-relational database technologies to support enterprise-grade application requirements. Guide teams in designing reliable, performant, and maintainable database solutions that support high-volume data processing and business-critical workflows. Lead troubleshooting of complex database performance issues, including indexing, locking, query plans, connection management, data partitioning, and schema evolution. Ensure data architecture decisions align with security, compliance, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability goals. Security, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness Champion secure software design and development practices across the product. Ensure systems are designed with strong consideration for authentication, authorization, data protection, encryption, auditability, and secure integration patterns. Promote enterprise readiness through resilient architecture, operational maturity, compliance awareness, and high-quality engineering standards. Partner with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure technical solutions align with organizational governance and risk management expectations. Technical Mentorship & Influence Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and development teams on architecture, design, engineering practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making. Lead technical discussions with clarity, influence, and strong engineering judgment. Build consensus across teams on complex architecture and design decisions. Raise engineering standards through design reviews, technical coaching, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 16+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building enterprise-scale software products. Strong proficiency in Java, including modern Java frameworks, backend service development, concurrency, performance tuning, and scalable application design. Deep experience with database technologies, including relational databases, SQL optimization, schema design, transaction management, indexing strategies, and performance troubleshooting. Proven experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native enterprise applications. Strong understanding of observability platforms, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, capacity planning, caching, query optimization, and system tuning. Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture, operational readiness, resiliency, availability, security, and scalability. Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions, define technical roadmaps, and influence engineering direction across multiple teams. Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers. Strong understanding of AI-assisted software engineering practices, AI tools, and emerging agent-based development or automation models. Excellent communication, collaboration, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers. Experience defining or evolving a product-level technology stack and long-term technical roadmap. Expertise with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging platforms, distributed caching, and asynchronous processing patterns. Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale architecture evolution initiatives. Strong knowledge of secure software development, compliance-aware design, and enterprise integration patterns. Experience with AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling. Demonstrated ability to mentor senior technical talent and establish engineering standards across teams. Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical problem solving and delivery execution. Key Attributes Strategic technical thinker with strong execution discipline. Hands-on engineering leader who can guide architecture while also diving deep into technical issues. Strong enterprise mindset with focus on reliability, performance, observability, scalability, and security. Clear communicator who can lead technical discussions and influence decisions across teams. Passionate about engineering excellence, innovation, AI-first development, and continuous improvement. Comfortable working in complex environments with multiple stakeholders, systems, and priorities. Company Overview: UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. Must have skills : SAP PO/PI & APIs Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent Build AI native enterprise integration solutions using SAP Process Orchestration / Process Integration (PO/PI) and modern API-led connectivity. This role combines deep PO/PI integration engineering (interface design, mappings, adapters, monitoring) with agentic AI patterns (LLM + tools + retrieval + evaluation) to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and modernize legacy integration estates into measurable, production-grade integration products. Core Responsibilities 1) Enterprise Integration Engineering (PO/PI Core) Design and deliver end-to-end integrations across SAP and non SAP systems using PO/PI runtime capabilities. Build interface contracts (message types, service interfaces), implement routing, transformation, enrichment, correlation, and exception handling patterns. Develop and maintain integration artifacts in the repository and configuration layers, ensuring consistency and reusability. 2) Adapter & Connectivity Development Implement integrations using common enterprise adapters (e.g., IDoc, RFC, File/SFTP, HTTP/REST, SOAP, JDBC, JMS, Mail) depending on landscape requirements. Engineer secure connectivity patterns (certificates, credentials, encryption) and define transport-level controls aligned to enterprise policies. 3) Mapping & Transformation Engineering Build message mappings and operation mappings for complex transformation needs, including context-based routing, reusable mapping functions, and XSLT where required. Implement advanced transformation logic using Java mappings or script-based approaches when standard mappings are insufficient. Design canonical payloads to reduce point-to-point complexity and support long-term maintainability. 4) API Development & API-Led Integration Design, build, and expose APIs for integration consumption with a focus on contract-first design, versioning strategy, and backward compatibility. Implement policies for security, throttling, validation, and observability enable consistent API governance across teams. Support API testing and lifecycle automation through robust test harnesses and environment promotion practices. 5) Testing, Debugging & Quality Engineering Create integration test strategies covering contract tests, schema validation, payload regression, replay testing, and negative scenarios. Use API testing tools and structured logs/traces to debug and resolve integration defects across layers (connectivity, mapping, runtime, downstream dependencies). Maintain technical documentation (specs, mappings, test cases, runbooks) as part of delivery and handover. 6) Monitoring, Operations & Reliability Monitor interfaces, queues, and runtime health implement alerting and dashboards aligned to SLAs and operational KPIs. Build failure-mode handling (retries, reprocessing, dead-letter/error queues, idempotency patterns) to reduce incident frequency and mean-time-to-recover. Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive fixes to improve stability over time. 7) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can: o Draft interface specifications and mapping proposals from requirements and standards. o Generate initial mapping logic and routing templates, then validate against enterprise patterns. o Recommend remediation steps grounded in runbooks, prior incidents, and observed runtime signals. Implement retrieval-grounded assistance for integration engineering (interface catalogs, mapping rules, known errors, operational runbooks) so outputs stay verifiable and consistent. Establish evaluation loops (offline golden tests + online monitoring) to measure accuracy of AI-generated mappings, recommendations, and troubleshooting outputs. Enforce guardrails: tool permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact changes, and strict handling of sensitive data. 8) Modernization & Transition Enablement Support modernization from legacy or tightly-coupled integrations toward API-led and cloud-ready patterns while keeping business continuity. Refactor legacy mappings (e.g., complex Java mappings) into maintainable equivalents where required, improving performance and operability. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PO/PI integration development: repository/configuration artifacts, interface design, mappings, and runtime troubleshooting. Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns: routing, transformation, correlation, retries, idempotency, and error handling. Experience with a broad range of adapters/connectivity patterns and secure transport practices. API engineering fundamentals: contract-first design, versioning, security policies, observability, and testing. AI-native build capability: tool-augmented workflows, retrieval-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Java-based mapping development and advanced transformation techniques (including XSLT where applicable). Exposure to hybrid integration landscapes and migration from legacy integration styles to modern API-led approaches. Strong documentation and operational readiness practices (runbooks, knowledge base, incident patterns). Familiarity with cloud integration concepts to support coexistence and transition strategies. What This Role Does Not Center On Training or fine-tuning foundation models from scratch. AI-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration lifecycle (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability). Value Delivered Faster delivery of integrations and APIs through intelligent generation of specs/mappings/templates and grounded troubleshooting. Improved reliability through robust testing, observability, and AI-augmented incident response with strict governance. Scalable integration modernization by evolving PO/PI estates toward API-led, reusable, and maintainable integration products. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education
