jobs.title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon. We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches. Key job responsibilities As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will: Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off. Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase. Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response. Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on. Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does. You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role. A day in the life You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate. About the team Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience Experience in automation testing Experience in manual testing Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience scripting or coding Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Description Are you a hands-on engineer who wants to build AI agents that do real work? Not demos, but agents that provision infrastructure, investigate incidents, answer the questions engineers would otherwise file a ticket for, and take action safely on production systems? Our technology organization runs the cloud, compute, and network platforms that thousands of engineers across Thomson Reuters build on, spanning AWS, Azure, and our own data centers. We are rethinking how that platform is built and operated, with AI agents and automation taking on work that used to require tickets, runbooks, and manual toil. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead that work. We are a software engineering team within Thomson Reuters’ technology organization. We design and build AI agents, agent tooling, and infrastructure automation that change how technology teams across the company work. We also own and evolve internal platform and developer tools used by engineers across the company. We place a high degree of trust in our engineers and expect them to deliver. We move quickly, ship to production, and learn from what our users actually do. In return, you will have interesting problems, the resources to solve them, and real room to shape how a large enterprise adopts AI. Key Responsibilities We build for production, so a prototype is a starting point, not a deliverable. We eliminate toil by design, asking whether software, automation, or an agent should handle repetitive work. We use AI in our own development workflow and apply engineering judgment to everything it produces. We reuse before we build, and we value aptitude and judgment over experience with any specific toolset. Design and build AI agents that reason over context, call tools, and take action on real systems, from single-purpose assistants to multi-step workflows with human approval where it matters. Build the APIs, MCP servers, and integrations that give agents safe, well-scoped access to cloud providers, source control, service management, observability, and internal platforms. Build infrastructure-as-code, pipelines, and self-service capabilities that let engineers get what they need without waiting on a person. Own production-grade concerns for agents, including evaluation and regression testing, observability, cost and latency management, guardrails, least-privilege access, defenses against prompt injection, and auditability. Lead technically by owning the design of major systems, writing clear design documents, leading design and code reviews, establishing reusable patterns and standards, and mentoring engineers across the team. Apply judgment about when AI fits, recognizing when a deterministic script, a better API, or a process change is the right answer and making that case clearly. Partner with platform, cloud, security, and SRE teams, and with the stakeholders whose work is being automated, to turn ambiguous problems into well-defined solutions. Required Qualifications 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating production systems. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Python is the primary language and experience with it is a plus, but strong engineers from Go, TypeScript, C#, Java, or similar backgrounds who are ready to work in Python are welcome. Hands-on experience building applications or agents on large language models, including tool and function calling, context management, retrieval (RAG), and structured outputs, with a practical understanding of failure modes such as hallucination, non-determinism, and prompt injection. Experience with AWS and/or Azure and with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Bicep. Experience with modern delivery practices, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines), automated testing, and containers. A secure-by-design mindset, especially when giving software the ability to act on production systems. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a strong design document and explain complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences. A track record of technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading through influence, and raising the quality of a team’s work. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks and SDKs such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Understanding of what these frameworks abstract is valued more than experience with any one of them. Experience designing evaluation suites for LLM systems, or with LLM observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith). Experience with Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or event-driven systems. Background in platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps, including on-call and incident response. Familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, firewalls, cloud networking) or IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow. Experience working in large, regulated, or compliance-conscious enterprise environments. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You? Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About Tech@Lilly At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. Principal Engineer – Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms (R3) About the Role As a Principal Engineer – Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale production systems, cloud platforms, and AI-powered applications. You will drive reliability, operational excellence, observability, automation, and resiliency across multiple products and platforms while serving as a trusted engineering leader for critical business services. This role combines deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, operational ownership, and strategic thinking. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations teams to establish reliability standards, eliminate operational toil through automation, improve system resilience, and ensure mission-critical services operate securely and efficiently at scale. What You'll Be Doing Technical Leadership & Strategy Define and drive the operational engineering strategy for enterprise applications, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled systems. Establish standards for reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence. Lead architecture reviews with a focus on supportability, observability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and long-term sustainability. Provide technical leadership during major incidents, service disruptions, and high-severity production events. Influence product and engineering roadmaps to proactively address technical debt, operational risks, and reliability improvements. Production Operations & Reliability Engineering Own reliability outcomes through Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and operational health metrics. Drive adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and operational excellence practices across teams. Lead complex root cause investigations involving distributed systems, cloud platforms, integrations, databases, and AI services. Establish operational readiness reviews, production acceptance criteria, release governance, and supportability standards. Define and implement resiliency engineering practices including failover validation, disaster recovery testing, capacity planning, and business continuity programs. Drive continuous improvement through incident trend analysis, reliability metrics, and operational insights. AI Platform & Agent Operations Provide technical leadership for AI-powered applications, copilots, virtual assistants, chatbots, and agent-based systems operating in production environments. Establish operational standards for Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, vector databases, MCP ecosystems, and orchestration platforms. Lead investigations involving AI model failures, retrieval issues, prompt orchestration, tool-calling workflows, agent interactions, and integration failures. Define monitoring strategies for AI quality, token consumption, latency, throughput, reliability, and operational health. Drive AI governance, responsible AI practices, security, compliance, and operational risk management. Automation & Operational Excellence Lead initiatives to eliminate manual operational effort through automation, intelligent workflows, self-healing capabilities, and autonomous remediation. Design and implement operational automation using scripting, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and AIOps solutions. Establish enterprise runbooks, playbooks, operational standards, and knowledge management frameworks. Drive adoption of platform engineering principles to improve reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. Collaboration & Mentorship Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to improve service quality and customer outcomes. Mentor engineers and technical leaders in reliability engineering, distributed systems, cloud operations, and AI platform support. Communicate technical risks, operational health, and strategic recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders. Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve reliability, resilience, supportability, and operational maturity across the organisation. How You Will Succeed Demonstrate exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and systems-thinking capabilities across complex distributed environments. Drive measurable improvements in service reliability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency. Build scalable observability, monitoring, tracing, and automation capabilities that proactively detect and resolve issues. Operate effectively across application, platform, infrastructure, cloud, and AI technology stacks. Influence engineering organisations through technical leadership, collaboration, and data-driven decision making. Balance business priorities, operational risk, engineering investment, and long-term sustainability. Establish measurable operational KPIs, SLOs, SLIs, and reliability programmes. Become the escalation point for the most complex technical and operational challenges. What You Should Bring Experience 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Production Operations, or related disciplines. Proven experience operating and supporting large-scale enterprise production environments. Experience leading reliability, operational excellence, and platform transformation initiatives. Demonstrated success driving operational improvements across multiple products, systems, and teams. Experience operating within regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Healthcare, Financial Services, or similar environments. Technical Expertise Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms. Strong understanding of software architecture, performance engineering, resiliency, security, and operational excellence. Advanced troubleshooting capabilities across applications, integrations, databases, networking, infrastructure, and cloud services. Experience leading major incident management, post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, and corrective action programmes. Strong understanding of governance, compliance, risk management, and secure engineering practices. Cloud & Platform Engineering Skills Expert knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or GCP cloud platforms. Experience designing and supporting highly available, fault-tolerant, enterprise-scale cloud architectures. Strong expertise with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration technologies. Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or similar platforms. Deep understanding of networking, identity management, security, and cloud governance. Experience implementing platform engineering principles and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs). Strong knowledge of high availability, failover, disaster recovery, backup, and resilience engineering concepts. DevOps, SRE & Automation Skills Expert understanding of SRE principles, reliability engineering, error budgets, SLOs, and SLIs. Strong experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and modern deployment automation platforms. Proven experience implementing self-healing systems, automated remediation, and operational automation solutions. Deep expertise with observability platforms including OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or equivalent technologies. Experience implementing AIOps, intelligent alerting, event correlation, and operational analytics platforms. Strong automation and scripting capabilities using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies. AI & Emerging Technology Skills Strong understanding of Generative AI ecosystems and enterprise AI architecture patterns. Experience supporting: LLM-based Applications Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems Agentic Workflows Semantic Search Platforms Vector Databases AI Orchestration Frameworks Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Services, or similar AI platforms. Understanding of MCP Server architecture, MCP Clients, Tool Calling, Enterprise AI integrations, and AI platform operations. Experience monitoring AI reliability, latency, throughput, token consumption, usage patterns, and operational health metrics. Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, security, compliance, model evaluation, and operational risk management. jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 The Team The Cyber Fusion Center protects the business by combining threat intelligence, monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, and security automation into one proactive, intelligence-led defense capability. By breaking down silos, the team reduces risk and strengthens security across the enterprise. The team prioritizes collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, with shared ownership of outcomes and a supportive learning mindset during high-pressure situations. This is a hands-on, build-driven environment where team members work with real-world use cases, rapidly develop new capabilities, and continuously improve the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to emerging threats. Responsibilities and Impact Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality detections for threats including malware, ransomware, identity attacks, insider threats, cloud threats, network, AI, and advanced persistent threats. Develop detection logic across SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, network, identity, and application security platforms using tools such as Splunk SPL, Microsoft Sentinel KQL, Elastic Query DSL, Sigma, and YARA. Apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science techniques to identify anomalous behavior, emerging threats, attack patterns, and indicators of compromise. Build and maintain security analytics and data pipelines using Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and Databricks. Perform feature engineering, statistical analysis, model development, testing, tuning, and performance monitoring for security use cases. Conduct threat hunting and hypothesis-driven investigations to identify gaps in existing detection coverage. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and improve coverage of priority attack techniques. Analyze false positives, false negatives, alert quality, and detection performance, implementing improvements based on measurable results. Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, SOAR, Cloud Security, and Vulnerability Management teams to develop effective detection capabilities. Implement detection-as-code practices using version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and controlled deployment. Support purple-team exercises, adversary simulations, attack replay, and detection validation activities. Explore the use of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and Agentic AI to improve threat research, detection development, alert analysis, and investigations. Develop Power BI dashboards and reports to communicate detection coverage, alert trends, model performance, data quality, and operational metrics. Document detection logic, data sources, analytical methods, model limitations, investigation procedures, and response recommendations. What We’re Looking For Five or more years of experience in cybersecurity, threat detection, detection engineering, threat hunting, security analytics, or a related field. Strong knowledge of security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, attack techniques, and enterprise security technologies. Hands-on experience developing detections for SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud, network, identity, or application security platforms. Strong Python and SQL skills, including experience processing and analyzing large security datasets. Practical experience with data science and machine learning methods, including: Data preparation and exploratory analysisFeature engineeringAnomaly detectionClassification and clusteringModel evaluation and performance tuning Experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, or equivalent tools. Experience using Databricks, data lakes, Spark, or other large-scale data processing platforms. Experience with one or more detection technologies, such as Splunk SPL, Microsoft Sentinel KQL, Elastic, Sigma, YARA, Suricata, Snort, or EDR query languages. Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and the detection engineering lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, tuning, monitoring, and retirement. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. What’s In It For You? Our Mission: Advancing Essential Intelligence. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. Our Values: Integrity, Discovery, Partnership Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. You will be empowered to work at speed, supported by a global AI ecosystem, and play a pivotal role in delivering outcomes that matter. This position operates within our triad delivery model, where engineering, consulting, and product expertise come together to drive transformative results for customers. This is not traditional consulting or pure software engineering; it is a hybrid role designed for the complexities of real-world AI deployment, with accountability for outcomes not just code. You will blend deep engineering expertise with consultative engagement to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business value. Operating in dynamic environments and working closely with customer teams - often on-site - you will scope, prototype, and deploy solutions at pace. Technologies include Generative AI, Agentic AI architectures, and multi-agent ecosystems, with insights continually fed back into Kyndryl’s platforms and frameworks to accelerate future deployments. If you are motivated by solving complex problems, excel in direct customer engagement, and aspire to shape the future of enterprise AI, this role is designed for you. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one. 2. Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks. 3. Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Optimisation: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability. 5. Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks. 6. Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development. 7. Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Skills & Experience 3-6 years of relevant IT experience in which at least 1 years of working experience in Agentic AI Frameworks, Orchestration, Deployment and 2 years on GenAI solutions Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python; experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions. Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark. Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures. Performance & Security: Knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems. Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences. Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required. Career progression is clearly defined, from Junior to Principal levels, with pathways to influence the evolution of our AI platforms. You will contribute directly to platform development and see the results of your work in real-world applications. If you are seeking an environment where your ideas are valued and execution drives results, this is the place to make a difference. If you want to work where innovation meets execution, apply now. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system. Key job responsibilities Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation. Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews. Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly. Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation. Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time. Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures. Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits. Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs. Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked. Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity. A day in the life You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup. About the team We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
jobs.description: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them. This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped. The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job. Key Responsibilities Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business. Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity. Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog. Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved. Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them. Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution. Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria. Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery. Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers. Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation. Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office. Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise. Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise. Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy. Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate. Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout. Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers. Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private. Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate. Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope. Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms. Professional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate). Area of Specialisation Product ownership at scale for end user services and mobile device management, with direct working familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform (e.g., Microsoft Intune). Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices. Digital employee experience (DEX) and service-desk-driven product improvement, using telemetry and ticket analysis to prioritise root-cause fixes. Related Experience Required Overall 15 years and 12+ years in technology delivery, including 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager with genuine backlog authority (not a business analyst writing another team's requirements). Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries. Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform. Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment. Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed. A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped. Proven ability to manage senior and conflicting stakeholders across business units and regions, and to hold a prioritisation decision under pressure. Fluent English; credible with both engineers and executives in a global matrixed organisation. Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [10–15]% of the time — including to sites, labs and field locations where the devices are actually used. Desirable: Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP-validated systems and the change control that comes with them. Product ownership for specialised or frontline mobile devices: rugged handhelds, lab and clinical devices, field-force tablets, shared/kiosk devices, scanners and shop-floor endpoints. Experience with deskless and frontline worker populations — employees without a corporate laptop, whose primary device is shared or personal. Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring. Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design. Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch. Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting. Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management. AI-enabled workplace tooling product experience — Copilot, virtual agents, AI-assisted support deflection. Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition. Sustainability — device longevity, refurbishment and circular IT built into the product roadmap. Skills/Background Deep product craft across backlog ownership, outcome-based requirements, continuous discovery, and value definition and measurement. Endpoint management platform fluency (Microsoft Intune or comparable MDM/UEM tooling) — enough to have credible conversations with engineers and challenge estimates. Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — conditional access, compliance policy, encryption — and the trade-offs each imposes on the user. Fluency in agile delivery tooling (Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow) — able to run a backlog others can actually read. Influence without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery, regions and vendors through evidence and relationship. Communication — equally credible in a sprint refinement and in a steering committee; able to translate technical constraint into business consequence. Comfort with conflict — the role exists at the intersection of security, cost and experience, and someone is always disappointed. Bias to evidence — willing to change position when the data contradicts a strongly held view, including their own. Skills Agile Leadership, Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, GxPs, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Platform Development, Process Diagrams, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs. Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved. Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale. Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them. About the Mansort Team The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers. We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises. Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs. Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation. Collaborating and working with Government, Research and Public sector departments What we need to see: B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience 10+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs). In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures. Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers. Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Function: AI Engineering / Applied AI Delivery About the Role We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production AI systems — not prototypes, not notebooks. This is a builder's role: you'll own the path from "we think an LLM/agent could solve this" to a system running reliably in production, under real load, with real failure modes. We are being deliberately selective here. This role is not for someone who has "used ChatGPT a lot" or built a weekend RAG demo. We want people who have shipped agentic or LLM-powered systems that other engineers depend on, who understand why those systems break, and who can hold their own in a room full of skeptical senior engineers. If that's not you yet, this probably isn't the right role yet either — and that's fine. Requirements What You'll Own Design and build production-grade AI/agentic systems — from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and iteration — not just model calls wrapped in a script Own the full lifecycle of at least one non-trivial AI capability: problem framing, evaluation strategy, prompt/context engineering, orchestration, deployment, and post-launch tuning Build deterministic guardrails around probabilistic components — retries, validation, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop checkpoints where confidence is low Design evaluation harnesses and offline/online eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not vanity metrics Make real architectural tradeoffs on latency, cost, and reliability — token economics is a design constraint you think about upfront, not an afterthought Integrate AI systems into existing production infrastructure (APIs, data pipelines, orchestration layers) without breaking what already works Push back on bad ideas — including ours — with technical reasoning, not opinions Who You Are 4+ years of strong software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years hands-on building and shipping LLM/agentic systems in production (not just experimentation) Fluent in Python and/or TypeScript, with the engineering discipline to write systems that survive contact with real users Real, hands-on depth with modern AI tooling — LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, or equivalent), vector stores/RAG pipelines, and prompt/context engineering — and a clear, opinionated point of view on where each of these breaks down Strong grasp of evaluation methodology — you know the difference between a model that looks good in a demo and one that's actually reliable Comfortable with orchestration and systems fundamentals: APIs, event-driven design, queuing, observability, CI/CD Able to reason clearly about cost, latency, and failure modes at design time, not just after something breaks in production Sharp communicator — can explain a technical tradeoff to both an engineer and a non-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down or overcomplicating it Genuinely curious and self-directed — this space moves weekly, and we need someone who tracks it because they want to, not because it's a KPI Nice to Have Experience with cloud-native deployment (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) Exposure to AI gateways / model routing layers (Portkey or equivalent) Experience with structured spec-driven or agent-first SDLC platforms Contributions to open-source AI tooling, published technical writing, or a portfolio of shipped AI products you can speak to in depth Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, healthcare) where reliability and auditability are non-negotiable Working Style Onsite Pune or Hyderabad, India. Direct, low-ceremony communication. We'd rather hear "this approach is wrong and here's why" in week one than a polished status update Benefits This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses Comprehensive benefits package Career development and training opportunities Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based) Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally known group Private Health Insurance Retirement Benefits Paid Time Off Training & Development Note: Benefits differ based on employee level About Capgemini Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2025.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
jobs.description: About the Team: Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. Job Purpose The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness. Key Responsibilities: Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured. Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies). Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary). Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards. Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding. Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement. Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required. Shape design trade-offs with Solution Architects, and scout emerging capability on the product platforms, bringing a short ranked opportunity list into backlog refinement. Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Product Manager and Domain Lead. Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact. Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria. Define the business value and success measures for AI use cases, including adoption, user experience, process improvement, quality, risk reduction and support effort. Lead AI-enabled product delivery across business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data specialists, security, quality and third-party providers. Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI, including appropriate human oversight, data protection, security, validation, traceability and regulated change controls. Monitor AI product performance after release, using operational metrics, user feedback and evaluation results to identify improvement priorities. Basic qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience. Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles. Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog. Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes. Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints. Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption. Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations. Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience. Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices. Experience owning or delivering an AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics or intelligent automation product. Experience translating business problems into prioritised AI use cases, product requirements and measurable outcomes. Experience leading cross-functional delivery involving business SMEs, architects, engineers, data teams, security and compliance functions. Experience defining and monitoring AI product KPIs, evaluation criteria, adoption measures and benefits realisation. Experience delivering technology products in a regulated or highly controlled environment, with appropriate governance, validation and change control. Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM). Preferred qualifications: Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions. Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations. Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience. Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant. Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately. AI product management: Ability to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data availability, risk and cost. Generative AI understanding: Good working knowledge of large language models, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop solutions. AI evaluation: Ability to define acceptance criteria and performance measures covering accuracy, relevance, consistency and user value. Responsible AI and risk management: Understanding of privacy, security, transparency, human oversight and risks such as unsupported or misleading outputs Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders. Skills Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Mobile (Android)
jobs.description: Overview Intuit is a global technology platform that helps consumers and small businesses overcome their most important financial challenges. We serve over 50 million customers worldwide across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer (Mobile) to help define the technical strategy, architecture, and overall engineering excellence for TurboTax Mobile, one of Intuit’s most critical consumer-facing flagship platforms. TurboTax Mobile operates at massive scale in a highly seasonal, customer-critical environment where reliability, performance, and trust are paramount. Responsibilities Responsibilities Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for complex, large-scale consumer applications, with deep technical expertise in Android and the ability to architect, develop, and deliver solutions across mobile, web, backend, and emerging technology platforms. Lead the design and development of highly reliable, scalable, and performant Android applications while contributing hands-on to engineering challenges across iOS and other technology stacks as business and technical needs evolve. Set engineering best practices, mentor engineers, and drive cross-functional alignment with Product, Design, Data Science, and Engineering leaders. Lead the strategic evaluation, prototyping, and integration of cutting-edge AI technologies, including generative AI, multimodal LLMs, and agentic AI, to transform consumer tax experiences and unlock new platform capabilities. Establish organizational standards for software engineering, CI/CD pipeline efficiency, and modern architecture patterns, including modularization, server-driven UI, and reusable platform capabilities. Champion technical excellence, performance optimization, accessibility, security, and reliability across mobile and adjacent engineering workstreams. Architect and build mobile platform capabilities and agentic surfaces, enabling highly contextual, intelligent, and seamless customer experiences. Drive end-to-end technical solutions across client applications, backend services, APIs, and AI systems, demonstrating the ability to operate effectively beyond the Android ecosystem. Job Purpose The Principal Tech Engineer – Site Serialisation Systems provides technical leadership for site serialisation systems within PIMMS (the Manufacturing Track & Trace product), across the broader product family, technology platform or programme. The role leads solution design, validation, implementation and troubleshooting and ensures technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy, engineering standards and GxP requirements. The role is hands-on and embedded close to business problems. The job holder personally investigates complex failures, interrogates data, logs and interfaces, challenges vendor and partner designs and resolves integration problems, rather than primarily coordinating or escalating them. The role works across the site serialisation estate rather than being tied to a single site and retains technical judgement and engineering integrity where strategic partners deliver routine build, test, deployment and support. The job holder applies AI-assisted methods to development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, knowledge management, monitoring and automation, while retaining full human accountability for technical decisions and GxP, Responsible AI, cyber security and architecture compliance. The role also develops engineering capability by coaching engineers and super users and converting lessons learned into reusable designs, standards, training and knowledge. Key Responsibilities Implement technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy. Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence. Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected. Design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments, including site serialisation system integrations, and write or review related specifications and test scripts. Hold configurations, interface mappings and scripts under version control, subject changes to peer review, and verify them through repeatable automated or scripted tests, retaining traceable test evidence under approved change and GxP validation controls. Own the technical reliability of site serialisation systems, including monitoring, recoverability, obsolescence and technical debt, addressing root causes so that incidents do not recur rather than closing individual tickets Actively extract and codify existing serialisation knowledge into runbooks, integration patterns, troubleshooting guides and technical documentation, building capability across the wider engineering teams rather than creating a single point of dependency. Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites. Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence. Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex incidents, integration failures and data-integrity issues, and act as the technical authority over strategic partner output – accepting or rejecting designs, configurations and test evidence against GSK engineering, architecture and regulatory standards. Assess technical risks and ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability. Maintain technical standards and reusable engineering assets for the assigned product family or platform. Support formal technical assurance, GxP validation, audits and inspections for regulated site systems and ensure corrective actions are evidence based. Identify repetitive serialisation engineering and support activities suitable for automation, reduce manual diagnosis, testing, deployment and support effort, and reuse automation across sites rather than resolving the same problem repeatedly. Apply AI-assisted methods to development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation and automation within Responsible AI, data privacy, cyber security and GxP controls, validating all output before use and retaining human accountability for technical decisions. Direct and coordinate external vendors, system integrators and managed service partners across design, build, release and stabilisation; set technical direction and acceptance criteria for their work, review and formally accept or reject their designs, configurations and test evidence, and hold them to GSK engineering, architecture, security and GxP standards. Experience working in Agile or product engineering environments, including translating operational problems into backlog items, iterating quickly, demonstrating working solutions and partnering with product teams through lifecycle ownership. Experience in leading technical design and implementation for a product family, platform, programme or multiple sites. Experience maintaining configurations, interface mappings and scripts under version control, conducting peer reviews, and developing and executing repeatable automated or scripted tests, with traceable evidence. Experience reviewing and approving specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and technical validation evidence. Demonstrated leadership of complex troubleshooting and root-cause investigations across systems, interfaces, workflows, data and infrastructure. Experience coordinating internal engineers, site teams, vendors and specialist partners through design, deployment and stabilisation. Preferred Qualifications Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to translate architecture and product direction into clear technical designs and implementation activities. Clear technical writing and disciplined maintenance of specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records. Understanding of interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support. Awareness of security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change controls. Ability to collaborate across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams. Practical use of AI-assisted development, agent-based workflows and prompt templates for engineering, testing, documentation and support, applied within Responsible AI, data privacy, cyber security and GxP controls. Technical leadership and ability to challenge designs constructively. Coaching and knowledge-transfer capability. Confidence communicating technical risk and recommendations to governance and senior stakeholders.
