jobs.title: Senior Researcher - Security & AI
jobs.description: Overview Lab Overview Microsoft Research India, based in Bengaluru, is home to a vibrant concentration of talent, pursuing important questions across AI and Machine Learning, systems, security and cryptography, and AI for healthcare. The lab combines the freedom to pursue deep, long-term research with a strong culture of building and experimentation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and opportunities to translate research advances into real-world impact. Researchers publish openly, engage with the global research community, and collaborate with teams across Microsoft, creating an environment where fundamental ideas and practical impact can reinforce each other. Learn more about the people, research, and projects at Microsoft Research India. Role Overview AI is rapidly changing both the systems we need to secure and the way security itself is practiced. AI systems increasingly interact with sensitive data, execute code, invoke tools, and take actions across complex environments, creating new security challenges. At the same time, advances in AI create opportunities to fundamentally rethink how we detect vulnerabilities, understand attacks, and build defences. Our team is pursuing a forward-looking research agenda at the intersection of security and AI , spanning both securing AI systems and using AI to advance security . Our research includes protecting sensitive data throughout AI pipelines, securing agentic and autonomous systems against new classes of attacks, developing principled defences for AI-enabled systems, and using AI to discover vulnerabilities, understand complex attack surfaces, and develop new security defences. Role Description As a Senior Researcher – Security and AI , you will push the state of the art in security for emerging AI systems. You will pursue significant, long-term research problems while also having opportunities to translate research advances into systems deployed at Microsoft scale. You will work with researchers and engineers across MSR India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to have impact both in the research community and on systems used by millions of users. We are looking for candidates who: Are passionate about advancing the state of the art in security, privacy, cryptography, systems, and AI Have a strong research track record, demonstrated through publications at top venues such as IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS , or other leading security, systems, cryptography, or machine learning venues Are excited about tackling emerging security problems created by AI and agentic systems Combine scientific rigor with strong systems thinking and the ability to turn research ideas into working prototypes Thrive in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment Take end-to-end ownership of complex, open-ended research problems Responsibilities Lead research at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and applying AI to security problems. Develop new techniques to protect sensitive and proprietary data in AI systems and pipelines, including training, post-training, reinforcement learning, inference, and agentic workflows. Investigate the security of AI agents and autonomous systems, including attacks arising from tool use, code execution, memory, external data, multi-agent interaction, and long-running autonomous behavior, and develop principled defenses against them. Explore how AI can help address critical security problems, including discovering vulnerabilities and attack paths, understanding complex security environments, detecting attacks and anomalous behavior, and developing effective defenses. Investigate new attacks enabled or amplified by advances in AI and develop robust defenses against them. Design rigorous threat models, benchmarks, evaluations, and experimental methodologies for emerging AI security problems. Form hypotheses, build prototypes, design experiments, and evaluate new security mechanisms in realistic environments. Pursue significant, long-term research while identifying opportunities to translate promising ideas into practical security mechanisms. Publish at top-tier security, systems, cryptography, and machine learning venues, release research artifacts where appropriate, and help shape the research agenda in security and AI. Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to translate research advances into stronger security for real-world Microsoft systems. Mentor interns and early-career researchers and contribute to MSR India's broader academic and research engagement. Embody our culture and values. Qualifications Required PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 1+ years of software engineering or research experience. Strong background in one or more areas of computer security, privacy, cryptography, computer systems, or machine learning. Strong research track record in security, cryptography, systems, machine learning, or a closely related area. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, open-source artifacts, or other impactful outcomes. Ability to identify and formulate important research problems, develop novel technical approaches, and evaluate them rigorously. Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams. Preferred Research experience in AI security, security of LLMs, or security of agentic systems. Experience with security and privacy techniques for AI training, post-training, inference, or data pipelines. Experience in areas such as systems security, applied cryptography, privacy-enhancing technologies, confidential computing, access control, or secure machine learning. Experience studying adversarial behavior, software vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, or security of large-scale systems. Experience applying LLMs or other AI techniques to security problems such as vulnerability discovery, security analysis, attack detection, or defense generation. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description: Overview Microsoft 365 powers some of the world’s most critical productivity experiences at massive global scale. The M365 Core organization builds the foundational platforms that enable Microsoft 365 services to deploy, operate, scale, and evolve safely and efficiently. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the M365 Core team in Noida and help shape the future of our cloud infrastructure and safe deployment platforms. This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, deployment and release management, reliability, developer experience, and AI. You will work closely with engineering teams and partner organizations to simplify complex infrastructure problems, build scalable platform capabilities, and rethink how AI can transform the way large-scale cloud services are developed and operated. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities As a Senior Product Manager, you will: Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for foundational cloud infrastructure, deployment, and service-management capabilities. Partner deeply with engineering teams to solve complex problems in deployment, release safety, service reliability, infrastructure management, and developer productivity. Understand the needs of service engineering teams and translate them into scalable platform capabilities rather than point solutions. Build experiences that make it easier and safer for developers to deploy and operate services at cloud scale. Use product telemetry, customer feedback, operational signals, and engineering insights to identify opportunities and measure impact. Drive adoption of platform capabilities across multiple services and engineering teams. Simplify complex technical concepts into clear product priorities, requirements, and executive-level narratives. Work across organizational boundaries to align stakeholders, make thoughtful trade-offs, and drive results. AI-Forward Product Leadership We are specifically looking for a PM who believes AI and agents can fundamentally change how cloud infrastructure is built and operated. You will explore opportunities such as: Applying AI to operational signals, deployment data, incidents, logs, and engineering knowledge to surface actionable insights. Creating intelligent and agentic experiences that help engineers diagnose problems and make better operational decisions. Automating repetitive operational and deployment workflows while maintaining appropriate safety and governance. Using AI to improve developer productivity and reduce the cognitive load associated with operating complex distributed systems. Rapidly prototyping AI-powered experiences with engineering teams and validating them with real users. Understanding the strengths and limitations of LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and emerging AI technologies and translating them into practical product opportunities. We are looking for someone who uses AI as an integral part of their own product management workflow, not simply someone who manages an AI feature. Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product management . Additional or preferred qualifications Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Preferred Qualifications: Solid product management experience delivering technically complex products or platforms. Demonstrated ability to work closely with engineering teams on cloud services, infrastructure platforms, developer platforms, distributed systems, reliability, or related areas. Solid product thinking with the ability to move between customer problems, technical architecture, product strategy, and execution. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces and create clarity and direction. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior engineering and product stakeholders. Solid analytical skills and a track record of using data to inform product decisions. Experience with large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform products. Understanding of CI/CD, deployment systems, service reliability, observability, incident management, or infrastructure automation. Hands-on familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted product development. Understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-based systems, evaluation, and modern AI application architectures. Experience building products for developers or technical users. Ability to prototype ideas using AI-assisted development tools, scripting, data analysis, or lightweight application development. Experience driving platform adoption across multiple engineering organizations. What Success Looks Like Platform Thinker You think beyond individual features and identify reusable capabilities that can solve classes of problems across a large cloud ecosystem. Technical Product Leader You are comfortable going deep with engineers on infrastructure, deployment, reliability, and architecture while maintaining a solid customer and product perspective. AI-Forward Builder You actively experiment with AI, understand where it genuinely changes the product experience, and push beyond simply adding AI features to existing workflows. Customer-Obsessed PM You understand the engineers and service teams using your platform, deeply investigate their friction points, and turn those insights into simple, scalable product experiences. Why This Role This is an opportunity to work on foundational technologies that influence how some of Microsoft’s largest cloud services are deployed, operated, and protected at global scale. You will tackle problems where cloud infrastructure, safe deployment, reliability, developer productivity, and AI converge, with the opportunity to build capabilities that can benefit a broad set of services and engineering teams. jobs.title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
jobs.description: About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes. We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked. Why This Role Exists: Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things. In this role you will be the person who: Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio. Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain. Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end. Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale. How This Differs from Traditional Product Management: This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you: Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform. Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements. Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off. Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime. Key Responsibilities: Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing: Hunt for high-value AI opportunities within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value. Quantify value rigorously. Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained. Develop deep domain pattern recognition so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated. Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping: Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain. Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio. Make trade-off recommendations. When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go. Protect engineering focus. Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes. Engineering Partnership & Enablement Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain. Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against. Shape engagements end-to-end. Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute. Surface re-use and platform leverage when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability. Design the human–digital split. Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe. Stakeholder Alignment & Communication Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders. Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements. Build sponsor coalitions that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements. Communicate impact clearly in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes. Measurement, Learning & Iteration Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn. Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities. Required Functional Experience: 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations. Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery. Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it. Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices. Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount. A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software. Skills AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. jobs.title: Engineer II, Data Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers direct that work and own the quality of what ships. Humans and digital workers both rely on a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them. The Data Engineer II independently owns a data domain. The role designs pipelines for complex use cases, owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in that domain, and keeps its context accurate and audit-ready. It also contributes reusable components to the platform and raises technical quality across the team. Why This Role Exists: Owns a data domain end-to-end, with clear accountability for the pipelines, models and datasets digital workers build and operate in it, and sound independent judgement on design choices. Makes digital workers more effective in that domain by improving the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, so manual intervention falls measurably over time. Delivers quality-assured data to AI systems through data contracts, governed context and quality frameworks that hold up to audit. Key Responsibilities: Agent-Operated Data Engineering: Design pipelines for complex use cases and direct digital workers to build and operate them, with clear, defensible architectural trade-offs. jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up? Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems? Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer. Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day? Profit Intelligence provides these answers. We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks. We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions. This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon. Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks) Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review Own your services in production — you build it, you run it Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores. Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers. Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions. Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics. You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company. jobs.description: About the Role: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to and own the quality of what ships. EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users. The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt. Qualifies problems before committing to them, challenging underspecified asks and forming evidence-based recommendations on what to continue or stop. Raises the team's standards through code review, documentation and reusable components that others adopt without rework. Key Responsibilities: Delivery & Experimentation: Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision. jobs.description: Lead Applied AI Engineer II Role Overview: As a Lead Applied AI Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks—together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver—consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes—and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build. Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, low-level architecture and component design, development, testing, integrations, and support. Maintain accountability for the integrity of architecture and technical stack to the enterprise standards and strategy. Manage dependencies, code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. The successful candidate will possess: § Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. Required Qualifications: § A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. § 6+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks. § 3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration. § 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, or micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability). § 1+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards. § Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. § Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly. Other: Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. #pxe Our purpose Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Our people and culture Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. Professional development At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India. Benefits to help you thrive At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. jobs.description: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. Key Responsibilities: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. § 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management. § Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production—their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. § Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). § Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. § Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. Within EngOps ACES, the Agent Fleet Operations (AFO) team is looking for an AI-first software engineer to join the Cloud Operational Demand Engineering (CØDE) organization and help advance our mission of driving operational demand to zero. We're seeking a hands-on engineer with a DevOps background — CI/CD and release engineering, safe deployment, observability, and always-on production operations — who pairs that discipline with AI engineering skills and a learn-it-all mindset. You are passionate about applying AI to solve real customer problems and energized by the challenge of eliminating operational toil. In this role, you will build and ship production AI solutions that reduce operational demand and improve customer outcomes. This role suits an engineer who has built and shipped production-scale AI systems — and ideally the CI/CD, safe-deployment, and reliability practices around them — and who wants to go deep on agentic resolution while collaborating closely across the team. Team charter Build, operationalize, and scale AI-native support experiences for Broad Commercial customers by transforming supportability knowledge into reusable, versioned, testable, and measurable assets that power product experiences, support engineers, and autonomous agents. The team reduces support demand, engineering toil, and time-to-resolution through AI-driven resolution capabilities that continuously learn from customer signals, unresolved cases, and operational insights. AFO operates a fleet of autonomous agents that resolve customer support cases with human oversight. Build and maintain golden datasets, rubrics, judge agents, frozen anchors, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Contribute to measurable business impact Help move key business outcomes, including support demand reduction, autonomous resolution rate, resolution quality, time-to-resolution, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction. Ensure the capabilities you build are measurable and directed toward the highest-impact opportunities. Turn Customer Signals into Engineering Insight Build mechanisms that convert unresolved cases, customer feedback, and dissatisfaction signals into actionable engineering insights. Help ensure recurring failure patterns improve future agent capabilities and route product fixes back to the appropriate engineering teams. Grow your craft and share learnings Deepen your agentic AI and DevOps craft, and extend the team's impact by sharing proven patterns, tools, and operational learnings with your peers. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations. Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence. Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations. Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations. Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
jobs.description: Cyber Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. Position Summary Job Title: Senior Consultant - Cloud AI Security Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide. Work you’ll do The team Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice. Required: 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements. Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments. Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals. Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell. Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance. Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI. Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred: Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud. Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM. Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities. Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center. Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads. Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications. Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications. Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications. Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability. Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices. Relevant certifications such as: AWS Certified Security – Specialty Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently. jobs.title: Data Science and AI Engineering Lead​, VP
jobs.description: Job Description: Job Title: Data Science and AI Engineering Lead, VP Location: Pune, India Role Description Driving the creation of new AI solutions for Chief Strategy & Innovation Office(CSIO). We are seeking an AI Engineer with more than 18+ years of experience who will stand at the forefront of innovation, architecting, developing, and deploying groundbreaking AI solutions that redefine what's possible. We are seeking a visionary and highly motivated Engineer eager to leverage advanced AI models and platforms to conquer complex business challenges and accelerate digital transformation across Deutsche Bank. As Deutsche Bank enters a phase where a variety of data and AI development tools are becoming more accessible, we are seeking an experienced Data Scientist and AI Engineer to help drive the implementation and deliver our AI Strategy for the Deutsche Bank. The role holder will be expected to lead the design, development and implementation of new AI solutions for stakeholders across the Deutsche Bank. These solutions will vary in terms of complexity, but all will have the goal of simplifying and accelerating Operations and Controls activities, achieving cost save targets, and driving revenue growth. What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy: Best-in-class annual leave policy Gender-neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender-neutral) Sponsorship for industry-relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and term life Insurance Complementary health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Leadership (20%): Help lead and develop a high-performing Data Science and AI Engineering team Help drive the adoption of AI and analytics best practice across CSIO, IT (TDI), and Deutsche Bank more widely Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, encouraging continuous learning and skill development on topics across AI Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies in data warehousing, business intelligence, and cloud analytics, particularly within the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support career progression for team members as needed Stakeholder Management and Governance (10%): Help ensure the CBIBOC Data Science and AI Engineering book of work is transparently documented and managed to ensure tasks are efficiently allocated and executed, and progress is easily tracked and reported Ensure AI governance requirements, as mandated by bank policy, regulation, or law, are adhered to for all new solutions developed Provide demos of new solutions, training materials, slides, and other materials as required to support the CBIBOC communication and upskilling agenda Hands-on Development of AI Solutions (70%): Lead by example, working with other Squad members to design, develop, and implement novel AI solutions Partner with business stakeholders and other Squad members to understand their needs and priorities, and identify new opportunities for the development or use of AI solutions Ensure new AI use cases (Squad projects) are rigorously evaluated and prioritized based on expected ROI, strategic alignment, technical feasibility and risk Ensure all new AI solutions are thoroughly tested, validated, controlled (e.g. implementation of guardrails, access permissions, etc.), and monitored on an ongoing basis Ensure all new AI solutions are recorded in a centralized inventory and brought through the required approval steps prior to production implementation Track against agreed KPIs to demonstrate the effectiveness and value of each AI solution (e.g. costs and benefits as well as accuracy/consistency/performance) Your skills and experience Strategic AI Solution Development: End-to-End AI Architecture & Leadership: Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of highly scalable and robust AI-powered applications and services utilizing Python, FastAPI/Flask, FastMcp LangGraph, ADK and Google VertexAI. Advanced Model Integration & Optimization: Architect, integrate, and expertly fine-tune large language models, with a strategic focus on the Gemini Model, for advanced tasks and cutting-edge generative AI applications. Demonstrable experience using Data Science / AI developer tools and platforms such as Github, VS Code, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow, Weights and Biases, Jupyter Notebook, Hugging Face, Langchain, Langgraph, Google Vertex, Neo4J, etc. Experience with front-to-back AI solution design and architecture, particularly the design of agentic AI solutions Scalable System Integration & Cloud Infrastructure API Architecture & Integration: Drive the design and implementation of seamless API architectures and integrations with diverse internal and external systems, ensuring optimal data flow and functionality across the enterprise. Cloud Infrastructure Leadership: Lead the deployment, management, and optimization of AI solutions on cloud platforms, leveraging services like GCP CloudRun/GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and CloudSQL for resilient data processing and infrastructure management. Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance Code Quality & AIOps Governance: Establish and enforce rigorous code quality standards and best practices for software development and AIOps, ensuring clean, maintainable, and well-documented code across all AI projects. Advanced Testing & Deployment Oversight: Architect and execute comprehensive test strategies for AI solutions, leading the deployment and continuous monitoring of models in production environments, ensuring high performance and reliability. Thought Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Research & Innovation Leadership: Actively lead research into the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and natural language processing, translating cutting-edge developments into innovative solutions and strategic initiatives. Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering leaders to define strategy, align priorities, and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality, impactful AI products that meet business objectives. jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with Python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Validate AI-powered features, LLM applications, copilots, chatbots, agents, and conversational experiences across functional and non-functional requirements. Design test strategies for deterministic application behavior and probabilistic AI outputs, covering positive, negative, adversarial, boundary, and edge-case scenarios. Test agent behavior across user personas, multi-step workflows, tool usage, function calling, memory, routing, fallback, and error-recovery paths. Evaluate AI-generated responses across single-turn and multi-turn conversations for factual correctness, grounding, relevance, completeness, coherence, and adherence to instructions. jobs.title: Group Technical Architect
jobs.description: Job Summary Technical Lead Platform Team About the product We build an AI-powered application security platform. It reads source code, finds security vulnerabilities, and then produces a fix that a person reviews and approves. Customers install it and run it inside their own cloud environment. The stack is Python (Langgraph, FastAPI, Pydantic V2), TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms. About the role You'll be the senior engineering owner of the backend platform, and the person everyone else learns the system from. Your job is to spread the knowledge across a team and lift engineering quality as that team grows. The core backend service runs the analysis and remediation workflow. It's long-running and resumable, it pauses for human decisions, and it has to survive restarts without losing state. You'll be our first engineering hire and the person who can deploy and debug the whole system. You'll also review everyone's code. Reviewing senior work and disagreeing with it is part of the job, not a rare exception. Key Responsibilities What you'll do Own the backend service: workflow logic, the API layer, and the boundaries between internal modules. Review all code and set the quality bar for the team. Take the system from single-instance to horizontally scalable without breaking correctness. Technically onboard every engineer who joins after you. Write architecture decisions alongside the team, and challenge them. Skill Requirements What we're looking for Substantial production Python(Langgraph, FastAPI, Pydantic V2,asyncio) including async code and static typing. Experience with long-running, stateful or resumable workflows: state machines, checkpointing, or jobs that have to survive interruption. The framework matters far less than having solved this class of problem. Strong relational data modelling, plus safe schema migrations against live systems. You've owned a codebase other teams depended on, and you were accountable when it broke. You read existing systems before you change them, and you can explain someone else's design fairly even when you disagree with it. Nice to have A background in security tooling or developer tools. Experience somewhere that writes its architecture decisions down. Must Have Skill Python,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Large Language Models (LLMs),Generative Artificial Intelligence,Fast.ai,Agentic AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements

jobs.description: Job Summary Job Description — AI/ML Engineer (Codibix Assistant) Location: Chennai Experience level: Senior — 8–12+ years Summary Owns the conversational Assistant end-to-end — a standalone Python/Node service, deliberately separate from the Java/Spring Boot core, that authors and validates knowledge-repository entries through a multi-agent architecture. This is the one genuinely novel, non-boilerplate part of the platform: not a CRUD app Claude can generate wholesale, but a governed agent system where every AI-drafted output must stay clearly distinguishable from human-authored content until a Reviewer approves it. Key Responsibilities Design and build the multi-agent architecture: Orchestrator/Router, Retrieval/Grounding (RAG), Authoring, Validation/Schema, and Explainer/Audit agents — each with a narrow, explicit job, not one do-everything LLM call Enforce the core guardrail in code, not just in the prompt: the Authoring agent drafts only, never auto-publishes — every AI-suggested entry must render visibly distinct from human-authored ones Build the tool-calling contract per agent (e.g., Authoring agent can call draft_entry() but never publish_entry()) — RBAC boundaries enforced at the tool layer, not hoped for in the system prompt Own the retrieval layer: embedding strategy, chunking, and query design against the shared PostgreSQL/pgvector store so drafts don't duplicate or contradict existing repository content Build and maintain the model-agnostic integration layer — the abstraction that makes "swap the underlying model, keep the same agent behavior" actually true in code, not just a slide claim Own the REST/gRPC API contract this service exposes to the Java core (owned jointly with the Solution Architect, who owns the consuming side of that same contract) Define and monitor agent-quality metrics — hallucination rate on drafted entries, retrieval relevance, false-approval risk on the Validation agent Partner with Domain Architects to validate that agent-drafted entries actually reflect real domain judgment, not plausible-sounding text Skill Requirements 5–8 years in ML/AI engineering, with direct experience building production LLM-based agent systems, not just prototype chatbots Hands-on experience with an agent orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and a clear point of view on why a graph/state-machine approach beats a single unstructured agent loop for governed use cases Strong Python or Node.js (matches whichever the Assistant service is ultimately built in) Experience with retrieval-augmented generation: embeddings, vector search (pgvector or equivalent), chunking strategy trade-offs Demonstrated ability to design guardrails that are structurally enforced, not prompt-only — this is the single most important skill for this role, given the platform's audit-trail requirements Comfortable owning a service boundary/API contract with a team building in a different language (Java) — this role does not need Java fluency, but does need to design a contract a Java consumer can integrate against cleanly Experience evaluating LLM output quality in production (not just offline benchmarks) — hallucination detection, relevance scoring, human-feedback loop design Must Have Skill Python,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Vector Databases,Generative Artificial Intelligence,Machine Learning,Agentic AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements Preferred Prior experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive domain where AI output requires traceability back to source Familiarity with Spring AI or LangChain4j (useful context for the API contract, even though this role doesn't build in Java) Experience building a correction/feedback loop that feeds structured signal back into a knowledge base, not just a thumbs-up/down Success Metrics Draft-to-approval rate (how often Reviewers accept vs. reject/heavily edit AI-drafted entries) — the most direct signal of whether the Assistant is actually helping Retrieval relevance (drafts genuinely grounded in existing repository content, not duplicated or contradicted)

jobs.title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
jobs.description: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact: Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms. Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use. In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters. This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it. Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software. If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection. About the Team: The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms. We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams. Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy. The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.
