jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Data Engineering Architect
jobs.description: About This Role Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer / Architect ( Data Engineering )to define and advance the data information strategy, information models, data sourcing standards, and data enablement roadmap across Enterprise Risk, Audit, and Finance Technology. This is a horizontal architecture role supporting multiple business and technology domains, including Financial Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, Internal Audit, Independent Testing, Model Risk, and Financial Crimes. The role will shape how enterprise information is identified, defined, sourced, modeled, governed, integrated, and made consumable across ERAFT. The role will establish common information models, semantic standards, authoritative-source guidance, reusable data products, and architecture patterns that enable consistent reporting, analytics, regulatory traceability, and artificial intelligence use cases. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of information architecture, enterprise data architecture, financial-services and banking domain knowledge, data governance, sourcing strategy, semantic modeling, integration design, analytics enablement, and stakeholder leadership. This individual must be able to work independently, influence decisions across business and technology teams, and translate complex business, regulatory, and technology requirements into practical and scalable data architecture. In This Role, You Will Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership. Required Qualifications: 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education 7+ years of experience in data architecture, information architecture, enterprise architecture, information modeling, or data-platform design. 7+ years of experience supporting banking, financial services, finance, risk, audit, regulatory reporting, compliance, or control-related domains. Strong Experience in APIs, Kafka or event streaming, ETL and ELT, data virtualization, data lakes, lakehouse platforms, and enterprise data warehouses. Experience with technologies such as Dremio, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Python, SQL, Neo4J, Protégé, object storage, and metadata or catalog platforms. Desired Qualifications: Data Information Strategy and Architecture Define and own the data information strategy and target-state information architecture across ERAFT. Develop current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures covering information domains, data sourcing, information models, metadata, lineage, data products, semantic access, integration, and consumption. Define canonical information models and common business concepts that can be reused across Risk, Finance, Audit, regulatory reporting, analytics, and AI use cases. Establish standards and artifacts for conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, ontologies, business glossaries, source-to-target mappings, data flows, data lineage views, and semantic relationships. Align ERAFT information architecture with enterprise data, metadata, privacy, security, retention, records-management, and regulatory standards. Define architecture principles that enable common information to be understood and reused while allowing justified domain-specific extensions. Produce architecture specifications, decision records, reference models, roadmaps, standards, and executive-level recommendations. Develop POC’s and demos to supplement architecture materials. Data Sourcing Strategy Define reusable data sourcing strategies across ERAFT business and technology domains. Identify authoritative systems of record, systems of reference, authoritative distribution sources, and trusted consumption sources for critical enterprise information. Establish criteria for selecting the appropriate sourcing approach, including direct-source integration, authoritative data products, APIs, event streams, batch feeds, data warehouses, data lakes, data virtualization, federated queries, and metadata-driven ingestion. Define sourcing patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured information. Partner with source-system owners, data owners, and data stewards to assess data availability, ownership, quality, lineage, refresh frequency, historical coverage, access restrictions, and regulatory obligations. Determine whether information should be physically ingested, virtually accessed, indexed, summarized, referenced, or exposed through a governed data product. Reduce duplicate sourcing, unnecessary data movement, point-to-point integration, and inconsistent transformation logic. Define data contracts that document schema, semantics, quality expectations, service levels, usage constraints, and change-management responsibilities between producers and consumers. Information Modeling and Semantic Alignment Develop and maintain enterprise and domain-level information models across ERAFT. Standardize business concepts, definitions, relationships, taxonomies, and metrics across Risk, Finance, Audit, and related regulatory domains. Define semantic relationships among customers, accounts, products, transactions, legal entities, positions, risks, controls, models, obligations, issues, findings, evidence, business processes, reports, and organizational structures. Partner with business data owners and governance teams to approve common definitions and resolve semantic conflicts. Support subject-area taxonomy alignment, conceptual modeling, glossary analysis, ontology evaluation, and capability mapping. Define semantic-layer patterns that separate business meaning from physical data structures and technology implementations. Evaluate ontology and knowledge-graph approaches where they improve cross-domain discovery, traceability, impact analysis, aggregation, or AI-enabled access. Promote reuse of common information concepts while preserving appropriate business context for individual domains. Data Governance, Quality, Metadata, and Lineage Define information-governance requirements for ERAFT data products, platforms, and solutions. Partner with data owners and stewards to establish accountability for business terms, data domains, data products, and Critical Data Elements. Define data-quality expectations for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity, consistency, and uniqueness. Establish patterns for data controls, reconciliation, validation, observability, and issue remediation. Define end-to-end lineage requirements from authoritative sources through ingestion, transformation, semantic models, reports, analytics, models, AI solutions, and downstream consumers. Establish metadata requirements that support discovery, reuse, impact analysis, auditability, explain ability, and regulatory response. Ensure that information architecture addresses privacy, security, entitlements, data classification, retention, records management, and permitted use. Promote common metadata, glossary, domain, ownership, and quality standards across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Data Enablement, Analytics, and AI Define the data foundation required to support dashboards, reports, analytics, advanced monitoring, and AI-enabled insights. Partner with analytics and business-intelligence teams to define fit-for-purpose data products, semantic layers, data marts, dimensions, metrics, and reporting definitions. Ensure that business metrics and analytical concepts are consistently defined, traceable to authoritative information, and reusable across domains. Define information structures and metadata required for AI retrieval, grounding, context management, model inputs, evaluation, and human review. Establish data-readiness criteria for AI use cases, including quality, lineage, authority, access, consent, context, explainability, and traceability. Enable governed AI access to business glossaries, metadata, lineage, quality indicators, relationships, and approved enterprise knowledge. Ensure that AI-enabled consumption is explainable, auditable, secured, and aligned with applicable governance expectations. Promote an information-first approach in which AI solutions consume governed enterprise context rather than creating isolated copies and conflicting definitions. Integration and Data-Platform Architecture Partner with enterprise architects, application architects, platform architects, solution architects, and engineering teams to translate information architecture into implementable solutions. Define patterns for APIs, event streaming, batch ingestion, ETL and ELT, files, data virtualization, federated queries, and metadata-driven connectors. Ensure that platform designs support scalability, resiliency, performance, security, maintainability, and lifecycle management. Align information architecture with enterprise cloud, hybrid, on-premises, analytics, and integration standards. Provide data-architecture input to platform selection, vendor assessment, and build-versus-buy decisions. Guide modernization from fragmented legacy data flows to governed, reusable, and interoperable enterprise capabilities. Maintain a clear separation between business information architecture, logical data architecture, and physical technology implementation. Stakeholder Management and Architecture Governance Act as a trusted information-architecture adviser to business, data, technology, architecture, risk, finance, audit, compliance, and control leaders. Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical information and data architecture decisions. Facilitate decisions involving information ownership, authoritative sourcing, semantic definitions, quality expectations, data sharing, and consumption patterns. Present data and information architecture strategies, target states, trade-offs, risks, and roadmap recommendations to senior leaders and governance forums. Lead and contribute to architecture reviews, design reviews, data-governance forums, and platform decision-making bodies. Independently drive architecture decisions while balancing risk, cost, regulatory requirements, delivery commitments, and long-term sustainability. Document major sourcing, modeling, semantic, integration, and platform decisions through architecture decision records. Identify architecture risks, dependencies, gaps, exceptions, and remediation requirements. Mentor architects, data modelers, analysts, and engineers in information-architecture practices. Job Expectations: The Principal Engineer - Lead Architect will be expected to: Experience spanning multiple Risk, Finance, Audit, Treasury, Financial Crimes, Model Risk, regulatory, or enterprise data-management domains. Experience with metadata management, data catalogs, business glossaries, data lineage, data-quality platforms, data products, and data contracts. Experience with semantic layers, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or enterprise information models. Understanding of data mesh, data fabric, authoritative data sources, and contract-driven data distribution. Experience with APIs, Kafka or event streaming, ETL and ELT, data virtualization, data lakes, lakehouse platforms, and enterprise data warehouses. Experience with technologies such as Dremio, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Python, SQL, Neo4J, Protégé, object storage, and metadata or catalog platforms. Familiarity with graph technologies, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise large-language-model platforms, and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience defining governed data patterns for AI, including source traceability, context, lineage, human validation, explainability, and auditability. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent. Relevant architecture, information-management, cloud, data-governance, or security certification. Establish a clear and executable data information strategy across ERAFT. Define reusable information models and semantic standards across Risk, Finance, and Audit. Improve clarity around authoritative sources, data ownership, business definitions, and consumption patterns. Promote reuse of governed data products, reference data, metadata, and integration patterns. Improve the quality, traceability, explainability, and auditability of enterprise information. Enable consistent reporting, analytics, regulatory use, and AI-enabled capabilities. Reduce duplicate sourcing, inconsistent definitions, manual reconciliation, and fragmented data flows. Translate target-state strategies into standards and patterns that application and platform teams can adopt. Posting End Date: 3 Nov 2026 Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. Operating at the intersection of technology, artificial intelligence and employee experience, our goal is to eliminate friction and elevate productivity across a fast-paced, distributed workforce. Join a team of hardworking, multifaceted, and hard-working engineers who take personal pride in the service they provide to our workmates and external clients. The ideal candidate should have a passion for operational excellence, automation, AI engineering solutions, and developing modern collaborative workflows. This person must be driven with a strong capacity to quickly adapt to a meaningful pace of work and an interest in learning new technologies. You will possess the ability to balance multiple tasks while operating across a large range of technologies simultaneously, ensuring daily operational responsibilities are met alongside customer SLAs. The successful candidate will be willing to take on tasks outside of their immediate knowledge base, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and communicate effectively—both written and verbally—in technical and non-technical language across multi-functional teams. Enterprise Platform Expertise: Deep administrative expertise across core collaboration platforms, specifically Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Vault), Slack Enterprise Grid, and Microsoft 365 / MS Teams. Automation & Scripting: Demonstrated proficiency in architecting automated workflows and scripts using Python, PowerShell, Google Apps Script, REST APIs, and command-line administration tools such as GAM and Google Admin SDK. Technical Operations (L3/L4): Proven experience operating as an escalation point for complex L3/L4 technical issues, incident management, root cause analysis, and ticketing systems (ServiceNow or Jira). jobs.description: Job Description Job Title. - Salesforce Devops - SRE Department - Employee Services Technology & Operations – CIO RUN Function Experience Level - 4 – 8 Years Location - Pune, India (Hybrid) Shift Pattern - APAC and EMEA Shift Reporting Manager - Yashwant Sinha Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Devops engineer with 5+ years of technical expertise to join our team within the CIO RUN function. In this role, you will bridge engineering, operations, and business systems—driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation while leading administration, enhancement, and process optimization across our Salesforce and Quote to Cash (Q2C) platform ecosystems. You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), and configuring Salesforce applications (custom objects, validation rules, flows, profiles/permissions, and Q2C workflows) to support evolving administrative and business requirements. Primary Platforms : Salesforce Sales Cloud, Core Sales and Salesforce CPQ / Q2C. Zuora Billing knowledge is a plus. Over time, you may also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications in the Salesforce value stream. Key Responsibilities Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements. Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets. Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes. Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging. Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency. Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles. Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc In future , also support onboarding of other critical Tier 0 and Tier 1 applications relating to Salesforce value streams. Detailed Roles & Responsibilities Core Sales & ITCRM Support Responsibilities :- User & Access Administration: Manage end-to-end user administration, including logins, MFA troubleshooting, password resets, license assignments, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing settings across Core Sales and Salesforce environments. Visibility & UI Administration: Administer and adjust field-level security, custom fields, page layouts, record types, list views, report access, and button/tab visibility to support smooth end-user workflows. Light Data & Config Operations: Execute routine data fixes, picklist updates, public group management, delegated approver setups, and light operational configuration updates. Triage & Routing: Actively monitor and triage the ITCRM support queue and incoming requests, accurately categorizing issues, resolving L1/L2 admin queries, and routing non-admin requests (such as CPQ incidents or complex integrations) to appropriate domain teams. ITIL-Based Incident & Request Handling: Own and drive ITIL-aligned Incident and Service Request lifecycles for Core Sales, meeting defined SLA targets for response and resolution times while maintaining clean documentation and knowledge base updates. Salesforce & Quote to Cash (Q2C) Administration:- Partner and collaborate with business stakeholders and end users to understand administrative needs, gather requirements, and resolve system issues. Design, configure, and customize Salesforce applications using custom objects, validation rules, workflows, Flows, and Process Builder. Manage system administration and streamline business functionality, including user profiles/permissions, role hierarchies, security models, reports, and dashboards. Implement, own, and optimize internal Quote to Cash (Q2C) processes to drive operational efficiency across revenue and billing systems. Triage & Incident Management:- Actively triage incoming system alerts and user-reported issues, minimizing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR). Participate in incident swarming and real-time operational response utilizing modern collaboration and ITSM tools such as Incident.io, Datadog, Jira, and Slack. Oversee the lifecycle of monitoring tickets, maintaining strict adherence to SLA compliance and response metrics. Problem & Change Management:- Assist problem manager to conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) to eliminate recurring incidents for Salesforce CPQ & Core Salesforce. Maintain and expand the Known Error Database (KEDB) and runbook documentation to mitigate Single Point of Failure (SPOF) risks across operational workflows. Assist change manager in reviewing and governing change requests, verifying risk assessments and rollback plans to maintain operational continuity. Tooling & Integration Management:- Monitor, troubleshoot, and support bi-directional SaaS integrations and data pipelines (e.g., Salesforce-to-Zuora, Workato, AWS Lambda, and EHC/Zendesk platforms). Ensure seamless data flow across ticketing and incident management ecosystems, collaborating with engineering leads to resolve integration breaks. Required Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, System Engineering, NOC or Global Command Centre environments. Observability & Systems Analysis: Hands-on experience handling telemetry-triggered incidents (APM, metrics, tracing in Datadog/Dynatrace) combined with strong business systems analysis capability in enterprise SaaS applications. ITIL Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management integration. Cloud & Architecture: Technical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), API integrations, payload troubleshooting, and database querying via SQL. Salesforce & Q2C Expertise: Demonstrated experience administering Salesforce platforms, managing Quote to Cash (Q2C) workflows, configuring security models/permissions, and building declarative automations (Flows, validation rules) Operational Drive: Proven track record in reducing alert fatigue, managing complex system environments, and maintaining composure during high-priority outage events. Nice to Have ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management. Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure. Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies. AWS , Salesforce and Integration/Middleware knowledge will be an addon. Zuora Billing knowledge (subscriptions, amendments, charges, invoicing) Salesforce Admin / CPQ / Platform certification. jobs.description: Job Description Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead Location: Pune, India Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk. About Zendesk At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy. The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR. You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes. What You’ll Do Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation). Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection. Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations. Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto- Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements. Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times. Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems. Tooling Enhancements : End-to-end management of observability stacks (Data Dog) and its integration with ITSM tools (Ticketing Tools) and applications. Seek assistance from product and engineering team for any tool enhancement use cases to build a robust observability platform integrated with the ticketing tools. Application Onboarding: Responsible and accountable for onboarding relevant observability and monitoring necessities for new applications which are onboarded and handed over to operations. Incident & SLA Management: Oversee the operational lifecycle of monitoring tickets and Lead the monthly analysis and reporting of performance metrics (Eg - Mean time to detect, Mean time to restore,Mean time to Respond/Accept, First touch resolution) and ensure SLA compliance . Continual Service Improvement: Liaise with technical and level 2 teams to improve and mature the current monitoring state of applications in scope. Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights. SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations. Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards. What You Bring Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications. Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools. Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets. Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python. Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews. Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives. Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages. Nice to Have Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance. Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems. Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog). Working Model Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows. jobs.title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
jobs.description: Job Description Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements. Core Daily Activities Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk. Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities. Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations. Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio. Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery. Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments. Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients. Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials. Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements. Key Responsibilities: Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use. Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance. Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios. Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team. Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality. Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations. Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio. Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction. Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience. Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS. Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios. Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability. Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges. jobs.description: Skill required: Sourcing - Sourcing Designation: Procurement Practice Manager Qualifications: BBA/Master of Business Administration Years of Experience: 13 to 18 years About Accenture Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com What would you do? Dive into the fascinating world of technology sourcing, juggle multiple projects at once, conduct market research, steer clients and vendors, communicate persuasively, achieve win-win results, continually learn about new tech products/services, and craft contracts that encapsulate all discussions and terms between our client and their partners. If you are passionate about technology sourcing, possess strong analytical and communication skills, and thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment, then we want you! Join us and become a Tech Nerd, Master Multitasker, Research Whiz, Consulting Pro, Wordsmith, Fact-Based Persuader, Curiosity Catalyst, and Contract Craftsman! What are we looking for? •Engineers with a full-time MBA are preferred, and a minimum of twelve years of relevant experience in strategic sourcing, category management, and/or professional industry experience related to software, infrastructure & IT services is required. Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are necessary and experience leveraingleveraging AI tools is preferred. A minimum of six years of experience managing global customers and suppliers (NA, EMEA, APAC) is preferred. You should have five years plus of team management experience leading a team of ten plus members. To be successful in this role, you should be a strong critical thinker and self-starter who can take the initiative with high-level direction and deliver client work with minimal supervision. You should have a passion for continuous self-learning across industries, such as IT, banking, retail, industrial, healthcare, etc., with end-to-end technology sourcing exposure. You should possess proven analytical skills in terms of numeric and text-based analysis, converting information into tangible recommendations to clients. You should be an effective collaborator, able to manage in a matrix organization structure with multiple internal and client stakeholders, and influencing at the executive level to drive transformational changes. You should also have a passion for process improvement and innovation, specifically aligned to applying generative AI use cases to augment sourcing delivery. Awareness of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) and their responsible use in sourcing and procurement activities. Ability to leverage generative AI to improve efficiency in tasks such as RFP drafting, spend classification, data summarization, and contract review. Foundational understanding of how generative AI works and its evolving Roles and Responsibilities: •As a member of the technology sourcing practice, you will be responsible for identifying cost/productivity improvement opportunities in technology spend across a wide array of leading companies and industries. You will lead sourcing projects, including all key steps such as strategy development, RFx management, risk management/mitigation, supplier negotiation, award recommendations, business case presentations, and supplier contract execution. You will work with the legal and technical teams to facilitate the negotiations of the legal and technical terms in a contract and execute them. You will also provide industry and supplier research, market intelligence, and robust commercial analyses to clients, support the development of market insights from cross-client sourcing activity, and collaborate with Technology Practice advisors to develop content that enables knowledge sharing across the organization. You will pursue and develop senior-level stakeholder relationships at priority accounts and support account relationship plans. Your role will span from individual contributor, leading high complexity sourcing projects, to team leader, coaching and developing expertise and sourcing excellence in others. BBA,Master of Business Administration

jobs.title: LLM Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : LLM Operations Engineer Project Role Description : Utilize cloud-native services and tools for scalable and efficient deployment. Monitor LLM performance, address operational challenges, and ensure compliance and security standards in AI operations. Must have skills : Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning Operations, Agentic AI Good to have skills : NA Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI and Multi-Agent Systems to design and deploy intelligent, autonomous solutions. This role focuses on building LLM-powered, agent-driven architectures that can reason, collaborate, and execute complex workflows across enterprise systems. You will work on cutting-edge Agentic AI frameworks, enabling systems that go beyond prediction to decision-making, orchestration, and autonomous execution. Roles & Responsibilities: Design and build multi-agent AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, and task execution Develop applications using LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) with advanced prompt engineering and orchestration - Implement Agentic workflows (planner - executor - critic - memory loops) Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases for enterprise knowledge grounding Develop tool-using agents that integrate with APIs, databases, and enterprise systems Architect and deploy AI copilots and autonomous assistants for business workflows Optimize LLM performance using fine-tuning, prompt chaining, and caching strategies Implement short-term and long-term memory mechanisms (vector stores, knowledge graphs) Design multi-agent collaboration protocols (hierarchical, swarm, role-based agents) Deploy scalable solutions using MLOps & LLMOps practices (monitoring, evaluation, guardrails) Ensure AI safety, governance, and responsible AI practices Professional & Technical Skills: Experience building multi-agent orchestration systems with role-based coordination Exposure to agent planning algorithms (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tree of Thought) Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, Promptfoo) Knowledge of graph-based reasoning, knowledge graphs Building autonomous systems or copilots in enterprise environments Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT environments Systems thinking for designing autonomous AI architectures Strong problem decomposition for agent task design Ability to balance latency, cost, and accuracy in LLM systems Communication with business stakeholders to translate workflows into agent pipelines Innovation mindset with focus on applying agentic AI in production 3–8 years' experience in AI/ML with strong focus on Generative AI Strong Python development skills Hands-on experience with: - LLMs & GenAI frameworks - OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers Agent frameworks: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel - RAG pipelines & vector DBs- FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate Experience building API-driven, tool-integrated AI agents - Strong understanding of - Prompt engineering & prompt optimization Chain-of-thought reasoning and tool augmentation Context management and token optimization Experience with cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable) Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines Additional Information: The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Generative AI. This position is based at our Pune office. A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education

You will design and guide enterprise-wide AI & GenAI solutions, from advisory through to production-grade deployment, working at the intersection of strategy and technology. Business Case & Value Transformation: Assessment of AI potential and development of use cases — including process hotspot identification using process mining and value-led prioritisation — that can transform business operations. Agentic AI Design: Help design agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and AI agent architecture for production-grade deployment using LLMs and GenAI platforms. Demonstrate deep expertise in LLM architecture, prompt engineering, GenAI platforms, and framework selection (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent). Leverage strong expertise and certification in cloud AI platforms — Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Azure AI / Copilot, Claude, Amazon Bedrock, IBM Watson — as well as open-source models. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies. As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. Mandatory knowledge of IT & Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience — Cloud, API-first, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MLOps, observability. Strong understanding in any of the following industries preferred: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, Transportation, Automotive/Industrial, or equivalent. An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies. Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional. Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. jobs.description: Entity: GN Song Practice: GN Song - Data & AI Title: Song EVA Manager - CL7 Job Location: Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai/ Hyderabad/ Pune/ Kolkata/ Chennai About Song - Data & AI Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and “next best action,” faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. What's In It For You? Join a worldwide network of practitioners who are pioneers in leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies, including Generative AI and Agentic AI. Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications to expand your skill set and stay at the forefront of industry trends. Work on high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - applying AI to transform how businesses operate. Contribute to Accenture's internal accelerators, reusable assets, and methodologies that scale AI adoption globally. What You Will Do As a Manager, you will lead the design, implementation, and enterprise adoption of Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions, combining deep technical expertise with consulting leadership to deliver business transformation for clients. Define and drive enterprise-level AI strategy, data orchestration design, and context management architectures for scalable Agentic AI systems. Architect and lead development of multi-agent solutions - orchestrating specialized agents to solve complex, cross-functional business challenges. Oversee advanced data integration, governance, and quality initiatives, ensuring reliability and auditability of inputs for autonomous AI workflows. Design end-to-end orchestration pipelines with best practices for scalability, monitoring, resilience, and human-in-the-loop controls. Guide deployment and optimization of AI systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), ensuring enterprise readiness and lifecycle management. Evaluate and improve system performance across trust, accuracy, automation rate, and business ROI metrics - in alignment with client goals. Engage with senior client stakeholders and executives, positioning Agentic AI as a driver of innovation, efficiency, and competitive advantage. Create executive-level solution presentations, roadmaps, and demos - communicating opportunities, risks, and adoption strategies with clarity. Leverage platforms including FastAPI, GCP Vertex AI, and Databricks for modular, enterprise-grade AI solution development. Manage delivery governance, resource planning, risk management, and project economics across AI engagements. Mentor Consultants and Analysts, fostering hands-on capability in Agentic AI frameworks and consulting best practices. Shape internal accelerators, methodologies, and playbooks to scale AI adoption across the practice. Domain Focus Candidates should bring hands-on solution-building experience in one or more of the following domains: Marketing - customer acquisition, content/ creative generation, performance optimization, and next-best-action execution Sales - omnichannel selling experiences, and revenue intelligence Commerce - digital commerce platforms Service - customer service transformation, contact center AI, and operations automation Design & Digital Products - experience design, digital product build, and agile product delivery Who We Are Looking For Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA from a top institution advantageous. 8-12 years of progressive experience in AI, Data Science, and/or digital consulting, with significant consulting or enterprise leadership experience. Strong expertise in Python and SQL; hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade AI solutions. Hands-on proficiency with Agentic AI frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph. Demonstrated success leading AI projects from design through enterprise deployment, including multi-agent and orchestration-based solutions. Solid experience with at least one major cloud or AI platform - AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or Anthropic - and its relevant AI services for development and deployment (e.g. Amazon Bedrock/ SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry/ Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI). Working knowledge of data platforms and pipelines; familiarity with Databricks/ Spark, vector databases, and API-based integrations (e.g. FastAPI) is valuable. Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills - ability to translate advanced AI into business strategy and measurable ROI. Proven project leadership capability: solution architecture, delivery governance, resource planning, and risk management. Strong foundations in supervised/ unsupervised ML, feature engineering, model evaluation and experimentation; ability to select appropriate techniques rather than relying only on LLMs. Hands-on Generative AI experience: prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), structured outputs, evaluation and guardrails. Agentic AI experience with tool/ function calling, planning, memory/context, orchestration and multi-agent patterns using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen or equivalent. Demonstrated capability in Enterprise AI Strategy and AI & Data Roadmap development - including AI maturity assessments, platform strategy, and agentic system design across at least one functional domain or cloud platform. Experience defining data products, semantic/knowledge layer design, and knowledge architecture to underpin AI and agentic solutions. Ability to develop AI business cases and value realization frameworks - translating technical AI capabilities into financial outcomes and executive investment rationale. Awareness of Responsible AI, security, privacy, observability, testing and evaluation practices needed to move AI solutions from prototype to production. What We Are NOT Looking For Pure Data Engineers, ML Engineers, or Solution Architects without consulting, commercial, or C-suite ownership experience. Pure Delivery/ Program Managers with no strategy, solutioning, or origination track record. RPA-only or classic BPM-only backgrounds without AI strategy or build experience. Hands-on-only architects without commercial accountability or senior client relationship ownership. Profiles focused purely on pre-sales or platform consulting (SAP/Oracle/Salesforce) without demonstrable AI delivery depth. Operations/ Process Transformation leadership experience; Lean/ Six Sigma or process excellence credentials. External thought leadership in AI - publications, speaking engagements, or analyst engagement. Scaled team leadership experience across multi-disciplinary, geographically distributed AI teams. GTM and origination exposure - ability to identify and shape AI transformation opportunities in a commercial context. Platform depth in one or more of: GCP, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or Anthropic.

jobs.description: Job Title - Decision Science Practitioner Consultant S&C GN Management Level: Consultant Location: Bangalore/ Kolkata/Gurugram/Hyderabad Must have skills: Data Modelling, Conceptual & Logical Design, Semantic Modelling and Understanding of Knowledge Graphs Good to have skills: Data Science, Ontologies, AI/ML Data Enablement, GenAI Foundations Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Consultant Data Modeler to design, develop, and support the maintenance of conceptual, logical, physical, and semantic data models that support advanced analytics, AI/ML, and Generative AI use cases. The consultant will work closely with domain experts/business stakeholders, data science/engineering teams to translate complex business and system knowledge into scalable, high-quality data and semantic models. These models will serve as foundational assets enabling analytics, decision science, AI-driven insights, and intelligent automation across enterprise platforms. The role requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across multiple client environments. Key Responsibilities Project and Team Leadership Collaborate with business stakeholders and domain experts to understand data requirements and translate them into clear conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Work closely with data engineers, analytics teams, and AI/ML practitioners to ensure data models are aligned with downstream consumption needs. Aptitude to work independently on modeling workstreams within client engagements, including requirements gathering, design, and documentation. Document & communicate modeling decisions, trade-offs, and best practices to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to project delivery through high-quality, low-defect delivery”, documentation, design reviews, and model governance activities. Data Modelling & Semantic Modelling Expertise Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for structured and semi-structured data across enterprise systems. Develop reusable, extensible data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML feature engineering, and decision science use cases. Apply semantic modeling techniques, including domain modeling, entity relationships, hierarchies, and taxonomies. Enable ontology and knowledge graph modeling, translating subject-matter knowledge into machine-readable representations. Ensure alignment of data models with enterprise architecture principles, data standards, and best practices. AI & GenAI Enablement Design data and semantic models that act as foundational datasets for AI/ML and Generative AI systems. Enable explainability, reasoning, and contextual grounding through ontology-driven approaches and graph-based data models. Partner with data science and AI teams to ensure models support feature reuse, RAG pipelines, and intelligent agent workflows. Contribute to data model designs that improve trust, interpretability, and scalability of AI-driven solutions. Data Governance & Standards Follow and contribute to data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design guidelines across projects. Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, lineage, and documentation. Ensure consistency, quality, and reusability of data assets across platforms and use cases. Business Impact and Innovation Translate complex business concepts into clear, well-structured data models that accelerate analytics and AI adoption. Enable faster solution development by providing high-quality, well-documented data foundations. Support measurable outcomes by improving data usability, consistency, and decision-making effectiveness. Required Qualifications Experience 4–6 years of experience with 3+ years of hands-on experience in data modelling, information modelling, or data architecture roles. Experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Experience working in consulting or client-facing roles is highly preferred. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills Strong expertise in data modeling techniques and methodologies. Proficiency with data modeling tools (ER modeling tools, UML, or equivalent) is preferred. Experience working with relational and graph-based data models. Familiarity with semantic modeling concepts, ontologies, or knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/OWL concepts). Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Preferred Skills Exposure to knowledge graph technologies (e.g., Neo4j or similar). Familiarity with AI/ML and GenAI consumption patterns, including feature stores, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems. Experience defining data standards and governance frameworks. Prior experience supporting analytics, decision science, or AI-driven initiatives.

jobs.title: AI, Sr Architect
jobs.description: We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and intelligent software systems. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. As part of our Generative AI / Agentic AI initiatives, we are building next-generation intelligent applications powered by LLMs, workflows, tools, memory, and autonomous decisioning. Our team is focused on delivering scalable, production-grade AI full-stack solutions that create measurable business impact. You Are: You are a hands-on senior engineering leader with a passion for building production-grade agentic AI systems and AI full-stack applications . You thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments and enjoy solving complex problems across orchestration, memory, reasoning, backend systems, and user experience. You bring strong technical depth in modern AI application development, combined with the leadership skills to guide teams, mentor engineers, and drive delivery excellence. You are excited by the challenge of developing workflow-driven agentic systems using frameworks such as ADK, NAT, and other agent orchestration frameworks , and you understand how to combine LLMs, tools, memory, retrieval, and guardrails into reliable applications. You balance innovation with engineering rigor and are committed to building secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. What You’ll Be Doing: Design, build, and deploy agentic AI applications and AI full-stack solutions using frameworks such as ADK, NAT, Langchain, CrewAI and similar agent platforms. Develop intelligent workflows for planning, reasoning, task decomposition, tool execution, reflection, and multi-step orchestration. Implement and optimize memory architectures, including: Semantic memory Procedural memory Episodic memory Working/session memory Long-term memory consolidation and retrieval patterns Conduct LLM evaluations for agentic applications, factoring in cost and performance considerations to optimize solutions. Build integrations with enterprise tools, APIs, knowledge bases, databases, search systems, and external services using tool calling, function calling, and MCP/equivalent connector patterns where applicable. Develop backend services, orchestration layers, APIs, and supporting full-stack components for AI applications, including human-in-the-loop experiences and operational dashboards. Implement RAG pipelines, vector search, knowledge retrieval, prompt orchestration, and contextual grounding for agents. Design robust agent state management, persistence, retry, fallback, and recovery mechanisms for workflow-driven systems. Establish evaluation frameworks for agent quality, memory relevance, tool-use success, trajectory quality, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, and safety. Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems, including tracing, logging, prompt/version tracking, workflow telemetry, and incident analysis. Apply guardrails, policy controls, validation layers, and secure design practices to ensure safe and responsible AI behavior. Mentor engineers, drive design reviews, establish best practices, and contribute to engineering standards for agentic application development. Collaborate with product managers, designers, researchers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions. The Impact You Will Have: Accelerate Synopsys’ adoption of agentic AI through scalable, workflow-driven applications. Enable delivery of robust AI systems that combine LLMs, tools, memory, and orchestration to solve high-value business problems. Improve engineering productivity and business efficiency through reusable agentic patterns, platform components, and best practices. Raise the technical maturity of the team through mentorship, code quality, architecture guidance, and knowledge sharing. Help establish Synopsys as a leader in responsible, enterprise-grade AI application development. What You’ll Need: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related field. PhD is a plus. Minimum 15+ years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on experience building and shipping production systems. Proven experience delivering AI/ML, GenAI, or agentic AI applications in production environments. Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of JavaScript, Java, C++, or Go. Experience with ADK, NAT, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar agentic development frameworks. Strong understanding of: LLM application design Workflow orchestration Prompt engineering Tool/function calling RAG architectures Memory systems for agents Multi-agent collaboration patterns Experience with vector databases, search systems, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval pipelines. Experience building AI full-stack applications, including backend APIs/microservices and frontend or user-facing AI experiences. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and container/orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD, Git-based development, testing, and Agile/Scrum practices. Strong understanding of observability, evaluation, guardrails, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices. Experience in semiconductor, EDA, developer productivity, or enterprise software domains is a plus. Who You Are: A strong systems thinker and pragmatic problem solver. A hands-on technical leader who can move between architecture and implementation. An effective communicator who can explain complex AI concepts to diverse audiences. A collaborative team player who values inclusion, curiosity, and continuous learning. A mentor who raises the bar for engineering quality and technical excellence. Ethical, detail-oriented, and committed to responsible AI deployment.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI (CAD/EDA)
jobs.description: We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. You Are You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle. You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use. At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work. What You'll Be Doing Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices The Impact You Will Have Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous What You'll Need Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in in production settings Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus Experience with Silicon Lifecycle Management concepts such as in-chip sensing, telemetry, and analytics is a strong plus Who You Are You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow You prototype fast and iterate based on real feedback, not theoretical requirements, and you know the difference between a demo that impresses and a system that ships You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure You will perform within the scale and scope of your role by defining solutions and beginning to identify problems to solve and contribute to Data Sciences’ and Target’s culture by modeling and contributing to the culture. You’ll drive development of problem statements that capture the business considerations, define metrics/measurement to validate model performance, and drive feasibility study with data requirements and potential solutions approaches to be considered. You’ll evaluate tradeoffs of simple vs complex models/solutions in determining the right technique to employ for a business problem and develop and maintain a nuanced understanding of the data generated by the business, including fundamental limitations of the data. You’ll leverage your proficiency in one or more approved programming languages (Java, Scala, Python, R), and ensure foundational programming principles in developing code (best practices, writes unit tests, code organization, basics of CI/CD etc.) are followed in developing the team’s products/models. As you do so, you’ll collaborate with engineers, scientists, and business partners/product owners to create algorithmic solutions that are performant and integrated into applications. We’ll look to you to mentor and provide technical support within a team, including mentoring junior team members, and present your work and your team’s work to business partners and other Data Sciences teams. With a deeper understanding of your functional area of responsibility, you’ll support agile ceremonies, collaborate with peers across multiple products, communicate and collaborate with business partners, and demonstrate an understanding of areas outside your scope of responsibility. What You’ll Be Doing… As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists. Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives. Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems. Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments. Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders. Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka. Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle. Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies. Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation. Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain. Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities. What We’re Looking For... You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale. What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…") Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience. Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments. One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows). Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks. Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design. Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality). Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka. Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics. Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing. Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders. Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists. What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…") Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments. Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression). Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure. Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems. Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications. Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.
